nye dga' mi bzod pa skyes rtsenas kho bo yang de dag gis bslus te spu gri la khu tshur gyis brdegs shing rang thags kyi rdo la rtswas phug gis kho bos de dag la gang bya ba shes so snyam du sems so/ /ji tsam na tshong pa de dag yang de kho na bzhin du 'ongs pa dang / nye dga'as kyang de kho na bzhin lan gnyis su bzung ste/khyed kyis kho bo yang bslus ci —so zhes smras pa dang / tshong pa de dag gis smras pa/'phags pa bdag cag la bgyi ba cung zhig byung bas des cho na bdag cag ma zhus ñtsa par mchis te/ da ni de dang gzhan yang thams cad 'bul lo/ /'bul 3lam / 'bul lo6/ /deng shig de dag de nas dong ste nye dga'i drung nas bral ba dang / 'di skad ces yu bu cag ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la yang sho gam mi 'jal na / dge sbyong mgo reg nye dga' la 'jal ba lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes kun du rjod 8par byed do/ /nye dga'as tshong pa de dag gis bdag la mang po zhig khas blangs pas yang ngade kho na bzhin du mi lta bar song na mi rung gis mtshan ma dang bcas pa kho nar langs te/ de dag gi drung du 'gro bar bya'o snyam du bsams nas des snam sbyar bgos te srang du song ba dang /tshong pa de dag kyang zong bkram ste 'tshong bar byed nas nye dga'as de dag la mtshan ma bstan par brtsams pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/ ༷ 'phags pa je zong bsgyur bar bgyis bzhud cig dang nyu bdag cag mchis te dbul bar bgyi'o / /nye dga'as smras pa/ gal te bden na'o/ /de dag gis smras pa/'phags pa khyod ni 'gal skyobar bgyi ba ma lags kyis bzhud cig /nye dga' song ste myur ba myur bar gtsug lag khang du song nas zas kyi bya ba byas tenyucu /lhung bzed 'khru zhing phyogs su rnam par lta bar byed do/ /de bzhin du gzhon nu 5—214

zhig gis smras pa/ gnas brtan ci'i slad du phan tshun rnam par gzigs par mdzadal/ nye dga'as smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa kho bo'i mdza' bshes tshong pa dag zong thogs te mnyan yod du zhugs pa de dag lta'o/ /gzhon nu des smras pa/gnas brtan khyod ji tsam na zas kyi bya ba mdzad pa de tsam na de dag dong lags so / /nye dga' rgya cher mi bzod pa skyes nas mgo bsigs 1te kho bo de dag gis lan gnyis su bslus kyis/ da ni gal te de dag mthong na gang gis phyin chad tshong par mi 'gyur ba de 'dra ba'i khrims 'char gzhug go snyam du sems so/ /ji tsam na yang tshong pa de dag de kho na 2bzhin du 'ongs pa dang / nye dga'as smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed kyis yang dang yang du kho bo bslus pas/ da ni gang bya ba de ltos — shig /de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa bzod par mdzod cig /bdag cag tshong pa dag ni rtag tu 'jal 4tshongs kyis sems g.yengs pa lags pas da ni sngar mchid kyis 'tshal ba gang lags pa dang /slad kyis rimachid kyis 'tshal ba gang lags pa de dang gzhan thams cad kyang dbul bar bgyi'o/ /nye dga'as gal te 'di dag la gzu lums su 'dzud snyopar byas na shes par 'gyur gyis mthun par brjod par bya'o snyam du shes shing rig nas smras pa/ bzhin bzangs dag nges par 'bul lam/ 'phags pa nges par 'bul lo/ /gal te de lta 7na khyed cag la nyes dmigs 'ga' zhig byung bar gyur tam/ kho bo cag la yang gtsug lag khang gi drung du tshong pa dag tshong pa ma yin par rnam par gzhag par gyur na ma legs kyis re zhig lam lta 3ba de srid kyi bar du sdod cig /de dag sdod pa dang nye dga' de na sho gam pa dag gi drung du song ngo sh+yi/ /de'i tshe na sho gam pa dag shes ldan dag tshong pa sho gam 5—215

'dral ba dag gis sho gam dral cing masge'u chung nas 'jug pas lo tang du 'du ba mi 'byung la dus la ni bab/ rgyal po ni gtum pas bdag cag bu dang /chung ma 3dang / rtsa lag sdodang bcas pa btson skurar bcug ste gsad 9par 'gyur ba gang yin pa de lta bu'i gnas yod do zhes zer zhing sems khong du du chud cing 'dug go/ /de dag de ltar sems khong du sachud cing 'dug pa na nye dga'as smras pa/ khyed cag ci'i phyir/ 'di ltar sems khong du /chud cing 'dug /'phags pa ji ltar sems khong du ngachud cing mi mchi / tshong pa sho gam 'dral ba dag gis sho gam dral cing ri sge'u chung nas 'jug pas lo tang ri 'du ba mi 'byung la dus la ni bab/ rgyal po ni gtum pas bdag cag bu dang /chung ma dang / rtsa lag dag dang bcas pa btson sarar bcug ste gsad sapar 'gyur ba gang lags pa/ de lta bu'i gnas mchis so/ /bkren pa dag khyed cag sus risho gam gyi gnas su bzhag /khyed cag gluni lcag rgod mang pos brims las skyed pa'am/ shing 'cheg tu gzhug par bya ba yin no/ /ci'i phyir khyed kyis tshong pa tshe sho gam 'dral ba gcig tsam yang nor thams cad dang bral bar mi byed/'phags pa mnyan 9yod ni kun shes pa'i sho gam can lags kyi nyes pa byed pa'i sho gam can ma lags pas ji ltar nor thams cad dang bral bar bgyi/ bkren pa dag mnyan yod ni nyes pa byed pa'i sho gam can yin gyi kun shes pa'i sho gam can ma yin no/ /'phags pa bdag cag gis yun de srid du sho gam bsgrubs ciX na lan 'ga' ri nyeyang nyes pa bgyid cho ༷ pa'i sho gam can ma cho — lags na/ da ji ltar nyes pa bgyid pa'i sho gam can du 'gyur/ bkren pa dag sdod cig dang nga song la tshong pa sho gam 'dral ba dag gtang bar byas/ de dag khyed kyis 5—216

zung la nor thams cad dang bral bar gyis shig /gal te mnyan yod ni kun shes pa'i sho gam can yin gyi nyes pa byed pa'i sho gam can ni snam yin no zhes zer na/ mnyan yod ni nyes pa byed pa'i sho gam can yin gyi kun shes pa'i sho gam can sam yin no zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gal te yun de srid du kho bo cag tshong pa'i tha snyad byed pa na/ lan 'ga' ri yang mnyan yod nyes pa byed pa'i sho gam can ma yin na/ da nyes pa byed pa'i sho gam can du gyur tam/ tshur shog tshong pa'i tshogs kyi nang du 'dong ngo / /zhes zer na rgyal po'i pho brang du bkri bar bya'o/ /gal te rgyal po na re shes ldan dag yun de srid du nga'i rgyal srid byed du bcug na/ lan 'ga' 4yang ngas mnyan yod nyes pa byed pa'i sho gam can du ma thos na/ da nyes pa byed pa'i sho gam can du gyur tam zhes zer na / rgyal po a ra da tshangs byin tshong pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas gang skyed mos tshal lam/ 'dun musa'am/ lha'i gnas che ge mo nas mnyan yod du 'jug pa la 6de la ni kun shes pa'i sho gam can yin la/ gang skyed mos tshal lam / 'dun 7sa'am/ lha'i gnas che ge mo nas mnyan yod du 'jug pa de la nyes pa byed pa'i sho gam can yin no/ /zhes khrims su bya ba rnam par bzhag pa gang lags pa de lha la brtsan nam zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gal te brtsan 9no zhes zer na/ lha mdzod che ge mo zhig na sgrom mchis pa de na zangs ma'i glegs bu la yi ge bris pa mchis pa de lhas gzigs su gsol zhes brjod par bya'o//ji tsam na sho gam pa de dag gis tshong pa sho gam 'dral ba de dag bzung ste nor thams cad dang bral bar byas pa na tshong pa de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag ci'i phyir kho bo cag nor thams cad dang bral bar byed/ mnyan yod ni kun 5—217

shes pa'i sho gam can yin gyi nyes pa byed pa'i sho gam can ni ma yin no/ /sho gam pa dag gis smras pa/ mnyan yod ni nyes pa byed pa'i sho gam can yin gyi kun shes pa'i sho gam can ni ma yin no/ /tshong pa dag gis smras pa/ yun de srid du kho bo cag tshong pa'i tha snyad byed byed na lan 'ga' yang mnyan yod nyes pa byed pa'i sho gam can ma yin na da nyes pa byed pa'i sho gam can du gyur tam/tshur shog tshong pa'i tshogs kyi nang du 'dong ngo / /sho gam pa dag gis smras pa/tshong pa'i tshogs kyi nang du mi 'gros tshur shog /rgyal po'i pho brang du 'dong ngo zhes de dag 'khang 1bzhin du mthus rgyal po'i pho brang du khrid pa dang / de dag gis tshong pa'i tshogs la shes ldan dag kho bo cag sho gam pa dag gis nor thams cad dang bral bar byas kyis 'grogs gyis shig ces ra mda' zlog 4pa'i skad phyung ngo / /tshong pa'i tshogs kyang de dag dang 5lhan cig rgyal po'i spyan sngar song nas / lha khyod kyi rgyal srid la sho gam pa dag gis tshong pa glo bur du lhags 6pa dag nor thams cad dang snye bral bar bgyis kyis yo/ngas su bskyab tu gsol zhes smras so/ /rgyal pos blon po rnams la shes ldan dag sho gam pa dag khug shig ces bsgo nas blon po rnams kyis sho gam pa dag bkug pa dang / rgyal pos smras pa / shes ldan dag ci'i phyir khyed kyis tshong pa dag nor thams cad dang bral bar byas/ sho gam pa dag gis smras pa/ lha tshong pa 'di dag ni sho gam 'dral ba lags la / mnyan yod ni nyes pa bgyid pa'i sho gam can lags pas de'i slad du bdag cag gis 'di dag nor thams cad dang bral bar bgyis so / /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag yun de srid du nga'i rgyal srid byed du bcug na lan 'ga' yang ngas mnyan yod nyes pa zhubyed pa'i sho gam can du ma 5—218

thos na/ da nyes pa byed pa'i sho gam can du gyur tam/ sho gam yang dag pa long la thong shig /sho gam pa dag gis smras pa/ rgyal po a rad tshangs byin tshong pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas gang skyed mos tshal lam/ 'dun sa 'am/ lha yi nyuganas che ge mo nas mnyan yod du 'jug pa de la ni kun shes pa'i sho gam can yin la/ gang skyed mos tshal lam/ 'dun sa'am/ lha'i gnas che ge mo nas mnyan yod du 'jug pa de la ni gnod pa byed pa'i sho gam can yin no zhes khrims su bya ba rnam par gzhag pa gang lags pa de lha la brtsan nam/rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag nga'i yab kyis mdzad pa gang yin pa de ni brgya byin gyis mdzad pa/ tshangs pas mdzad pa yin te mchog tu brtsan 4no/ /sho gam pa dag gis smras pa/ lha mdzod che ge mo zhig na sgrom mchis pa de na zangs ma'i glegs bu la yi ge bris pa mchis pa de lhas gzigs su gsol/ rgyal pos gtogs par byas pa dag la zangs ma'i glegs bu de 'on cig /ces sgrubasgo nas blangs te bklags 6pa dang / rgyal pos pha'i bsngags pa thos nas mchi ma dang bcas pa'i skad kyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag nga'i yab kyis mdzad pa gang yin pa de ni brgya byin gyis mdzad pa/ tshangs pas mdzad pa yin te/ gal te nor thams cad dang bral bar byas na legs so/ /tshong pa de dag re ba med par gyur nas mchi ma dang bcas pa'i skad kyis dong nas de dag gis sho gam pa de dag la smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed la sus sbran pa smros shig /sho gam pa dag gis smras pa/ kho bo cag la su zhig spron tsupar 'gyur/ kho bo cag nyid 3 kyis (shes mod kyi 'on kyang kho bo cag khyed la snying rje bas yal bar bor ro /khyed cag ha cang bya ba byed par brtsams pas des na kho bo cag mi bzod pa skyes 5—219

so / /tshong pa dag gis smras pa/ khyed la snying rje ga la yod/ smros shig dang kho bo cag khyed dang mdza' bor 'gyur ro/ /sho gam pa dag gis smras pa/'phags pa drug sde dag gis so/ /tshong pa de dag shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams kyi 1dge sbyong gi 2tshul ni tshig pa yin no/ /bram ze'i tshul ni tshig pa yin te / gang la de ci ltar gzhan gyi 'tsho ba la yang gnod par byed do zhes smod par byed/ phyar ka btong 4bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gis gzhan gyi 5'tsho ba la gnod par mi bya'o//gnod pa byed na 'gal tshabs/ can du 'gyur ro// pa //sdom la/ rkang med dang ni rkang gnyis dang / /rkang bzhi pa dang rkang ma/ngas kyi/ /sde 'tshan yang dag bsdus pa yin/ /rkang med ces bya ba ni sbrul dang pad nga/ dang / srog chags dri'u chi srin dag go/ /de dag ni gsum gyis sogs par byed de sbrul khas sdigs 8pa dag dang / rgyal po'i sma na pa dag dang /kha lungs pa'i ya ba na dag gis so/ /ji ltar sbrul khas sdigs pa dag gis she 7na / 'di ltar sbrul khas sdigs pa dag sbrul la brten te 'tsho bar byed pa ste/de ltar sbrul khas sdigs pa dag gis so/ /ji ltar rgyal po'i sman pa dag gis she na/ 'di ltar rgyal po'i sman pa dag pad pa la brten te 'tsho bar byed pa ste / de ltar rgyal po'i sman pa dag gis so/ /ji ltar kha lungs pa'i ya ba swādag gis she slon/ 'di ltar kha lungs pa'i ya ba na dag srog chags dri'u srin dag bag bye ri son nyu)par byed/ sa 'byin par byed cing sla nyurteng la rngod par byu byed de de dag de 'cha' zhing myos par ci 1'gyur ba'i btung nu snab rnam pa du ma 5—220

'thung bar byed de/ de ltar kha lungs pa'i ya ba na dag gis so/ /dge slong gis srog chags rkang med dag rku bar byed na/ srog chags 41rkang med dag gi rin thang brtsi bar bya zhing dngos po tshang na pham par 'gyur la/ dngos po ma tshang na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /rkang gnyis zhes bya ba ni mi rnams dang /bya ci kha cig go/ /mi rnams ni rnam pa gsum gyis rku ste/ yul phyogs dang /brda ri dang / mtshan mas so/ /ji ltar yul phyogs kyis she na/ gang gi 4tshe 5kho bo skyed mos tshal lam/ 'dun sa'am/ lha'i gnas che ge mo zhig tu mthong ba de'i tshe khyod 5kyis bya ba de byas par shes par gyis shig ces 7bya ba ste/ de ltar yul phyogs kyis so/ /ji ltar brdas she na/ gang gi tshe kho bo 8snga dro 'am/gung tshigs sam/ phyi 'bred mthong ba de'i tshe khyod kyis bya ba de byas par shes par gyis shig ces bya ba ste/ de ltar brdas so/ /ji ltar mtshan mas she na/gang gi tshe kho bo skra dang / kha spu bregs nas ring por ma lon pa'am/ snam sbyar dmar ser ram/ zha nye'i dbyar 'dab kyis glan 2pa'i lhung bzed dam/khar 1 ba sbubs can nam/ zhun mar gyi lhung bzed dam/ 'bru mar gyi lhung bzed dam/ sbrang 4rtsi'i lhung bzed dam/ bu ram gyi dbu ba'i lhung bzed thogs par mthong ba de'i tshe khyod kyis bya ba de byas par shes par gyis shig ces bya ba ste/ de ltar mtshan mas so/ /dge slong gis mi rku bar byed na mi'i rin thang brtsi sabar bya zhing dngos po tshang na pham par 'gyur la/ dngos po ma tshang na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /bya ni rnam pa gnyis kyis rku ste/ sbar ba dang /mngon sum du babs pas so/ /ji ltar sbar bas she chun/ 'di ltar dge slong gis bya sbar te rku bar byed na bya'i rin thang brtsi bar bya zhing dngos po tshang na 5—221

pham par 'gyur la/ dngos po ma tshang na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro①/ /de ltar sbar bas so/ /ji ltar mngon sum du babs pas she na/ 'di ltar bya ba'am/bya ba'i slob ma mkhas pa zhig gis bya drungs dbyung ba'i phyir dang / chud gzan ②par ② bya ba'i ④phyir dang / tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal bar bya ba'i phyir nags mes btang bar gyur cing de na bya kha cig du bas khyab cing 'khrugs par gyur nas/dge slong rnams kyi ⑤'chag sa dag tu babs sam/ dag ⑥ra dag gam/ sgo khang dag tu babs par gyur pa na/ dge slong gis de ltar babs pa'i bya rku bar byed na/ bya'i rin thang brtsi ⑦bar bya zhing dngos po tshang na pham par 'gyur la/dngos po ma tshang na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur te/ de ltar mngon sum du babs pas so// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po drug pa/ rkang bzhi pa ⑧zhes bya ba ni glang po che dang / rta dang / rnga mo dang / ba lang dang / bong ༅bu dang / ra dang / ri dgas dang / ma he dang / phag dag go/ /de dag ni rnam pa gnyis kyis rku ste/ khyu nas dgar ba dang / brtod pas so/ /ji ltar khyu nas dgar bas she tshun/ dge slong gis glang po che khyu nas dgar bas rku bar byed na/ tho ji srid mig sngar snang ba de srid du nyes pa sbom por 'gyur la/mig sngar mi sdong bar gyur na brkus par brjod par bya ste/ rin thang brtsi bar bya zhing dngos po tshang na pham par 'gyur tsol/ dngos po ma tshang na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur te/ de ltar khyu nas dgar bas so/ /ji ltar brtod pas she na/dge slong gis glang po che brtod 8pa sna tshogs shing ljon pa'am/ rtsig pa'am/gzhan dag la bstod 8par byed natso/ ji srid mig sngar snang ba de srid du nyes 5—222

pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /①mig sngar mi snang bar gyur na brkus par brjod par bya ste/ rin thang brtsi bar bya zhing dngos po tshang na pham par 'gyur la/dngos po ma tshang na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur te/ de ltar brtod pas so/ /glang po che la ji lta ba bzhin du rta la sogs pa rkang bzhi pa lhag ma rnams la yang de bzhin no/ /rkang mangs zhes bya ba ni grog mo dang /② bye ma leb dang /til dang / phub ma dang / rul pa za ba dang / sdig pa dang / t+ta ②ma bu ka dang / tre'i la ta dag go/ /de dag ni gsum gyis sogs par byed/ de ④gnod byed dag dang / grong khyer srung ba'i sna chen po la gtogs pa dag ⑤dang /rgya mtsho'i ⑥tshong pa dag gis so/ /ji ltar gnod byed dag gis she na/ 'di ltar gnod ⑦byed dag gis ④srog chags rkang mangs dag gis bum pa rtsaso btang ba ⑩bkang ste/ 'jog par byed cing de dag gis gang gi tsotshe chad pas gcad pa dag khrid de/ de dag gi rkang pa'am/ lag pa bum pa de dag gi nang du 'dzud (sprepar byed cing / de dag de dag gis zin 6pa na myur du dbya cadang /gsug mang po 'jal bar byed de/ de ltar gnod byed dag gis so/ /ji ltar grong khyer srung ba'i sna chen po la gtogs pa dag gis she na/ 'di ltar grong khyer srung ba'i sna chen po la gtogs pa dag gis srog chags rkang mangs dag gis bum pa so ma btang 8ba bkang ste/ 'jog par byed cing de dag gis gang gi tshe pha rol gyi dpung 'ong ba de'i tshe de dang lhan cig g.yul sprod par byed pa na/ gal te de dag gis 'joms ⑩par nus na de lta na legs/ gal te mi nus na srog chags rkang mangs dag gis bkang ba'i bum pa so ma btang bar ba ⑩la gnas pa 'phen par byed cing de dag srog 'chags rkang mangs dag gis zin pa na 'byer 5—223

bar 'gyur te/ de ltar grong khyer srung ba'i sna chen po la gtogs pa dag gis so//ji ltar rgya mtsho'i tshong pa dag gis she na/ 'di ltar rgya mtsho'i tshong pa dag gis srog chags rkang mangs dag gis bum pa so ma btang ba bkang ste/ rgya mtsho'i gru nyusbyar nas nor sgrub pa dag rgya mtsho chen po ci rgal ba na der de dag la chom rkun pa rtags mtshan sngon gipo'am/ nag po can dag 'ong zhing / gru 'joms par byed pa na tshong pa dag gis de dag dang / lhan cig g.yul nasprod par byed pa na/gal te de dag gis 'joms par byed nus na de lta na legs/ gal te mi nus na srog 'chags rkang mangs dag gis bkang ba'i bum pa so ma btang ba 'phen par byed cing / de dag srog chags rkang mangs dag gis zin pa na/'byer bar 'gyur te/ de ltar rgya mtsho'i tshong pa dag gis so/ /dge slong gis srog chags rkang mangs dag rku bar byed na/ srog chags rkang mangs dag gi rin thang brtsi bar bya zhing dngos po tshang na pham par 'gyur la/ dngos po ma tshang na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro// //sdom la/ gdol ba dang ni bag rdzangs can/ /snam sbyar re zhig dus dang ni/ /mtshan bzangs dang ni nor gyis byin/ /rang gir shes pas lhung bzed len/ /mi pham nadang ni zla bas sbas/ /bdag nyid sun 'byin rku 9ba yin / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na dge slong gdol pa dang bag rdzangs can zhes bya ba gtam 'dre ba/ phebs par smra ba/'grogs bshes/ smos 'drin gnas skabs mnyam par spyod pa gnyis shig 'khod de/ de la gdol pa ni grags pa dang me/ bsod nams che ba yin mod 5—224

kyi lus chung ste/ de la lhung bzed dang / chos gos dang / dra ba dang /phor bu dang / ska rags lhag pa dag yod do/ /bag rdzangs can ni lus che ba yin mod kyi grags pa dang / bsod nams chung ste/ chos gos gsum lhur len cing de'i chos gos gsum ngan cing snam sbyar yang yongs su rnyings pa yin no//dge slong rnams kyis bag rdzangs can la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod te por 'dod pa chung bar gyur na/ ci'i phyir bdag nyid gcer bur ston par byed/ci rnyed pas sam/ ma rnyed pas/ bag rdzangs can gyis smras pa/ ma rnyed pas so/ /ci'i phyir sbyor du mi 'dzud①/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang /dge 'dun spangs te②/ su zhig kho bo la sbyin par byed/ dge slong gdol pa de khyod ②kyi gtam 'dre ba/ phebs par smra ba/ 'grogs bshes/ smos 'drin yin la④/ de la lhung bzed dang / chos gos dang / dra ⑤ba dang /phor bu dang / ska rags lhag pa dag yod na ci'i phyir de la mi slong / bag rdzangs can gyis smras pa/ mi ster ro/ /ci khyod kyis sngon lan 'ga' bslangs sam / lan 'ga' yang ma bslangs ⑥so/ /ci chu'i sgra kho nas lham dag 'bud par byed dam/ song la slongs shig ⑦dang ster ro/ /bag rdzangs can de dge slong de dag gis spro bar byas nas gdol pa'i gan du song ba dang / gdol pa med nas bag rdzangs can gyis gdol pa ni lus chung ba yin pas je ⑧'di'i chos gos gzhal bar bya ⑨ste/ gal te bdag gi tshulus kyi tshad du 'gyur na bslang bar bya'i/ gal te mi 'gyur na ci'i 7phyir de drin bgrang 8du gzhug par bya snyam du bsams nas/ bag rdzangs can gdol pa'i gnas khang du zhugs te snam sbyar blta 8bar brtsams ④pa dang / ji tsam na chos gos kyi gdang tsol snam ⑩5—225

sbyar dmar ser 'dug pa mthong nas/ bag rdzangs can gyis phog ste/ gyon zhing bsnyams nas/ ngos dang ngos la rtog par byed pa na gdol pa 'ongs te ①mthong ma thag tu smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyed ②kyis snam sbyar 'di rku sems kyis blangs so/ /bag rdzangs can gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa kho bos rku sems kyis ma blangs te/ 'di ltar kho bo la gdol pa ni lus chung ba yin pas je la'adi'i chos gos gzhal bar bya ste/ gal te bdag gi lus kyi tshad du 'gyur na bslang bar ④bya'i/ gal te ⑤mi 'gyur na yo byad don med pa 'di ༅ci bya snyam pa'i blo skyes so/ /gdol pas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa ci'i phyir gzhan nas gzhan du 'phro bar byed/ khyod kyis ⑦rku sems kyis blangs pas khyod la pham par 'gyur ba'i ltung ⑧ba byung ngo / /bag rdzangs can bdag la pham par 'gyur ba'i ltung ba ma byung ngam snyam du 'gyod pa skyes nas/ des skabs de dge slong rnams la brjod do/ /dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong de la rmas ⑨pa/ dge slong khyod kyis skyabasam pa ji lta bus snam sbyar de bgos/ bag rdzangs can gyis ji ltar gyur pa bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong dpyod pa'i bsam pa can 'di la ni ⑪ltung ba med de/ yang dge slong gis yid gcugs 8pa ma yin pa la yid gcugs ⑩pa bskyed par mi bya'o/ /'di ltar mdza' bshes ④ni gsum ste/ tha ma dang / 'bring dang / chen po'o/ /de ④la mdza' bshes tsotha ma la ni yid gcugs ⑩pa chung ngu tsobya'i/ 'bring yang ⑩mi bya/ chen po yang mi bya'o/ /mdza' bshes rjo 'bring la ni yid gcugs 0pa chung ngu dang / 'bring bya'i chen po 5—226

mi bya'o/ /mdza' bshes chen po la ni yid gcugs pa chung ngu dang / 'bring dang / chen po yang bya'o/ /dge slong gis yid gcugs ①pa ma yin pa la yid gcugs ②pa skyed par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod ②na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na dge slong mtshan bzangs dang / nor gyis byin zhes bya ba gtam 'dre ba④/ phebs par smra bas/'grogs bshes smos 'drin mtshungs ⑥par 'don pa gnyis shig 'khod de/mtshan bzangs kyi ①lhung bzed ni mdzes pa/ gsal ba/ skum pa/ longs spyad dubazod pa yin la/ nor gyis byin gyi lhung bzed chung ngu yang mdzes pa/gsal ba/ skum pa/ longs spyad bzod pa yin no/ /de gnyis dus gzhan zhig na zas kyi bya ba byas te/ 'chag yis na lhung bzed 'khru ba'i tshe hu mtshan bzangs kyis (1nor gyis byin dbang ba'i lhung bzed chung ngu rang gis 0lhung bzed du bcug ste smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa nor gyis 'byin gang la lhung bzed dang ④lhang bzed chung ngu 'di lta bu bdog pa de ni snying las chung ngus tshudage ba'i phyogs spyod par byed do/ /nor gyis byin gyis smras pa/ gal te thob na khyer cigayi /ji tsam dus cigazhan zhig na nor gyis byin la ri brag ④shig tu bya ba chung ༅zhig byung nas des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa mtshan bzangs kho bo la ri brag 0 shig tu bya ba chung zhig 0byung nas/ kho bo'i bya ba de byed pa de la kho bos lhung bzed chung ngu sbyin no/ /mtshan bzangs kyis ( )smras pa/ sbyin nam/sbyin no/ /thabs yin no/ /mtshan bzangs kyis ④thabs ④yin no/ /zhes byas nas bdag la gzhi 'dis tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams mtshan 5—227

bzangs ni gla rngan gyis las byed do/ /zhes zer bar 'gyur ro snyam nas 'gyod pa skyes te de ma song ngo / /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na mtshan bzangs la ri brag ①der bdag nyid kyi bya ba zhig byung nas/ des song la de gnyi ga byas te phyir 'ong ngo snyam du bsams nas mtshan bzangs song ste gnyi ②ga byas nas phyir 'ongs te smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa nor gyis byin kho bos khyod kyi dgos pa de bsgrubs kyis lhung bzed chung ngu byin cig /nor gyis byin gyis smras pa/khyed ③bdag nyid kyi dgos pa la song ba yin gyi/ kho bo'i dgos pa la song ba ma yin pas kho bos mi sbyin no/ /mtshan bzangs kyis ༅smras pa/ gal te mi sbyin na kho bo rang nyid kyis blang bar bya'o/ /gal te thob na'o/ /ji tsam na nor gyis byin phyir byung ba de na mtshan bzangs kyis ②lhung bzed chung ngu blangs te rang gi lhung bzed du bcug ⑥ste bzhag go/ /ji tsam na nor gyis byin 'ongs pa na lhung bzed chung ngu mi snang nas des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa kho bo'i lhung bzed chung ngu sus blangs mtshan bzangs kyis ⑦smras pa/ su dbang bas so/ /su dbang / kho bo dbang ngo / /nor gyis byin gyis spyos te smras pa/ khyod kyis rku sems kyis blangs pas khyod la pham par 'gyur ba'i ltung ba byung ngo / /mtshan bzangs bdag la pham par 'gyur ba'i ltung ba ma dubyung ngam snyam du 'gyod pa skyes nas/ des skabs de ⑨dge slong rnams la brjod she/ /dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis mtshan bzangs la bka' stsal ⑩pa/ dge slong khyod kyis bsam pa ji lta bus lhung bzed chung ngu de blangs0/ des ji ltar gyur pa bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge 5—228

slong rang gi ①'du shes pas lhung bzed chung ngu blangs pa ②'di la ni ltung ba med de / yang dge slong gis gla rngan gyis rgyalas mi bya bar 'di ltar lag pod dam/bsod nams 'dod pas las bya'o/ /dge slong gis gla rngan gyis las byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na dge slong mi pham dang / zla bas sbas zhes bya ba gtam 'dre ba/ phebs par smra ba/ 'grogs bshes smos 'drin gnyis shig 'khod dekhyo/ zla bas sbas ni grags pa dang ⑤/bsod nams che ba yin te/ de la lhung bzed dang / chos gos dang / dra ba dang / phor bu dang / ska rags lhag pa dag yod do/ /mi pham ni grags pa dang / bsod nams chung ste/ chos gos gsum lhur len cing de'i chos gos gsum ngan cing snam sbyar yang yongs su rnyings ⑥pa yin no/ /dge slong rnams kyis ⑦mi pham pa la smras ⑧pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod khyate por 'dod pa chung bar gyur na ci'i phyir bdag nyid gcer bur ston par byed/ ci rnyed pas sam / ma rnyed pas/ mi pham gyis smras pa/ ma rnyed pas so/ /ci'i phyir sbyor ⑩du mi 'dzud⑩/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun spangs te ⑫su zhig kho bo la sbyin par byed/ dge slong zla bas sbas de khyod kyi gtam 'dre ba/phebs par smra btso/ 'grogs bshes/ smos ci'adrin yin la/ de la lhung bzed dang / chos gos dang / dra ba dang / phor bu dang / ska rags lhag pa dag yod na ci'i phyir de la mi slong / mi pham gyis byasmras pa/ mi ster ro / /ci khyod kyis sngon lan 'ga' bslangs sam/ lan 'ga' yang ma 5—229

bslangs so/ / ci'i phyir ②chu'i sgra go rgyanas lham dag 'bud par byed dam/song la slongs shig dang ster ro/ /mi pham de dge slong de dag gis spro bar byas nas zla bas sbas kyi gan du song ste smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa zla bas sbas bdag la lhung bzed byin cig /zla bas sbas kyis smras pa/ mi sbyin no/ /mi pham gyis smras pa/ gal te lhung bzed mi sbyin na chos gos byin cig /zla bas sbas kyis smras pa/ ci kho bo khyod kyis sbyin ②bdag mgo reg tu mthong ngam khyod la kha tshar yang yongs su mi gtang na/ chos gos lta smos ④kyang ci dgos/ mi pham ⑤gyis spyos te/ kho bo 'di'i 'phral ⑥gyi bya ba thams cad la thog mar 'gro ba yin na/ 'di de skad ces kha tshar yang khyod la yongs su mi gtang na/chos gos lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes zer ro snyam du bsams nas/ mi pham gyis smras pa/ deng gos ④thams cad ma phrogs dun mi pham zhes bya ba'i ming mi gzung ༅ngo zhes mi pham de nam zhig na 'di'i chos gos dag brku ⑩bar bya snyam du skabs tshol zhing de lhur len bzhin du sdod do/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na zla bas sbas la btso 7blag gi las nye bar gnas par gyur pa dang / mi pham de zla bas sbas kyi drung du song ste smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa zla bas sbas kho bos kyang grogs bya'o/ /zla bas sbas kyis smras pa/ ma nyes kyis de bzhin gyis shig /mi pham de zla bas sbas kyi ()chos gos dag 'tshed tho)par byed/ byi dor byed/'dren par byed cing zlog ④cing zlog ④cing rtog par byed do/ /zla bas sbas kyis 'di 'di ltar lta bas bdag gi chos gos yidag zlog ⑩cing zlog 8cing rtog par byed pa las na gdon mi za bar bdag gi yichos gos 'di dag rku bar byed do/ /snyam du bsams nas zla bas sbas dogs pa dang bcas pas chos gos dag kha 5—230

bsgyur ①nas gtur bur bcug ste de dag sngas su bcug nas nyal lo/ /dge slong dag nam gyi cha stod dang nam gyi cha smad la mi nyal bar sbyor ba'i rjes su brtson par spyod pas mi pham gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa zla bas sbas tshur shog /dge ba'i phyogs byed du 'dong / zla bas sbas kyis smras pa/ khyod song shig kho bo ngal bas ②phyi bzhin 'ong ngo / /mi pham pa tshe dang ldan pa shog shig ces zer te phyir byung ngo / /zla bas sbas kyis gal te 'gro na ni chos gos dag rlag ②par 'gyur / 'on te mi 'gro na ni bdag gi dge ba'i phyogs yongs su nyams par 'gyur na/ gang gi phyir bdag gi chos gos dag kyang rlag ④par mi 'gyur la/dge ba'i phyogs kyang ⑤nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i thabs ci yod snyam du sems shing rig nas/ bdag nyid kyi gtur bu mi pham gyi sngas su bcug ste༅/ mi pham dbang ba'i gtur bu bdag nyid kyi sngas su bcug nas nyal lo/ /dge slong dag gis nam gyi cha smad la kha ton bya bar brtsams pa dang / zla bas sbas kyis mi pham la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa mi pham longs la dge ba'i phyogs spyod cig༅ /mi pham gyis smras pa/ kho bos dge ba'i phyogs byas zin gyidu/ da khyod song la dge ba'i phyogs spyod cig /kho bo ngal ba ngal ba 0sos so zhes zla bas sbas dge ba'i phyogs kyi ched du song ngo / /mi pham gyis re zhig dus ni snang na lam gyi dus yin nam ma yin snyam du bsams ⑪ nas/ dus bzang po mthong ba dang / de ⑪zla bas sbas kyi sngas nas bdag nyid kyi gtur 8bu khyer te tsomong ngo ji tsam na mtshan mo nam nangs par gyur pa dang / des re zhig chos cigos ci 'dra ba dag gis bdag pham par gyur pa'i ltung ba byung ba blta'o snyam du bsams nas/ji tsam na bdag nyid kyi rnyang 4)rnying dag mthong nas yid mi bde bar gyur te/5—231

bdag nyid kyi ①chos gos dag kho nas bdag pham par gyur ②gyis lcags kyi thu lum 'cha' bas ci bya/ phyir 'babs par bya'o snyam mo/ /des yang je bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'gro bar byas te③/ gal te skal ba yod par gyur na rjoni bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bya'o/ /'on te skal ba med na ni phyir 'babs so snyam du bsams nas/ de bcom ldan 'das ga la ⑤ba der song ngo / /de'i tshe na bcom ldan 'das dge slong brgya phrag du ma'i 'khor gyi mdun na chos ston pa'i phyir bzhugs shing chos ston to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mi pham thag ring po kho na nas gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed kyis thag ring po kho na nas 'ong ba'i dge slong de mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong ngo / /dge slong dag mi pham mi gti mug can 'di ni rang gi chos gos rnyang rnying ⑥dag gis nyes pa sbom po'i ltung ba byung ngo / /dge slong dag de ltar rku ⑦sems la ni nyes dmigs 'di dang gzhan dag kyang yod pas de'i phyir dge slong gis rku sems kyis rang gi lhung bzed dang / chos gos kyang blang bar mi bya'o/ /dge slong gis rku sems kyis rang gi lhung bzed dang chos gos len na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro// //sdom la/ snam sbyar 'phyang bar gyur pa dang / /bgam phyir 'bru mar slong ba dang / /khyim bdag bu dang tsha bo dang / /lha 'bangs ⑧mi lin da ⑨yi bu//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na dge slong ma shar nas skyes pa dang / lho nas skyes pa gnyis shig 'dug ste/ shar nas skyes pa ni 5—232

mdun du 'gro ba'i dge slong ①ma yin/ lho nas skyes pa ni phyi ②bzhin 'brang ba'i dge slong ①ma yin no/ /de gnyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing spyan sngar song nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'khod do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de gnyis la chos bstan nas/ de gnyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te dong ba dang / shar nas skyes pa mdun du 'gro ba de'i snam sbyar phrag ④pa la gyon pa 'phyang bar gyur nas/ lho nas skyes pa phyi bzhin 'ong bas smras pa/ 'phags ma a ba sa ṭha ⑤yo ba sa ṭha༅/ shar nas skyes pa de chos kyi shugs thob pas mi sems pas/ snam sbyar ltung ⑦bar gyur nas/ lho nas skyes pas blangs te/des 'di ltar bdag gis da ⑤phul na/ 'phags ma'i dge ba'i phyogs yongs su nyams par 'gyur bas ⑨dbyar khang du phyin nas dbul bar bya'o snyam du bsams nas / de gnyis dbyar khang du son pa dang / shar nas skyes pa 7myur ba myur ba kho nar gtsug ⑩lag khang gi phyi rol du rkang pa gnyis bkrus nas gtsug lag khang du zhugs te skyil mo krung 'phyed kyis 'dug go/ /lho nas skyes pas gal te phul na nyes dmigs de kho na bstabs ④par 'gyur bas re zhig phyis langs pa la dbul lo snyam du bsams nas/ des snam sbyar de rang gi gnas khang du khyer te chos gos kyi gdang ④la bzhag go/ /ji tsam nyi ma gzhan zhig na mtshan mo nam nangs pa dang / shar nas skyes pas smras pa/ gzhon nu ma snam sbyar khyer cishog /bsod snyoms la 'gro'o/ /gzhon nu ma de 8gnas khang du zhugs te/chos gos kyi gdang skyal bltas ⑩pa dang / snam sbyar ma mthong nas des smras pa/'phags ma snam sbyar ma mchis so/ /shar nas skyes pas smras pa/ lho nas skyes 5—233

pa'i gnas khang du ltos shig /gzhon nu ma de lho nas skyes pa'i gnas khang du zhugs pa dang / chos gos kyi gdang ①la snam sbyar bzhag pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang sus 'phags ma'i snam sbyar 'di 'dir khyer snyam du sems so/ /lho nas skyes pas thos nas des smras pa/ kho mos khyer te 'ongs so ci'i phyir lho nas skyes pas ji ltar gyur pa de la go bar byas so/ /dge slong ma de de la nang dang bcas pas gshe zhing smras pa/ khyod kyis rku sems kyis rang gi gnas khang du bcug ②ste/ bzhag pas khyod la pham par 'gyur ba'i ltung ba byung ngo / /lho nas skyes pa'i dge slong ma de bdag la yang dag pa kho nar pham par 'gyur ba'i ltung ba ma byung ngam snyam du 'gyod pa skyes nas des skabs de dge slong ma rnams la brjod pa dang / dge slong ma rnams kyis dge slong rnams la brjod nas/ dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong sem de la rmas ④pa/ dge slong ma khyod kyis a ba sa ṭha ⑤zhes brjod pa ci'i tha tshig /btsun pa yul dbus na nar pa dang / lhung ba gang lags pa de la bdag cag a ba sa ṭha ⑥zhes mchis so༅/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong ma 'di la ni skad kyi nges pa'i tshig dang / yul gyi 33nges pa'i tshig dang / ljongs kyi nges pa'i tshig gis ltung ba med mod kyi/ 'on kyang nyes dmigs gang yin pa de thams cad gzhan gyi dngos po lhung ba yun ring du 'chang ba las gyur pa yin pas de lta bas na ⑨dge slong ngam/ dge slong mas gzhan gyi dngos po lhung ⑩ba yun ring du bcang bar mi bya ste/ 'chang na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong ngam dge slong mas gzhan gyi dngos po lhung ba 5—234

yun ring du bcang bar mi bya'o zhes gsungs nas/ dge slong zhig gis gzhan gyi ②dngos po lhung ba mthong nas 'di dge slong che ge mo zhig gi yin no zhes ngo ②shes nas dge slong de'i gnas khang du song ste dal bus khad kyis khad kyis chasgo gtan la brdungs ④pa dang / dge slong de ting nge 'dzin las langs nas smras pa / 'di su/ des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyi ⑤dngos po lhung ba 'di kho bos mthong gis long shig /des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa kho bo la dngos po de ma byin par len pa dag gis brkus par gyur pa ni bla'i/ kho bo khyod kyis ⑤ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan ma bzang po 'di 'dra ba las bslang ba ni ⑦ma yin no/ /dge slong de bdag la dge slong ting nge 'dzin las bslang bas ltung ba dang bcas par ma gyur tam snyam du 'gyod pa skyes nas/ des skabs de dge slong rnams la brjod nas/ dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong de la ni ltung ba med de/ yang dge slong gis dge slong don de'i phyir ting nge 'dzin las bslang bar mi bya bar 'di ltar de'i mngon sum du gzar phyathag la btags spute gzhag par bya'o/ /dge slong zhig gis gzhan gyi dngos po lhung cib mthong nas des 'di dge slong che ge mo zhig gi yin no zhes ngo shes nas des de khyer te dge slong de'i drung du song nas/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyi dngos po lhung ba 'di kho pos mthong gis long shig /dge slong de de la nang dang bcas pa yin pas smras payi/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyis 'di lhung ba mthong ba ma yin gyi 'di ltar khyod kyis 6rku sems kyis brkus so/ /dge slong de bdag ltung ba dang bcas par ma gyur tam snyam du 'gyod pa skyes par gyur nas/ des 8skabs de dge 5—235

slong rnams la brjod nas/ dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong de la ni ltung ba med mod kyi 'on kyang dge slong gis ①dge slong gi yo byad lhung ②ba mthong na dge skos ②la gtad par bya zhing / dge skos kyis ④kyang nyi ma gnyis sam / gsum du dge 'dune gyi nang du brim par bya zhing gal te ngo shes pa yod na ⑤gtad par bya'o/ /gal te med na dge 'dun gyis ci bder bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba 6)na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na dge slong ma rim zhes bya ba dgra bcom pa rnam par rgyal bar bya ba las rnam par rgyal ba zhig 'dug pa de la spos 'tshong ⑦gi khye'u zhig mngon par dad par gyur nas/ des de'i rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal te/ 'phags ma khyod la ci dang ci 'tshal ba de'i slad du bka' stsol cig dang thams cad bsgrub par bgyi'o ⑧zhes yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs pa dang / des kyang bzhin bzangs a rog gya ⑨de ltar bya'o zhes dang du blangs so/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na dge slong ma ri ma na bar gyur nas bsod snyoms la ma song zhing dge slong ma dag bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / spos 'tshong gi khye'u des de dag la phyag 'tshal te smras pa/'phags ma dag 'phags ma ri ma re zhig mi gda' na gar bzhud zhu'o/ /de dag gis smras pa/ bzhin bzangs thugs mi bde'o/ /des smras pa/ 'phags ma de la bdag gis yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs na des bdag la lan 'ga' yang cung zad kyang ma bslangs ⑩na de'i slad du gal te de la 'tshal ba 'ga' zhig mchis na spyon la snoms shig /de dag gis smras pa/ bzhin bzang ⑩a rog 5—236

gya ①de bzhin bya'o zhes smras te dong ngo / /des de bzhin lan gsum gyi bar du bstabs pa dang / de na gzhon nu ma zhig gis spos 'tshong gi khye'u 'di yang dang yang du stobs par byed na/ ci 'di'i yang dag par stobs pas stobs par byed dam/ 'on te rtog ②pas stobs par byed pa bgam par bya'o snyam du bsams nas des de la 'phags ma ri ma la 'bru mar dgos so zhes lhung bzed chung ngu phul ba dang / des de nyid la 'phral la btsir ba'i 'bru mar gyis lhung bzed chung ngu bkang ste byin nas smras pa/ 'phags ma gal te yang de ①'tshal ba cung zad mchisaX/ spyon la snoms ⑤sheg gzhon nu ma des bzhin bzangs a rog gya rjode ltar bya'o zhes smras te song nas/ des 'bru mar de dge slong ma ri ma'i lag pa'i bsku mnye dang / rkang pa'i bsku mnye ⑦dang / mgo dang lus kyi bsku mnye dang mar me'i 'bru mar du spyad ⑧do/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na dge slong ma ri ma nad sos te bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / spos 'tshong gi khye'u des mthong nas/ des phyag 'tshal te smras pa/ 'phags ma ha cang yun ring zhig gis ⑨mthong ngo / /des smras pa/ bu bdag 0bro 'tshal bar gyur to//'phags ma bdag gis yo byad 0thams cad kyis bstabs tson/ khyod kyi yan lag 8'ga' yang cung zad kyang bka' ma 0stsal nas/ 'di ltar 'phags ma gcig cig mchis te 'phags ma ri ma la 'bru mar 'tshal lo zhes mchis tunyenas/bdag gis de nyid kyi sug par 'bru mar 'phral la btsir bas lhung bzed chung ngu bkang ste stsal to/ /des smras pa/ a rog gya thonyem nongs so zhes smras te/song nas bsod snyoms brgyus 0te dbyar khang du phyin nas smras pa/ gzhon nu ma khyod yikyis kho mo'i ming gis spos 'tshong gi khye'u che ge mo yizhig las lan gcig ⑥5—237

'bru mar bslangs ①sam/ gzhon nu ma des smras pa/ 'phags ma bdag bsod snyoms la zhugs pa na des lan gsum gyi bar du 'phags ma ri ma la bdag gis yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs na/ des bdag la lan 'ga' ②yang cung zad kyang ma bslangs na/ gal te 'phags ma la 'tshal ba cung zad mchis na spyon la snoms shig ces mchi nasal/ bdag la 'di yang dang yang du stobs na ci 'di duyang dag par stobs pas stobs par bgyid dam/ 'on te rtog pas stobs par bgyid pa bgam mo snyam pa'i blo dubyung nas bdag gis de la 'phags ma ri ma la 'bru mar 'tshal lo zhes lhung bzed chung ngu phul ba dang / des 'bru mar gyis ①lhung bzed chung ngu bltam ste ༅stsal nas bdag gis des du'aphags ma'i phyag dang / zhabs dang / dbu dang / sku'i bsku mnye dang /zhugs mar gyi 'bru mar du spyad ①do/ /des smras pa/ ci kho mos khyod la lan ⑩'ga' zhig de'i gan du song la 'bru mar khyer te shog shig ces smras sam/ lan 'ga' yang ⑩bka' ma stsal to/ /de la nang dang bcas pa'i dge slong ma gzhan zhig gis smras pa/ 'phags ma ci 'di 'ga' zhig 4)tu bas snyam mam()/'dis 'phags ma ri ma rgyur bgyis te/ mnyan yod thams cad khyab par bgyis pas pham par gyur pa dag gis lto gang 8ngo / /dge slong ma de bdag la pham par 'gyur ba'i ltung 8ba ma byung ngam snyam du 'gyod pa skyes nas/ — des skabs de dge slong ma rnams la brjod do/ /dge slong ma rnams kyis dge slong rnams la brjod nas4)/ dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong ma de la rmas ⑩pa/ dge slong ma khyod kyis bsam pa ji lta bus 'bru mar bslangs8/ bcom ldan 'das bgam 5—238

pa'i bsams ①pas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong ma bgam pa'i bsam pa can 'di la ni ltung ba med de/ yang dge slong ngam/ dge slong mas nad pa la ma dris par sman sbyor du gzhug ②par mi bya bar 'di ltar dge 'dun gyi nad pa'i sman khang nas bslang bar ③bya ba'am/'on te dad pa can las sam/ nye du'am/① nye du mang ba nyid yin na yang gang sbyor du gzhug ces nad pa la dri bar bya zhing / des gang brjod pa de las bslang bar 0bya'o/ /dge slong ngam dge slong mas nad pa la ma dris par sman sbyor du 'jug dun/ 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba rgyan bzhugs ⑧so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal ①gyi bu chen po snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs yinas mthar gyis bsod snyoms la rgyu zhing khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi khyim ga la ba der song ngo / /de'i tshe na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi bu dag phyi 0rol gyi bstan bcos dag klog go/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi bu dag phyi rol gyi bstan bcos dag klog pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyim bdag khye'u dag ci klog /'phags pa slad rol gyi bstan bcos dag go/ /khyim bdag phyi rol gyi bstan bcos dag ni lcags kyi se'u ()dang 'dra ste rtogs par dka' zhing /rtogs na yang de dag gis yinges pa la 'jug par yang mi 'gyur/ zag pa zad par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi bka' 8ni thog ma dang / bar ma ⑫5—239

dang / tha mar dge ba/ mngon par ①shes pa dang / rdzogs par byang chub pa dang / mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba yin na ci'i phyir de mi klog /'phags pa sus de klog tu spyoṣ+ṭhakhri/ kho bos klog tu gzhug go/ /'phags pa ma nongs kyis klog tu stsol cig /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis khye'u de dag la smras pa/ khye'u dag 'phags pa'i drung du rgyal byed kyi tshal du deng la sangs rgyas kyi ②bka' klogs shig /khye'u de dag nyi ma re re zhing rgyan gyis bklubs ①te/ khye'u mngag gzhug pa dag gis yongs su bskor nas rgyal byed kyi tshal du dong ste/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po las dusangs rgyas kyi bka' bklag dupar brtsams so/ /mnyan yod na ston zla tha chungs kyi dugayon can zhes bya ba chom rkun pa dag gi kun tu spyod pa ni de dag dgag dbye byas ma thag tu shes ldan dag bdag cag gis ⑦las ci zhig byas na des brtsal ⑧mi dgos par lo skor 0du longs spyod cing bde bar 'khod par 'gyur zhes phan tshun gros byed do/ /de dag la khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi bu dag nyi ma re re zhing rgyan thams cad kyis bklubs 0te khye'u mngag gzhug pa dag gis bskor nas/rgyal byed kyi tshal du 'dong zhing 'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen po las yisangs rgyas kyi bka' klog par byed kyis lam gyi bar du bsdad de de dag bzung tson 'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos 0khye'u dag skyikhyim na 'khod do snyam du shes la/khyim bdag gis kyang 'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i drung na 'khod do snyam du shes pas gal te khye'u dag dbrog 8par nus na ni bdag cag gi 'tsho ba'i bar gyi 'tsho ba yod la/ ji ste ma nus na rgyan dbrog par byas te0/ des kyang bdag cag brtsal ()mi dgos par lo skor du longs 8spyod cing bde bar 'khod par 5—240

'gyur ro snyam pa'i blo skyes so/ /de dag brda ①byas te lam gyi bar du dong nas 'khod pa dang / khye'u de dag kyang rgyan thams cad kyis bklubs ②te 'ongs nas chom rkun ②pa de dag gis khye'u de dag khyer ro/ /khye'u de dag gi ④phyi bzhin khye'u mngag gzhug pa dag 'dong ba de dag gis khye'u de dag chom rkun pa dag gis brkus pa mthong nas de dag gis khyim bdag ⑤mgon med zas sbyin gyi drung du brgyugs te sbran pa/ khyim bdag khyod kyi yisras bu dag ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag gis brkus kyis ④thabs dgongs shig /khyim bdag mgon med zas phyin brgyugs te ko chas lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi gan du song nas smras pa/ lha bdag gi 0bu dag ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag gis phrogs kyis bu'i slong tho) mo stsal du gsol/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis rgyal bu gzhon nu 'phags skyes po la bsgo ba/ song ⑩la khyim bdag gi 8bu rnams dang chom rkun pa dag myur du khug shig /'phags skyes po yun ring po nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dang nang dang bcas par gyur pas de'i 6mod la ma song ngo / /de nas lha gang dag tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la mngon par dad pa de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa mkhyen par mdzod cig /khyod kyi nye gnas dag ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can cidag gis phrogs kyis brtson par mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos gal te khye'u dag la ma bsams na/ re zhig khye'u dag pha ma dang bral ba las byung ba'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur zhing pha ma dag kyang bu dang bral ba las byung ba'i sdug bsngal 8nyams su myong bar 'gyur la/ ma dad pa dag gis kyang glags rnyed par 'gyur zhing /5—241

dad pa rnams kyang 'di ltar dong ngo cog ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag gis ①'phrog par byed na/ phyin chad su zhig rgyal byed kyi tshal du 'gro bar 'gyur zhes gzhan du gyur pa nyid du 'gyur gyis bdag gis rdzu 'phrul rnam par bstan par bya'o snyam du bsams shing rig nas/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos rdzu 'phrul gyis 'phags skyes po'i dpung mngon par sprul te/ phyogs bzhir rnga pa ṭa ha brdungs pa dang / ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag gis shes ldan dag bdag cag dmag dpon 'phags skyes pos phyogs bzhi nas bskor 0gyis zin par gyur na mi rung gis bor la 'dong ngo snyam du bsams nas de dag gis khye'u de dag bor te byer ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos kyang rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba de phyir brtul zhunas lam dang nye bar shing ljon pa'i drung du 'dug go/ /khye'u de dag kyang 'ongs pa dang / 'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos smras pa/ khye'u dag khyed cag gar dong dong / 'phags pa bdag cag ston zla tha chungs kyi cogayon can dag gis brkus so/ /'o na sus ⑤thar bar byas/ dmag dpon 'phags skyes pos so/ /khye'u dag de ring khyed cag gi /skupa ma dag yid mi bde bar 'khod kyis deng la sang lhogs shig /khye'u de dag khyim du 'phags pa dang / dmag dpon 'phags skyes po yang dpung gi ⑦tshogs yan lag bzhi pa glang po che pa'i tshogs dang / rta pa'i tshogs dang /shing rta pa'i tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi tshogs go bskon te mnyan yod nas byung ngo / /'phags skyes pos khye'u de dag mthong nas smras pa/ khye'u dag khyed cag gar dong dong / de dag gis smras pa/ rgyal byed kyi tshal du 'dong ba na bdag cag ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag gis brkus so/ /'o na khyed cag 5—242

sus thar bar byas/ dmag dpon 'phags skyes pos so/ /'phags skyes pos bdag da ltar 'gro bas bdag gis ji ltar 'di dag thar bar byas/ 'phags pa rdzu 'phrul che ba/ mthu che ba 'ga' zhig gis 'di dag ①thar bar byas gor ma chag snyam du bsams shing rig nas smras pa/ khye'u dag khyed cag gis phyogs de na su mthong / 'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'o/ /'phags skyes pos ②des 'di dag thar bar byas kyi gzhan su zhig ②gis nus snyam du bsams shing rig nas yid dga' zhing yid dga' nas bdag cag gi ⑦yul na 'phags pa de ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba/ de ltar ⑤mthu che ba tshe 'di'i don dang / tshe phyi ma'i don dang / tshe 'di dang tshe phyi ma'i don la skyabs mdzad pa bzhugs pa de 4ni bdag cag gis rnyed pa legs par rnyed ⑦do zhes ched du brjod pa ched du rjod ⑧par byed do/ /de bsngags pa ⑨brjod cing mnyan yod du 'jug pa na drug sde dag kyang phyir byung byazhing drug sde dag gis smras pa/ khyod su'i bsngags pa brjod/'phags skyes pos smras pa/ khyed kyi'o/ /nged kyis ci byas/ 'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi bu dag ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag gis phrogs yipa thar bar byas so/ /bkren pa dag kho bo cag de 'dra 8yang 'on kyang 'di na la la byi bo gcer bu dag la mngon par dad de/ gal te gcer bu dag gis mthong bar gyur du zin na/ de dag gis lam yang nye bar bstan par 'gyur ro/ /de dag cang mi smra bar 'khod pa dang / drug sde dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' de dag la go bar byas sol/ /don nyung ngu la ltung ba byung gis dong la 'chags su gzhug 'go/ /drug sde dag gtsug lag khang du dong ste zas kyi bya ba byas nas rgan rims kyis phyag 5—243

'tshal te/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ga la ①ba der dong nas phyin pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gnas brtan ②phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag a rog gya ②gnas brtan je skabs phye shig /ltung ba sde lnga po dag la skabs phye'o/ /gnas brtan gyis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi ④bu dag ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag gis phrogs pa thar bar bgyis ⑤sam/ de bzhin te thar bar byas so/ /gnas brtan bdag cag gis gnas brtan go/ /bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde ba dag nyams su myong bar mdzad cing bzhugs par 'tshal gyi skyobadag cag gis thugs rje phyogs gcig pa dang ldan zhing nye gnas la thugs rje bar mdzad la ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag la thugs rje bar mi mdzad par rtsom 'tshal to/ /gzhan dag gis bdag gir bgyis pa'i nor dag thar bar bgyis pa'i ltung ba duchos bzhin du slar mdzod cig /ltung ba ma mthong ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis ltung ba ma mthong ba'i phyir gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya'o//zhes gsungs kyis khang skyong su snang gaṇ+ḍi rdungs 6shig /'di gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya'o/ /zhes khang skyong gi cigan du dong nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gaṇ+ḍi rdungs nyunyeshig /ci'i phyir tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ltung ba byung ba 8chos bzhin du phyir mi byed pas/ de gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya'o//de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan byed cing bstan pa la chos kyi sgyu thabs kyis mi mthun pa 'ga' mi 'byung ngam zhes kun du spyod pa'i chos rmed par byed pas des khang skyong la rmas 8pa/ tshe dang ldan pa su zhig 5—244

yongs su gnas pa'am/ gzhi 3nas yongs su gnas pa'am/ mgu bar bya ba'am / gzhi nas mgu bar bya ba'am/ 'byin par byed/ gnas brtan su yang mi bgyid de/ 'di ltar tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ltung ba byung ba chos bzhin slar mi bgyid pas de ltung ba ma mthong ba'i slad du gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bgyid do/ /tshe dang ldan pa dge slong gnas brtan la tho ma 'tsham par 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di thams cad mkhyen pa/thams cad gzigs pa/ mkhyen pa dang shes bya dag la bla na med pa'i mnga' brnyes 4pa/ the tshom thams cad gcod par mdzad pa yin gyi 5de'i gan du song la zhus shig dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis khyed cag la ji skad lung ston par mdzad pa de de bzhin du zung 6shig /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed pa yin pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal snye pa/ mod gal gyi bu khyed kyis/ 8bsam pa ji lta bus rdzu 'phrul rnam par bstan btsun pa bdag 'di snyam bgyid de/ gal te khye'u dag la ma bsams na re zhig khye'u dag pha ma dang bral ba las byung ba'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur zhing / pha ma dag kyang bu dang bral ba las byung ba'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur la/ ma dad pa dag gis kyang glags ri rnyed par 'gyur zhing / dad pa rnams kyang 'di ltar dong ngo cog ston zla tha chungs kyi ri g.yon can dag gis 'phrogs sapar byed na/ phyin chad su zhig rgyal byed kyi satshal du 'gro bar 'gyur zhes gzhan du skye'agyur gyis/ bdag gis rdzu 'phrul rnam par bstan par bgyi'o snyam du bsams so/ /bcom ldan 'das 5—245

kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mod gal gyi bus bsam pa de lta bus rdzu 'phrul 3rnam par bstan pa la ltung ba med do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na ci 'od ma'i tshal ka lan da ku'i gnas na bzhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa pi yin da'i bu snga dro shams ci thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos 4thogs te/ rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la zhugs nas mthar gyis bsod snyoms la rgyu zhing dmag 5pa'i khyim ga la ba der song ngo / /de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu'i tsha bo 6dag phyi rol gyi 7bstan bcos dag klog go/ /tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bus tsha bo dag phyi rol gyi bstan bcos dag klog par — mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang dmag / pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tsha bo khye'u dag ci klog /'phags pa slad rol gyi bstan bcos dag go/ /tsha bo phyi rol gyi bstan bcos dag ni lcags kyi se'u dang 'dra ste rtogs par dka' zhing rtogs na yang de dag gis nges pa la 'jug par yang mi 'gyur/ zag pa zad par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi bka' ni thog ma dang / bar ma 5dang / tha mar dge ba/mngon par shes pa dang / rdzogs par byang chub pa dang / mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba yin na ci'i phyir de mi klog /'phags pa sus de klog du stsol/kho bos klog tu gzhug 7go/ /'phags pa ma nongs kyis klog tu stso(5 cig /dmag ri capa des khye'u de dag la smras pa/ khye'u dag 'phags pa'i drung du 'od ma'i tshal du deng la sangs rgyas kyi ci bka' lhogs shig /khye'u de dag nyi ma re re zhing rgyan gyis bklubs 1 te khye'u mngag gzhug pa dag gis yongs su bskor nas 'od ma'i tshal du dong ste/ tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu las sangs rgyas kyi kye 5—246

bka' bklag ①par brtsams so/ /rgyal po'i khab na ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can zhes bya ba chom rkun pa dag gis ②kun tu spyod pa ni de dag dgag dbye byas ma thag tu shes ldan dag bdag cag gis las ci zhig byas na/ des brtsal mi dgos par lo skor du longs spyod cing bde bar 'khod par 'gyur zhes phan tshun gros byed do/ /de dag la 'phags pa 0pi yin da'i bu'i tsha bo dag nyi ma re re zhing rgyan thams cad ④kyis bklubs ⑤te/ khye'u mngag gzhug pa dag gis bskor nas 'od ma'i tshal ༅du 'dong zhing 'phags pa pi lin da'i bu las sangs rgyas kyi ⑦bka' klog par byed kyis lam gyi ⑧bar du bsdad de/ de dag bzung ⑨na 'phags pa pi lin da'i bus ni khye'u dag khyim na 'khod do snyam du shes la/bram zes kyang 'phags pa pi lin da'i bu'i drung na 'khod do snyam du shes pas/gal te khye'u dag dbrog par nus na ni bdag cag gi ⑨ 'tsho ba'i bar gyi skye'atsho ba yod la/ ci ste ma nus na ni rgyan dbrog par bya ste/ des kyang bdag cag btsal 8mi dgos par lo skor 'du longs spyod cing bde bar 'khod par 'gyur ro snyam pa'i blo skyes so/ /de dag brda byas te lam gyi bar du dong nas 'khod pa dang / khye'u de dag kyang rgyan thams cad kyis bklubs cete 'ongs nas chom rkun pa de dag gis khye'u de dag grur bcug ste khyer ro/ /khye'u de dag gi ④phyi bzhin khye'u mngag gzhug pa dag 'dong ba de dag gis khye'u de dag chom rkun pa dag gis brkus pa mthong nas/ de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu'i dmag ⑩pa'i drung du brgyugs te sbran pa/ jo bo khyod kyi sras bu dag ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag gis brkus kyi ༅thabs dgongs shig /bram ze yang brgyugs te/ ma ga d+mar byung ba'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po'i 5—247

gan du song nas smras pa/ lha bdag gi ①bu dag ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag gis phrogs kyis bu'i slong 0mo lcal du gsol/ rgyal po gzugs can snying pos rgyal bu chagazhon nu ma skyes dgra la bsgo ④ba/ song ⑤la bram ze'i bu rnams dang / chom rkun pa dag myur du khug shig⑥ /ma skyes dgra yun ring po nas bram ze de dang / nang ⑦dang bcas par gyur pas de'i mod la ma song ngo / /de nas ⑧lha gang dag tshe dang ldan pa pi lin ⑨da'i bu la mngon par dad pa de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa mkhyen ⑩par mdzod cig /khyod kyi tsha bo dag ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag gis phrogs kyis 7brtson par mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bus gal te khye'u dag la ma bsams na/ re zhig khye'u dag pha tsom dang bral ba las byung ba'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur zhing / pha ma dag kyang bu dang bral ba las byung ba'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur la/ ma dad pa dag gis kyang glags rnyed par 'gyur 8zhing / dad pa rnams kyang 'di ltar dong ngo cog ston zla /) tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag gis 'phrogs 6par byed na/phyin chad su zhig 'od ma'i tshal du 'gro bar 'gyur zhes gzhan du gyur pa nyid du 'gyur gyis bdag gis rdzu 'phrul rnam par bstan par bya'o snyam du sems ⑩shing rig nas/ tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu 0rdzu 'phrul gyis song ste gru'i drung du 'dug pa dang gru de 8mi 'gul bar 'dug go/ /com rkun pa dag gis ci'i phyir gru 'di mi 'gul bar 'dug ༅snyam du bsams pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu gru dang nye ba na 'dug pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa ci'i slad du tho 0'tsham par 5—248

mdzad / rga ba'i chos can dag kho bo 'ba' zhig tho ①'tsham par byed dam/gal te kho bos yon tan gyi ༅tshogs 'di lta bu rtogs par ma gyur du zin na deng khyed kyi ③kho bo'i tsha bo dag brkus par mi 'gyur ram/ 'phags pa gtang du gsol deng shig /tshe dang ldan pa pi yin da'i bus rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba de dag phyir brtul ④nas khye'u de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khye'u dag de ring khyed cag gi ⑤pa ma dag yid mi bde bar 'khod kyis/ deng la sang lhogs shig /khye'u de dag khyim du 'phags pa dang / gzhon nu ma skyes dgra yang dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa glang po che pa'i tshogs dang / rta pa'i tshogs dang / shing rta pa'i tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi yotshogs go bskon te rgyal po'i khab nas byung ngo / /ma skyes dgras khye'u de dag mthong nas smras pa/khye'u dag khyed cag gar dong dong / de dag gis smras pa/ 'od ma'i tshal du 'dong ba na bdag cag ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag gis brkus so/ /'o na khyed cag sus thar bar byas/ 'phags pa pi lin da'i bus so/ /ma skyes dgra yid dga' zhing yid dga' nas bdag cag gi ⑦yul na 'phags pa de ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba/ de ltar mthu che ba/ tshe 'di'i don dang / tshe phyi ma'i don dang / tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i don la skyabs mdzad pa bzhugs pa ni bdag cag gis rnyed pa legs par rnyed do zhes ched du brjod pa duched du rjod ⑨par byed do//des tshubasngags pa brjod 0cing rgyal po'i khab tu 'jug pa la 8drug sde dag kyang phyir byung 8zhing drug sde dag gis smras pa/ khyod su'i bsngags pa brjod/ ma skyes dgras smras pa/ khyed ④kyi'o/ /nged kyis ci byas/ 'phags pa pi lin da'i bus bram ze'i bu dag ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon 8can dag gis phrogs pa 5—249

thar bar byas so/ /bkren pa dag kho bo cag de 'dra yang 'on kyang 'di na la la byi bo gcer bu dag la mngon par dad de/ gal te gcer bu dag gis mthong bar gyur du zin na/ de dag gis lam yang nye bar bstan par 'gyur ro/ /de dag cang mi smra bar 'khod pa dang / drug sde dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' de dag la go bar byas so/ /don nyung ngu la ltung ba byung gis dong la 'chags ①su gzhug go/ /drug sde dag gtsug lag khang du dong ②ste zas kyi bya ba byas nas largan rims kyis phyag 'tshal te/ tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu ga la ba ④der dong nas phyin pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gnas brtan che/phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag ⑥a rog gya zhuganas brtan je duskabs phye shig /ltung ba sde lnga po dag la skabs phye'o//gnas brtan gyis bram ze'i bu dag ston zla tha chungs kyi ⑨g.yon can dag gis phrogs pa thar bar bgyis sam/ de bzhin te mthar bar byas so/ /gnas brtan bdag cag gis gnas brtan go bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde ba dag nyams su myong bar mdzad cing bzhugs par 'tshal gyis7/ bdag cag gis thugs rje phyogs gcig pa dang ldan zhing bram ze'i bu dag la thugs rje bar mdzad la/ston zla tha chungs kyi 8g.yon can dag la thugs rje bar mi mdzad par ma 'tshal to//gzhan dag gis bdag gir bgyis pa'i nor dag thar bar bgyis pa'i ltung ba byung ba chos bzhin du slar tsomadzod cig /ltung ba ma mthong ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis ltung ba ma mthong ba'i phyir gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya'o zhes gsungs kyis 8khang skyong su snang gaṇ+ḍi rdungs 8shig /'di gnas 5—250

nas dbyung ba'i las bya'o zhes khang skyong gi gan du dong nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gaṇ+ḍi rdungs ①shig /ci'i phyir tshe dang ldan pa pi yin da'i bu ltung ba byung ba chos bzhin du phyir mi byed pas de gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya'o/ /de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan byed cing bstan pa la chos kyi 0sgyu thabs kyis ①mi mthun pa 'ga' mi 'byung ngam zhes kun tu spyod pa'i chos rmed par byed pas des khang skyong ④la rmas ⑤pa/ tshe dang ldan pa su zhig ⑥yongs su gnas pa'am/ gzhi ⑦nas yongs su gnas pa'am/ mgu bar bya ba'am / gzhi nas mgu bar bya ba'am/ 'byin par byed/ gnas brtan su yang mi bgyid de/ 'di ltar tshe dang ldan pa pi yin da'i bu ltung ba byung ba chos bzhin du slar mi bgyid pas/ de ltung ba ma mthong ba'i slad du gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bgyid do/ /tshe dang ldan pa dge slong duganas brtan la tho ⑨ma 'tsham rmye par 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di mthams cad mkhyen pa / thams cad gzigs pa/ mkhyen pa dang shes bya dag la bla na med pa'i mnga' brnyes zhu)pa/ the tsom nyu)thams cad gcod par mdzad pa yin gyis/de'i gan du song la zhus shig dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis khyed cag la ji skad lung ston tu)par mdzad pa de de bzhin du zung shig(sme /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni ⑩mkhyen bzhin du rmed 0pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa pi yin da'i bu la bka' stsal 8pa/ pi lin da'i bu khyod kyis bsam pa ji lta bus rdzu 'phrul rnam par bstan/ btsun pa bdag yi'adi snyam bgyid de/ gal te khye'u dag la ma bsams na re zhig khye'u dag ⑥ pha ⑥ma dang 5—251

bral ba las byung ba'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur zhing pha ma dag kyang bu dang bral ba las byung ba'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur la/ ma dad pa dag gis kyang glags ⑨rnyed par 'gyur zhing / dad pa rnams kyang 'di ltar dong ngo cog ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag gis phrogs ②par byed na/phyin chad ②su zhig 'od ma'i tshal du 'gro bar 'gyur zhes gzhan du ④gyur pa nyid du 'gyur gyis/ bdag gis rdzu 'phrul rnam par bstan par bgyi'o snyam du bsams so / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag pi lin da'i bus bsam ⑤pa de lta bus rdzu 'phrul rnam par bstan pa la ltung ba med do// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po bdun pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal ka lan da ku'i gnas na bzhugs so/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i kun tu spyod pa ni nyi ma re re zhing bcom ldan 'das dang ⑥/ dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal du 'gro'o/ /ji tsam mdus gzhan zhig na/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po bcom ldan 'das kyi duzhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spuspyan sngar 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das ma ga ṅgār byung ba'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po skyo mtha' gcig ༅tu 'dug pa la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod ④par mdzad / yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/ rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcugatso /yang dag par gzengs bstodabya/ yang dag par rab tu dga' 5—252

bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo / /de nas ma ga ṅgār byung ba'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po bcom ldan 'das kyi ①zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas stan las langs te song nas/ tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu'i gtsug lag khang ga la ba ②der song ngo / /de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu gtsug lag khang de na charal ba dang 'drums pa rang nyid kyis phyir 'chos par byed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bus ma ga d+mar byung ba'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po thag ring po kho na nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang lag pa dang / rkang pa dag bkrus te stan ④bshams pa nyid la 'dug go/ /de nas ma ga ṅgār byung ba'i rgyal po bzo ⑤sbyangs gzugs can snying po ⑥ tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu'i rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig ⑦tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas ma ga d+mar byung ba'i rgyal po bzo dusbyangs gzugs can snying pos tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu la 'di skad ces ⑨smras so/ /'phags pa ci lags / rang nyid kyis ⑩ral ba dang 'drums pa slar 'chos par mdzad dam/rgyal po chen po rab tu byung ba ni rang nyid kyis byed pa yin te/ bdag cag ni rab tu byung ba yin pas gzhan su zhig byed par 'gyur/ 'phags pa gal te de lta na bdag gis 'phags pa la zhabs 'bring 7ba dbul lo/ /rgyal po chen po a rog gya 8de bzhin du tsolan bzhi'i bar du smras nas/ lan 8lnga pa la yang de kho na skad du bdag gis 'phags pa la zhabs 'bring tsob dbul lo zhes zer ba dang /tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu'i lhan cig gnas pa bden pa dang / mthun pa dang / do zlog phod ⑩par smra ba zhig gis smras pa/ rgyal po chen po gang tshun cad ⑩nas rgyal po chen pos mkhan po la zhabs 'bring ba tsodag gis bstabs pa 5—253

nas mkhan pos gal te gtsug lag khang 'di yal bar bor du lags na da ①tsam ngos rdib par yang gyur to/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ 'phags pa ci lags bdag cag ②gis yang dang yang du ②khas blangs sam/ rgyal po chen po lan gcig ④cu ma bas kyi 'di ltar 'di ni lan lnga pa lags so/ /rgyal po de brjed ngas pas rgyal po de'i kun tu spyod pa ni gang yang rung ba la chung ༅zad khas blangs pa ci yang rung ste/ de thams cad phyi na 'dug pa'i mis yi ger 'dri bar byed pas rgyal po des mi de la smras pa/ kwa'e yinang rje kho bos yang dang yang du khas blangs pa bden nam/ lha mad de 'di ni lan ⑤lnga pa lags so/ /de lta na kho bo chad pa'i las la thug gis ②kho bos 'phags pa la zhabs 'bring ⑨ba lnga brgya dbul lo/ /des blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ 'phags pa la zhabs 'bring ⑩ba lnga brgya phul cig /tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bus smras pa/ rgyal po chen po kho bo rang gi g.yog nyid spangs te rab tu byung ba la g.yog dag gis ci bya/'phags pa dge 'dun gyi don du bzhes shig /rgyal po chen po gal te de lta na bcom ldan 'das la zhu'o/ /'phags pa de ma nongs kyis zhus shig /skabs de tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bus bcom ldan 'das la rgyas 7par gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi don du g.yog dag blang bar bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bus g.yog de dag blangs pa dang /g.yog de dag yang dang yang du rgyal po'i pho brang du las byed du bcug nas/ de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i 8bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag cag 'phags pa dag gi zhabs 'bring tsobar phul ba ni/ bdag cag glo ⑫ba dga' na ci'i slad du bdag cag yang dang yang du rgyal po'i pho brang du sug 5—254 ci

las bgyid/ bzhin bzangs dag 'khrug long ①ma byed cig dang / kho bos rgyal po la ②gsol bar ②bya'o/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na ma ga ṅgār byung ba'i rgyal po bzo ⑤sbyangs gzugs can snying po yang tshe dang ldan pa pi yin da'i bu'i ⑤drung du 'ongs te rkang pa la phyag 'tshal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu'i mdun du 'dug pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa pi yin da'i bus smras pa/ rgyal po chen po khyod dge 'dun gyi ༅don du g.yog dag ⑦phul bas 'gyod par ma gyur tam/'phags pa bdag dul 'gyod pa 'ga' yang ma mchis so/ /'o na ci'i phyir g.yog de dag yang rgyal po'i pho brang du las byed du bcug /rgyal pos stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du blon po rnams la ⑨bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag 'phags pa rnams kyi zhabs 'bring ⑩ba dag phyin cad rgyal po'i 7pho brang du las byed du ma gzhug shig ⑫ /blon po rnams kyis gang yang rung ba dag la rgyal po'i pho brang du las gyis shig ces bsgo ba na/ de dag na re cibadag cag 'phags pa dag gi yin no zhes zer nas/ blon po rnams kyis rgyal po la smras pa/ lha gang la yang mchid stsal bar rngo ma thog ste/ gang yang rung ba dag la rgyal po'i pho brang du sug las tshol cig cices bgyis na8 / de dag bdag cag 'phags pa rnams kyi tshulags so zhes mchi'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ song la thams cad las byed du chug shig3) /de dag thams cad yang 6)rgyal po'i pho brang du las byed du bcug nas/ de dag gis yang tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu la smras pa/'phags pa bdag cag yang yide kho na bzhin du rgyal po'i pho brang du sug las bgyid du stsal du na/ 'phags pas 0ma gsol tam/ bzhin bzangs dag gsol te/ yang gsol ba bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bus ma ga dhar 5—255

byung ba'i rgyal po bzo ①sbyangs gzugs can snying po yang de kho na bzhin 'ongs pa la smras pa/ rgyal po chen po ②ci lags/ khyod yang ③'gyod pa skyes par gyur tam / 'phags pa ci nongs/ g.yog dag ④yang de kho na bzhin du las byed du bcug ⑤gi/ /'phags pa gang la yang mchid stsal bar rngo ma thog ste/ gang yang rung ba la mchid stsal ba na de dag bdag cag 'phags pa dag gi ⑥lags so zhes mchi'o/ /e ⑦ma 'phags pa dag gi lha 'bangs kyi sdum pa logs shig tu rtsig ⑧ku stsal na/ 'di dag ni rgyal po'i 'o/ /'di dag ni 'phags pa dag gi'o / /zhes 'tshal bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa pi yin da'i bus smras pa/bcom ldan 'das la zhu'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bus don de bcom ldan 'das la rgyas par gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa ⑨/ de lta bas na lha 'bangs kyi sdum pa rtsig tu 'jud ⑩par rjes su gnang ngo / /dge slong dag gis gnas gang du lha 'bangs kyi sdum pa cig tu gzhug pa ⑪mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po'i pho brang gi phyi tho)rol dang / 'od ma'i tshal gyi phyi rol gyi 6bar gang du skad kyis bos pa thos nas dge 'dun gyi don sgrub par 'gyur ba der lha 'bangs kyi sdum pa rtsig ④ tu gzhug go/ /dge slong rnams kyis zhang blon 8dag la bsgo ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis phyogs 'dir ⑩lha 'bangs kyi sdum pa rtsig 0tu chug shig 8ces bka' stsal gyis de khyed cag gis ⑩shes par gyis shig / zhang blon chadag gis rgyal po'i khab tu dril gyi 0sgra sgrog tu bcug ste/ gang dag 'phags pa rnams kyi zhabs 'bring dub yin pa de dag rgyal po'i khab kyi phyi rol dang / 'od ma'i tshal gyi phyi rol gyi bar du 'dug par chad kyis deng tsol der sdum pa rtsigs ④shig ces 5—256

bsgo nas/ de dag der dong ste sdum pa brtsigs ①so/ /lha 'bangs kyi sdum pa brtsigs ②nas de dag gtsug lag khang du dong ste las byed cing / dge slong rnams kyis de dag la las 'di ni rung ba yin gyis khyed kyis bya'o/ /'di ni rung ba ma yin gyis khyed kyis mi bya'o zhes ③las bstan nas/ de dag las rung ba byed pas lha 'bangs lha 'bangs zhes bya ba'i ming du gyur to④/ /dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ⑤ra ba skyong bar byed pas rtse rgod ༅rtse rgod ces bya ba'i ⑦ming du gyur to/ /de dag thams cad gtsug lag khang du 'jug pas klag ⑧cor gyi sgras dge slong dag gis sems rtse gcig pa nyid mi sgrub ⑨nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ji snyed dag gis las 'grub pa de snyed 'jug par bya'i ⑨ thams cad mi bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis de dag thams cad la zas dang gos sbyin par byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang dag las byed pa de dag la zas dang gos sbyin par bya'i thams cad la mi bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis de dag na ba yal bar bor nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/⑪gang dag na ba de dag la zas dang gos sbyin par bya zhing bsnyen 8bkur yang bya'o//ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na nye dga' dge skos 8byed pas des lha 'bangs de dag la smras pa/ bzhin bzangs dag kho bo dge skos 8byed kyis khyed cag nang par sngar shog shiga' /rgyal po'i khab na ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can zhes bya ba chom rkun pa dag gis tsokun tu spyod pa 8de dag dgag dbye byas ma thag tu shes ldan dag bdag cag gis las ci zhig tsobyas na des btsal ⑩mi dgos par lo skor 0du longs spyod cing bde bar gnas par 'gyur zhes phan tshun gros byed do/ /de na dge slong gi 0rgyus shes pa cig cha'adug pa des smras pa/ shes ldan dag 5—257

'phags pa dag gi ①g.yog gang dag grong khyer gyi ②phyi rol na 'khod pa de dag gzhom par bya'o/ /gzhan dag gis smras pa/ re zhig de dag gi jo bo chagang dag yin pa de dag kyang sgo 'phar brgya snyed bzla ba ④byas kyang lto khengs pa 'grub par dka' ⑤bas de dag la yang ⑥cung zad kyang med na de dag gi ⑦g.yog de dag lta ⑧spros kyang ci dgos/ dge slong gi ①rgyus shes pa des smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed mi shes te/ de dag ni zan gzhan las za zhing rang gi las rjes su sgrub 0pa de lhur len te/ thabs du ma dag gis nor sgrub par byed pas de dag la yigang yod pa de ni grong khyer 'di na yang med kyis cung zhig cigazhom par bya'o / /de dag gis brda byas te dong nas de dag gzhom par brtsams so/ /de nas lha gang dag tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu la mngon par dad pa de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa mkhyen par mdzod cig /khyed kyi zhabs 'bring 8ba dag ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag gis 'joms tsu )par 'gyur gyis brtson par mdzad du gsol/tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bus gal te g.yog dag la ma bsams na g.yog dag kyang re zhig nor dang bral ba las byung ba'i tsunyesdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur la/ ma dad pa rnams kyis kyang glags rnyed par 'gyur zhing dad pa rnams kyang 'di ltar sbyin par bya ba'i chos byin 7pa dag yongs su skyong bar mi byed na/ phyin chad su zhig shākya'i sras kyi dge slong ⑩rnams la sbyin pa dang bya bar sems shes tsogazhan du gyur pa nyid du 'gyur gyis/ rdzu 'phrul rnam par bstan par bya'o snyam du bsams shing rig nas/ tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bus lha 'bangs kyi ༅sdum pa de lcags kyi ra bas bskor to/ /chom rkun pa dag 5—258

gis rkun rdzas thogs te 'phags pa dang / lcags kyi ra ba mthong nas de dag gis phan tshun kun tu 'gro bar brtsams na lam ma rnyed do/ /de dag gis rkun ①rdzas bor te 'phags pa dang / lcags ②kyi ra ba de yang mi snang bar gyur gto/ /de dag gis yang rkun rdzas blangs pa dang / lcags kyi ra ba de yang yang ④phyir byung ste/ lan bdun ⑤gyi bar du de ltar gyur pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/shes ldan dag 'phags pa rdzu 'phrul che ba/ mthu che ⑥ba 'ga' zhig gis 'di dag la dgongs pa 'dras rkun 0rdzas bor la bros ⑧par bya'o/ /de dag gis rkun 0rdzas phyogs gcig tu bor te bros so/ /lha 'bangs de dag sad pa dang /shes ldan dag bdag cag bcom mo/ /bdag cag bcom mo zhes ku co 'don cing ⑨ de dag nor dang bral ba las byung ba'i yid mi bde ba 0dang ldan zhing thams cad 'dus nas lha 'bangs kyi sdum ④pa kun tu byul 8bar brtsams pa dang /phyogs gcig na hu rdzas thams cad spungs te bzhag pa mthong ngo / /de nas dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes te rang rang gi cirdzas blangs tsonas khyim khyim du dong ngo / /de dag gis so so'i khyim srung ba bzhag ste ⑩/ gnyid log pa na lha des de dag gi rmi tsolam du sbran pa/ shes ldan tsodag khyed cag ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag gis ma bcom pa 'di dag m+mu thams cad ni 'phags pa pi lin da'i bu'i mthu yin no/ /de nas mtshan mo nam nangs ⑥pa dang / thams cad 'dus te smras ⑤pa/ shes ldan dag lhas rmi lam du khyed cag ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon ④can dag gis ma bcom pa 'di dag thams cad ni 'phags pa pi lin da'i bu'i mthu yin no zhes bstan to④/ /de ni de kho na bzhin yin gyis zhugazhan du na 'phags pa pi lin da'i bu ma gtogs par zhugazhan su zhig chabadag cag la 5—259

snying rje bar 'gyur/ de'i tshe de dag je ①byi dor byas la phyis gtsug lag khang du 'dong ngo ②zhes de dag khrus byas shing gos dkar po dang / dri dang / phreng ba rgyus ②brgyan te/ byi dor byas te gtsug lag khang du dong ngo / /nye dga' yang nang par sngar langs nas lde mig dang lde mig kyog po thogs nas gtsug lag khang gi sgo phye ste/ mar me'i kong bu bsal nas gtsug lag khang du ⑤chag chag dang byug pa byas te/ gnas mal bshams nas mchod rten gyi 'khor ⑤sar bdug spos brims nas khang steng du 'dzegs te/ gaṇ+ḍi ༅rdung zhing phyogs bzhir rnam par lta'o༅/ /des de dag ②gos dkar po dang / dri dang / phreng ba rgyus ⑨brgyan pa dag ⑩mthong nas/ de 'di dag nor can dag gam/ tshong dpon dag gamatho)/ ded dpon gtsug lag khang ltar 'ong ba su zhig yin snyam du sems so/ /gang gi tshe mchod rten gyi 'khor sar zhugs ④pa de'i tshe des de dag ngo shes nas nye dga'as gshe zhing smras pa/ ngas khyed cag la sang nang par sngar shog shig 8ces ma bsgo 'am theste/ khyed gar dong dong / de dag gis smras pa/'phags pa gal te bdag cag la 'phags pa pi lin da'i bus ma dgongs su lags na/ bdag cag deng 8kho nar ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag gis tshul ma lags pas/ sdug bsngal bsgrubs par 'gyur ro/ /nye dga'as tshugashe zhing smras pa/ khyed cag re zhig gang gi mthus snyems ⑩pa de la yang je khrims bca' bar bya'o zhes rig nas drug sde dag sbran 8te/ tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu ga la ba ⑩der dong ⑦ nas phyin pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa pi yin ⑥da'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gnas brtan la 'phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag a rog gya 3/ gnas brtan je chaskabs phye shig /ltung ba sde lnga po dag la 5—260

skabs phye'o/ /gnas brtan gyis ba ① zhabs 'bring ②ba dag gi nor ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag gis brkus pa thar bar bgyis dusam/ de bzhin te thar bar ④byas so/ /gnas brtan bdag cag gis gnas brtan go/ /bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyom ⑤par 'jug pa dag gi ⑥bde ba nyams su myong bar mdzad cing bzhugs par 'tshal gyi༅/bdag cag ⑤gis thugs rje phyogs gcig pa dang ldan zhing zhabs 'bring ⑨ba dag la thugs rje bar mdzad la/ ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag la mi mdzad par ma 'tshal tormya/ /gzhan ⑩ dag gis tsobadag gir 8bgyis pa'i nor dag thar bar bgyis pa'i ltung ba byung ba chos bzhin du slar mdzod cig /ltung ba ma mthong ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis ltung ba ma mthong ba'i phyir gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya'o zhes gsungs kyis/ khang skyong su snang / gaṇ+ḍi rdungs ④shig /'di gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya'o zhes de dag khang skyong gi drung du 8dong nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gaṇ+ḍi rdungs ⑩shig /ci'i phyir don nyung ngu la ltung ba byung ba chos bzhin du phyir mi 'chos pas de gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya'o/ /de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan byed cing bstan pa la chos kyi sgyu thabs kyis mi mthun pa 'ga' 'byung bar mi 'gyur ram zhes kun tu spyod pa'i chos rmed ⑩par byed pas des khang skyong la rmas phyepa/ tshe dang ldan pa su zhig yongs su gnas pa'am/ gzhi ⑩nas yongs su gnas pa'am/ mgu bar bya ba'am/ gzhi nas mgu bar du bya ba'am / 'byin par byed/ su yang mi bgyid de/ 'di ltar tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu ltung ba byung ba chos bzhin du slar mi bgyid pa de 0ltung ba ma 35—261

mthong ba'i slad du gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bgyid do/ /tshe dang ldan pa dge slong gnas brtan la tho ①ma 'tsham par ②'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di thams cad mkhyen pa/ thams cad gzigs pa/ mkhyen pa dang shes bya dag la bla na med pa'i mnga' brnyes ④pa/ the tshom thams cad gcod par mdzad pa yin gyis de'i gan du deng la don 'di zhus shig dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis khyed ④la ji ②skad lung bstan pa de de kho na bzhin du zung shig⑥ /skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed ⑦par mdzad pa yin pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ②kyis tshe dang ldan pa pi lin ⑨da'i bu la rmas ⑩pa pi lin da'i bu khyod kyis bsam pa ji lta bus rdzu 'phrul rnam par bstan/ btsun pa bdag 7'di snyam bgyid de/ gal te sug rjed dag la ma bsams na/ sug rjed dag kyang re zhig nor dang bral ba las byung ba'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur zhing ma dad pa rnams kyis kyang glags rnyed 8par 'gyur la/ dad pa rnams kyang 'di ltar sbyin par bya ba'i chos byin pa yongs su skyong bar mi byed pas phyin cad 8su zhig shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong ④rnams la sbyin pa dang bya bar sems shes gzhan 'du gyur pa nyid du 'gyur gyis/ bdag gis 0rdzu 'phrul rnam par bstan par bgyi'o snyam ⑩pas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag dge slong pi yin da'i bus bsam pa de lta bus rdzu 'phrul rnam par bstan pa la ltung ba med do/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa nor can gyis dge slong gi tsodage 'dun skyon ma ⑩mchis shing chu bur ma mchis 5—262 ri ca
