gnas su bsod snyoms pas bsro khang ①byed du bcug pa ji lta ba bzhin du me khang gi gleng gzhi yang de kho na bzhin du rgyas par brjod par bya'o/ /bye brag ni 'di yod de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis du rdzogazhi ma zin pa la mkhar len gyi stongs mo bya'o zhes bka' stsal zhunas/ dge slong dag me khang gi las byed cing phyam dag phar sbed 4tshur sbed pa na de dag gi phye'og na shing mkhan zhig zhal ta byed de/⑥ji tsam na phyam myodag sbed pa na/ dge slong gi lag nas phyam shor bas shing mkhan gyi mgor 3 rdzog nas de dus la bab pa dang / dge slong de dag tshe dang ldan pa dag bsod snyoms pa las ⑨med pas las phyung cobs bdag cag la pham par 'gyur ba'i ltung nyurngab ma byung ngam snyam du 'gyod pa skyes pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed la ni ltung nyu2ba med de/ yang dge slong dag gis mi bzod pa'i khur gdeg nyu)par mi bya'o/ /rkyen de lta bu zhig byung na mdo nyu mdor khyim pa dag 'dzin du gzhug par bya zhing gdeg /thupa dag nyunedang /gzhag pa dag kyang brjod par bya ste/ mnyam du gdeg skupa dang / mnyam du gzhag par bya'o/ /dge slong dag mi bzod pa'i khur 'deg tho)par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag gis mi bzod pa'i khur gdeg (1par mi bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/ dge slong rnams kyis ji tsam ni bzod pa yin/ ji tsam ni mi bzod pa yin pa kru mi shes nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim pa gcig ( nyugi khur gang yin pa de dge slong gnyis kyis gdeg par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med 5—362

zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus gtum mo btul te skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi dag la bkod pa de'i tshe des tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal nas yod ①byad thams cad kyis bstabs pa ②dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas dang du ma blangs te smras pa/ sring zhumo bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa ni gzhan la phan pas rjes su 'dzin par zhugs ༅pa yin pas kho bos kyang thugazhan la phan pa bya ⑥dgos so/ /gtum mos smras pa/ 'phags pa gal te de lta lags te rtsodang du mi bzhed 3na/ bdag gis 'phags pa'i slad du drang srong gi gdan bsham sh+yi par bgyis/ khyod kyis bsod snyoms brgyus nas drang srong gi gdan la longs cispyad de gshegs skyepar rigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas smras pa/ sring mo de bzhin bya'o zhes tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka nyi ma 25re re zhing bsod snyoms brgyus nas gtum mo'i khyim du drang srong gi stan la longs spyad de 'gro'o/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la ljongs su bya ba zhig byung nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char mas bsams pa/ bdag je tu song la sring mo blta bar bya'o snyam nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka gtum mo'i gan du song ste smras pa/sring mo kho bo ljongs rgyur 'gro yis / khyod kyis chos kyi lus la bag gyis shig /gtum mos smras pa'i/ 'phags pa myur du slar gshegs pa'i rigs te/ der bzhugs par mi mdzad cing der dgyes pa mi bskyed du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus gtum mo bltas 7te ljongs rgyur 'phags pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos dge slong rnams 7la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das ljongs rgyur gshegs kyis/ khyed cag las gang bcom ldan 'das dang 5—363

thabs cig ༅ljongs rgyur 'gro bar spro ba des chos gos kyi las gyis shig /tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus thos nas bsams pa/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyu ba la ni phan yon bcwa ②brgyad yod de/ rgyal po'i 'jigs pa med pa dang / chom rkun gyi ⑧'jigs pa med pa dudang / me'i 'jigs pa med pa dang / mi'i 'jigs pa med pa dang / mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa med pa dang / klu'i 'jigs pa med pa dang / gdug pa'i 'jigs pa med pa dang / seng ge'i 'jigs pa med pa dang / stag gi 'jigs pa med pa dang / gung gi 'jigs pa med pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs ⑤kyi 'jigs pa med pa dang / spyang ki'i rjo'ajigs pa med pa dang / sho gam gyi 'jigs pa med pa dang / la gcan ⑦gyi 'jigs pa med pa dang / gru btsas ⑤kyi 'jigs pa med pa dang / dus dang dus su lha'i gzugs dag mthong zhing lha'i sgra dag thos la kun shes pa brda sprod pa dag thos pa dang / chos kyi longs spyod dang / zang zing gi longs spyod yod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi rgyu ba la gnod pa nyung ba yin gyis/ bdag kyang bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig ljongs 0rgyur 'gros 7phyir ldog par bya'o snyam nas / tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka phyir log go/ /de'i bar skabs su gtum mo'i khyim du bu mo zhig la khye'u zhig btsas nas gtum yimos khye'u de'i ma la smras pa/bu mo khye'u 'di khrus gyis la gos dkar pos dkris te drang srong gi stan tso'adi la snyol ⑩cig dang yun ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur zhing ts+tsha ring du skyong bar 'gyur ro/ /bu mo des khye'u de khrus byas te gos dkar pos dkris nas drang srong gi bstan de la rtag tu bsnyal lo/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka yang nyi ma gzhan zhig na bsod snyoms la zhugs nas gtum tsomo'i khyim ga la ba der song ngo / /dgra bcom pa 5wa 364

dag ni ma bsams par shes pa dang mthong ba mi 'jug pas/ tshe dang ldan ①'char ka de bzhin du drang srong gi stan de la 'dug pa dang / bud med kyi yul de brtad pa dang bcas shing 'phags pa khye'u 'phags pa khye'u zhes zer nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka myur du langs te bltas ②na khye'u dus la bab pa mthong ②ngo //khyim mi dag gis cho nges gdab par brtsams ④pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus ⑤smras pa/ sring mo ma ngu shig /sems can 'dis tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i las byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang 'du byed thams cad ni ⑥mi rtag ༅go/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de lta mod kyi 'di la kho bos ngud mos gdab par bya ba yin te/ 'di ltar kho bos dgra bcom pa nyid thob kyang kho bo las ②brten te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul ba la/ nyan thos rnams kyis ⑨bslab pa'i gzhi 'cha' bar 'gyur ro/ /des ༅skabs de dge slong rnams la brjod nas/dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol ༅pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rmyabaka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong 'char ka la ni ltung ba med de/yang dge slong gis khyim gzhan du stan la ma brtags 8par 'dug par mi bya'o/ /'dug na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal byamagon med zas sbyin gyi tsodaga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na khyim bdag phyug pa/nor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba/ phan tshun gtam 'dres pa/ phebs par smra ba/ 'grogs bshes/ smos 'drin tsoganyis shig 'khod ⑩do/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig tson de gnyis nor zad pa dang / longs spyod zad par gyur nas de gnyis kyis gros bya bar brtsams ⑩pa/ bdag cag gnyis 'di nyid du 5—365

mthos pa dang dmas par gyur pas rnam pa 'di lta bu'i 'tsho ba za zhing longs spyod pas ci bya/ rab tu 'byung du 'dong ngo zhes de gnyis legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ngo / /de na gcig ①na bar gyur nas cig 0shos de'i nad g.yog byed do/ /nad pa de nyam snodams shing sos par ma gyur nas/nad g.yog des nad pa la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod ④la sngon khyim pa'i tshe na lan 'ga' nad 'di lta bu byung ngam/ sngon yang byung ngo ⑤/ /'o na ji ༅zhig gis zhi bar gyur/ lan tshwa'i ⑦sman rtsabs kyis so/ /'o na da ④ci'i phyir lan tshwa'i sman rtsabs 0mi 'thung zhes nad g.yog des lan tshwa'i sman rtsabs 4)bslangs te nad pa la blud pa dang / nad pa des 7dus kyi chos dang ldan par gyur nas dge slong de bdag gis 'di la sman ma yin pa byin par ma gyur tam snyam du 'gyod pa skyes nas/ des skabs de dge slong rnams la brjod nas/dge slong rnams kyis 8bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong de la ni ltung ba med de/ yang dge slong gis sman pa la ma dris par rang gi blos tsond pa la sman sbyin ⑫ par mi bya'o / /gal te sman pa med na sman pa rab tu byung ba la dri bar bya'o sman pa rab tu byung ba med na sman pas bkol ba la dri bar bya'o/ /sman pas bkol ba med na nad kyis thebs pa la dri bar bya'o/ /nad kyis thebs pa med na dge slong rgan pa rgan pa dag la dri bar bya'o/ /dge slong gis sman pa la ma dris sam/ ji skad bstan pa'i rim pa bzhin ma byas par rang gi blos nad pa la sman sbyin na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong rnams the tshom 8skyes nas the tshom ⑩thams cad gcod pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa 5—366

dge slong de la sman gang lags pa de nyid sman ma lags pa nyid du gyur pa'i rgyu ni gang lags/ rkyen ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 455 ①pa/de sngon khyim pa'i tshe na rlung dang bad kun ②can du gyur la/ da ltar ni rlung dang mkhris pa can du gyur pas des na de la sman gang yin pa de nyid sman ma yin pa nyid du gyur to// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis ma ga d+mar byung ba'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po lha brgyad khri dang ma ga d+mar byung ba'i bram ze dang khyim bdag brgya ②stong phrag du ma dang lhan cig ④bden pa dag la bkod pa de'i tshe na ma ga sgyur byung ba'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos rgyal po'i khab tu 'di skad ces rgyal po'i khab na ⑤'khod pa dang / pho brang 'khor ba dang / yul tha dad pa nas lhags pa'i tshong pa'i tshogs shes ldan dag nyon cig /nga'i yul du gang gis kyang chom rkun mi bya'o/ /gang nga'i yul du chom rkun byed pa de ngas yul med par bya'o/ / bcom pa ⑥rnams kyi rkun rdzas ni nga'i mdzod dang bang ba nas 'asbyin no zhes dril gyi sgra bsgrags pa byas so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gzhon nu'i dpe'i mdo sdes btul ba de'i tshe na ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis kyang mnyan yod du 'di skad ces mnyan yod na 'khod pa dang / pho brang 'khor ba dang / yul tha dad pa nas lhags pa'i tshong pa'i tshogs shes ldan dag nyon cig /nga'i yul du gang gis kyang chom rkun mi bya'o/ /gang nga'i yul du chom rkun byed pa de ngas bsad ⑧pa'i gyod la bsgrin ⑨par bya'o/ /5—367

bcom pa rnams kyi rkun rdzas ni nga'i mdzod dang bang ba nas sbyin no zhes dril gyi sgra bsgrags pa byas so/ /de'i bar skabs na chom rkun pa gang dag yul ma ga dhā na gnas pa dag dang / chom rkun pa gang dag yul ko sa la na gnas pa de dag sa mtshams kyi bar du dong ste ①'khod do/ /thams cad du chom rkun pa gang dag yul ma ga dhā na gnas pa dag dang / chom rkun pa gang ②dag yul ko sa la na gnas pa de dag sa mtshams kyi ②bar du dong ste 'khod cing don mthun 'joms par byed do zhes bya ba'i sgra de lta bus kyang khyab par gyur to/ /de thos nas yul ma ga dhā nas don mthun bsel ba dang bcas pas yul ko sa lar 'gro bar brtsams shing yul ko sa la nas kyang don mthun bsel ba dang bcas pas yul ma ga d+mar 'gro bar brtsams so/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na yul ma ga dhā nas don mthun bsel ba dang bcas pa yul ko sa lar 'phags nas de gang gi tshe sa mtshams kyi bar las 'das te yul ko sa lar zhugs pa de'i tshe na ded dpon gyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal 'di ni gtum pa/rtun cings pa dral shul che ⑤ba/ dpa' ba/ rtsal che ba zhes grags ⑥pas/gal te don mthun chom rkun pas bcom par gyur na yang des bdag cag la rkun ⑦rdzas sbyin par nus kyis bsel ba phyir thong shig /don mthun dag gis smras pa/ded dpon gal te de lta na de lta dubagyi'o zhes de dag gis bsel ba phyir btang ⑨ngo / /chom rkun pa de yidag gis bya ma rta bzhag ste ⑩'khod pa dang / bya ma rta dag gis bsel ba phyir btang ba de mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag bsel ba phyir log gis don mthun gzhom par byas 'dong ngo / /zhes de dag gis don mthun sā tshula'i dgon par zhugs pa bcom mo/ /de na tshong pa kha 5—368

cig ni bsad/ kha cig ni byer ro/ /de na gang dag byer ba de dag mgo sa rdul gyis bkang ste/ ko sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal ①rgyal gyi drung du dong nas smras pa/ lha bdag cag tshong pa rnams khyod kyi yul du tshong par ②mi rung bar rnam par bkod do/ /ci zhig byas/ lha bdag cag chom rkun pa dag gis bcom mo/ /rgyal pos dmag dpon 'phags skyes po la bsgo ba/ gzhon nu song la chom rkun pa dag dang rkun rdzas dag myur du khug cig① /dmag dpon 'phags skyes pos lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes ko ④sa lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal las mnyan nas dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa glang po che ba'i ④tshogs dang / rta pa'i tshogs dang / shing rta pa'i tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi ⑥tshogs go bskon te myur ba myur bar sā ⑦la'i dgon par song ngo / /de'i bar skabs na chom rkun ⑤pa dag sā ⑨la'i dgon pa shin tu stug po'i nang na 7zhugs nas bag phab ste rkun rdzas bged ༅par byed do/ /'phags skyes pos kyang de dag gi 8steng du brdzis blanas de na chom rkun pa kha cig ni bsad/ kha cig ni byer / chom rkun pa drug bcu coni gson por bzung ngo / /de nas g.yul las rnam par rgyal zhing chom rkun pa dang rkun rdzas khyer te ko tsos lar byung ba'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi drung du song nas rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal te smras pa/lha chom rkun pa ni 'di dag lags/ rkun rdzas ni 'di dag lags so/ /rgyal pos chom rkun pa dag la smras pa/ shes ldan dag ngas 'di skad ces nga'i yul du gang gis kyang chom rkun mi bya'o/ /gang nga'i yul du chom rkun byed pa de skyangs bsad ⑩pa'i gyod la bsgrin 8par bya'o/ /bcom pa rnams kyi rkun rdzas ni nga'i mdzod dang bang ba nas sbyin no zhes dril gyi sgra bsgrags ⑩pa byas pa de khyed kyis bya5—369

ma thos sam/ lha thos so/ /'o na khyed kyis ci'i phyir tshong pa 'di dag bcom/lha bdag cag 'tsho ba ma mchis so/ /gal te de lta na yang ci'i phyir gzhan bsad lhapar gyur/ lha 'jigs pa bstan pa'i slad du'o/ /ngas kyang khyed la sngon sus kyang ma bstan pa de lta bu'i 'jigs pa bstan par bya'o/ /rgyal po de gtum pas des blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag deng la chos 5rkun pa 'di dag bsad ri sar khrid la/ lag pa dang / rkang pa chod cig /tshong pa 'di dag gi ci phrogs pa nga'i bang ba dang ④mdzod nas byin cig /blon po de dag gis chom rkun pa de dag dur khrod du khrid de lag pa dang rkang pa bcad nas tshong pa rnams la rkun sardzas rgyal po'i bang ba dang mdzod nas byin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag bdag gi 5rgud pa dang / gzhan gyi rgud pa la yang dang yang du so sor rtogs shig /bdag gi 'byor pa dang / gzhan gyi 'byor 7pa la yang dang yang du so sor rtogs sashig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/dge slong dag bdag dang gzhan gyi 9rgyad pa tsu ni yid 'byung ba'i gnas yin la/bdag dang gzhan gyi 'byor pa yang yid 'byung ba'i gnas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bka' stsal nas/ dge slong dag langs shing langs shing dur (1khrod nyu rgyur 'gro bar brtsams so/ /dge slong ma dag kyang langs shing langs shing dur khrod rgyur 'gro bar tsu brtsams so/ /de'i tshe na rab tu mang po dag dur khrod rgyur dong zhing de dang de dag gis tsu —com rkun pa dag la nges par brtags thosapar brtsams so/ /mi gzhan zhig kyang de dag nyid la rtog cing 'dug pa des smras pa/gal te don 'dod pa 'ga' zhig gis 'di dag la lan tshwa'i chusman rtsabs blud par gyur na/ des na 'di dag 'di nas shi 'phos na ma gzhon nu dag gi mnu 5—370

zho 'thung bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong ma de dag gi nang na dge slong ma skyong ma zhes bya ba sbom mo/ glen ma/ mi gsal ba zhig 'dug pa des de thos nas des bsams pa/ gal te bdag bsod nams kyi phung po de ①lta bu las yongs su nyams par gyur na/ bdag gis legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung nas ci zhig rnyed kyis bdag song la lan tshu'i sman rtsabs bslangs te 'di dag la blud par bya'o snyam nas/ dge slong ma skyong ②ma de dge slong ma rnams kyi nang nas phyir byung ste/ gnas su song nas de nas lan tshu'i ②sman rtsabs kyi phru ba dang / kham ④por drug bcu bslangs ⑤te/ chom rkun pa dag gi drung du song ba dang / chom rkun pa de dag yisdug bsngal gyi tshor ba dag gis nyen cing srog la mi ltos pa skom pas gdungs pa dag gis bsams pa/ kye ma 'phags ma 'dis bdag cag skom gyis gdungs pa rnams la bum pa de nas skom blud na ci ma rung snyam mo/ /skyong mas bsod ⑦nams kyi 'du shes kyis re re la kham phor byin te lan tshwa'i sman rtsabs brims pa dang / gang gis 'thungs pa de dus la bab ste de bzhin du thams cad dus la bab bo/ /skyong ma chom rkun pa de dag la lan tshwa'i sman rtsabs 'drim ⑤par byed pa na nam sros par gyur nas dge slong ma'i dbyar khang sgo bcad pa na skyong ma 'ongs nas des dal bus khad kyis khad kyis sgo gtan ⑨brdungs pa dang / dge slong ma rnams kyis smras pa/ sgo gtan 0rdung bar byed pa 'di su/ skyong mas smras pa/ bdag skyong ma'o/ /khyod nam sros nas ga las yi'ongs/ phu nu mo dag rjes su yi rang bar gyis shig /rjes su yi rang bar gyis shig /ci khyod kyis skyedagra bcom pa nyid mngon tsodu byas sam/ 'on te phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'am/ lan gcig ④phyir 'ong 5—371

ba'i 'bras bu'am/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas sam/ 'on te dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang byed du bcug /phu nu mo dag ma yin no/ /'o na 'bras chan lhanam/ skyo ma 'am/ thug pa'i btung ba 'am/ ras yug chen sbyor du bcug gam/ skyong mas smras pa/ phu nu mo dag ci khyed cag du 'bras chan ri dang / skyo ma dang / thug pa'i btung ba dang / ras yug chen sbyor du gzhug pa btsal ba las las gegazhan med dam/ 'o na gzhan ci byas/khyed cag gis chom rkun pa drug bcu sapo lag pa dang / rkang pa bcad pa de dag mthong ngam/ mthong ngo / /bdag gis lan 69re sman rtsabs bslangs te de dag 'thung du bcug dzinas 'thungs pa dang / de dag dus la bab pas ma gzhon nu dag gi nu zho 'thung du bcug go/ /skal chad tsum khyod lto sapham par 'gyur ba dag gis bkang 9ba ci la nged cag rjes su yi rang ba 1 byed du 'jud ri —dam / de bdag la yang dag par pham par 'gyur ba'i ltung ba ma byung ngam snyam du 'gyod 1 pa skyes nas des skabs de dge slong rnams la brjod nas dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong ma de la 'du shes kyang yod/ sems pa yang yod pas phas 'pham par gyur to/ /de lta bas na dge slong ngam/ dge slong mas nad pa la ji ri 5nas kyang nad pa dus byed par gyur cig snyam pa de lta bu'i sems kyis tsugasman sbyin par mi bya bar 'di ltar ci nas kyang nad pa skyend sos par gyur cig snyam pa de lta bu'i sems kyis sman sbyin par bya'o/ /dge slong gis nad pa la ci nas kyang nad pa dus byed par gyur cig snyam pa de lta bu'i sems kyis sman sbyin par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//5—372

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod lhan rgyal byed kyi 3tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dudaga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /gang gi chetshe tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos nye ba rgya'akhor la sogs pa sar pa thoskyes phran gzhon nu bcu bdun sde'i tshogs dag rab tu phyung 3rdzogs par bsnyen par byas pa sade'i tshe na bcu bdun sde dag gal te gcig shel las su bsko nyu )ba bab na yang de dag thams cad bsdongs nyu te byed do/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na gtsug lag khang der mtshan thog thag tsu tu chos mnyan pa byung bas cho der de dag thams cad kyis bsdongs te tron 6byas so/ /phyi de nyin par dge 'dun gyi bsro khang 0byung nas der yang de dag thams cad kyis bsdongs te tron chubyas so/ /de'i phyi de nyin par bcu bdun sde las gcig zhu la dge skos bab nas de'i nyin mo yang thams cad kyis gtsug lag khang brgyan te 'khod do/ /de na dge skos tron ri nabyed pa'i tshe bcu bdun sde las gcig zhu la blo byung ba bdag ni chad ri kyis nyal lo/ /mi bcu drug gis ci'i phyir tron ri mi nus snyam mo/ /de bzhin du re re la yang blo de lta bu byung nas gzhan bcu drug po thams cad so sor nyal du dong ngo / /dge skos de 'ba' zhig gcig pu / mtshan thog thag las byas te/ mtshan mo nam nangs pa dang / mar me'i kong bu dag bsdus/ sgo dag phye/ gtsug lag khang chag chag btab/ byug pa byas te/ dus shes par byas nas stan bshams shing mchod rten gyi 'khor sar bdug cho — spos brims te/ gtsug lag khang gi steng du 'greng nas gaṇ+ḍi du brdung bar brtsams so/ /de nas bcu drug po de dag gaṇ+ḍi'i sgras sad nas rang rang gi gnas khang dag nas lhung bzed thogs te byung ba dang / de dag gis dge skos de gcig (1pu phar rgyug 4tshur rgyug cing 5—373

'dug pa mthong nas de dag gis phan tshun smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag 'di gcig pu phar rgyug tshur ①rgyug cing 'dug na yu bu cag las sus kyang 'di'i grogs ma byas sam/ gcig gis smras pa/ kho bo la blo byung ba bdag ni chad kyis ②nyal lo/ /mi bcu drug gis ci'i phyir tron mi nus snyam mo/ /de bzhin du ②gzhan yang de skad zer/ gzhan dag kyang de skad cizer te/ thams cad kyis ⑤de skad smras so/ /de nas bcu drug po dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag 'di bdag cag gi 'phral gyi ⑥bya ba thams cad la thog ⑦mar 'gro ba yin na bdag cag gis 'di'i grogs ma byas pa ni yu bu cag gis ma legs pa byas te/'di bdag cag la gshe bar 'gyur gyis zan zos ma thag tu bzod pa gsol bar bya'o zhes de dag gis zan zos nas bzod pa gsol bar brtsams te/ gzhon pa rnams kyis ni de'i rkang pa gnyis la gtugs/ rgan pa rnams kyis ni mgul nas 'khyud de tshe dang ldan pa bzod par gsol zhes byas na ⑧de cang mi smra ba nyid du 'dug go/ /de dang ches bshes pa gcig ⑨yod pa des ga cig tshil byas pa dang / des rgod par brtsams yite/ bzod do zhes kyang zer ro/ /de dag gis bsams pa/ de ni thabs legs pa yin no snyam nas gzhan gyis kyang ga ga tshil byas shing de bzhin du thams cad kyi tusmebar gyis ga ga tshil byas pa dang /de rlung gyen du 'chugs ④te dus la bab bo/ /de dag brtad cing mya ngan bya bar brtsams pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis ⑩smras pa/ kye bcu bdun sde dag ci'i phyir brtad cing mya ngan byed/ de dag gis smras pa/ bdag cag sngon ni bcu bdun sder gyur na da ni bcu drug sder gyur te tshangs pa mtshungs ⑫par spyod pa yid du 'ong ba dang bral zhing pham par gyur pa'i ltung ba byung ngo / /5—374

dge slong de dag gis ma legs so zhes smras te dong ngo / /bcu drug po de dag kyang mtha' gcig ①tu dong ste/ sems khong du ②chud cing 'khod pa rgyadage slong gzhan dag gis mthong nas dge slong de dag gis spyo ④bar brtsams te/ tshe dang ldan pa bcu bdun sde 'di dag ni sog ma'i ⑤me bzhin du skad cig gis 'bar zhing skad cig gis shi bar gyur yite/ yud tsam zhig 0rgod ⑤bag byed cing yud tsam zhig ⑨sems khong du 0chud cing 'khod do zhes zer ro/ /de dag mya ngan gyi mes yid gdungs pas yongs su spyos 0kyang cang mi smra bar 'khod pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis ④bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong de rnams la ni ltung ba med de/ yang dge slong gis ga 8ga tshil mi bya'o/ /byed na 0'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro// //'dul 8ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po bcu gcig pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod nas ha cang mi ring ba na/ ri brags shig ⑩yod pa de na khyim bdag phyug pa/ nor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba zhig 'dug ste(spre/ de yang dad pa can bzang ba dge ba'i bsam 8pa can yin pas des dge 'dun la bsngos te blugatsug lag khang rta babs mthon 0po dang /skar khung dang / skar khung dra ba can dang / lan kun gyis brgyan pa/ snying dang mig 'phrog 0pa/ mtho ris kyi them skas su gyur pa zhig byed du bcug go/ /gtsug lag khang der dge slong drug bcus phyedabyar gnas pa dag byas te dong nas khyim bdag des der ma byin par len pa dag gis 3khri 'am/ khri'u dag ma rdzi5—375

rkus ①par gyis shig ces srung ②ma'i mi bzhag go/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na ①dge slong gzhan drug bcu chaljongs rgyu zhing 'gro ba na ri brags der phyin nas bsti gnas rnyen ⑤par byed pa na mi zhig gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag khyed cag ci'i slad du ⑥ gtsug lag khang du ⑦mi gnas/ bzhin ⑧bzangs gtsug lag khang ga la yod/ 'phags pa dag dgon pa 'di na'o/ /dge slong de dag der dong ba dang srung ⑨ma'i mis mthong nas des 'ongs pa legs so zhes bya ba'i tshig gis bsnyen bkur byas te/ gnas khang dag bskos nas khri dang / khri'u dang /stan nang tshangs can dang / la ba la sogs pa dag phul te sbyangs tshags g.yar ༅nas smras pa/ 'phags pa dag re zhig chab btsag pa yimadzod cig dang de'i bar du bdag gis khyim bdag la brjod par bgyi'o/ /zhes mi de khyim bdag gi 8drung du song ste smras pa/ khyim bdag dgyes pa skyed 8cig /khyod kyi gtsug lag khang du dge slong glo bur du lhags pa drug bcu comachis so/ /khyim bdag gus par bsgrims 8pa dang bcas pas nang mi dag la smras pa/ shes ldan dag kho bo'i gtsug lag khang du dge slong gi dge 'dun byon pa de dag legs par sbyar ba'i btung bas tshim ⑩par byas/ bu ram dang / hwags dang /li kha ra dang / dgun ⑩dang / bal po 8se'u long shig ces khyim bdag des yilegs par sbyar ba'i btung ba sbyar nas gtsug lag khang du song ba dang / dge slong dag kyang chu btsags te rang rang gi spyod lam gyis 6) 'khod do/ /khyim bdag des dge slong de dag thag ring po kho na nas mthong ste/ des gtsug lag khang de mtsho pad mas gang ba bzhin du mthong nas rgya cher dad pa'i shugs kyis bsgyur ba'i rgyud kyis tshigs su bcad pa 0smras pa/ grong ngam yang na dgon 5—376

pa'ang rung / /gshong ngam yang na thang yang rung / /gang na 'os ①pa gnas pa yi / /sa gzhi ②de ni dga' byed yin/ /de nas legs par sbyar ba'i btung ba sta ②gon byas te rang gi lag nas ④dge slong gi dge 'dun de tshim par byas nas rang nyid kyis pog phor ༅thogs te dge slong gi dge 'dun dang lhan cig mchod rten la phyag 'tshal nas gtsug lag khang du zhugs ༅te/ rgan pa'i mtha' ⑦logs su 'dug go/ /dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis yon bshad nas khyim bdag des rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal te sang bdag gi sdum par 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyis gdugs tshod gsol bar ⑤ci gnang zhes smras pa dang / sdoge slong rnams kyis kyang dang du blangs nas khyim bdag des rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal te song ngo / /khyim bdag des phyi de nyin par zas bsod pas dge slong dag tshim par byas shing dus ma yin par yang ⑨btung ba blud nas dge slong rnams kyis kyang chos bstan 0to/ /phyis kyang de kho na bzhin du dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis yon bshad pa dang / khyim bdag de rgan pa'i mtha' logs su 'dug ste smras pa/ 'phags pa dag bdag gis gtsug lag khang 'di bdag nyid kyi slad du yang bgyid du ma stsal nye du rnams kyi slad du yang bgyid du ma stsal gyi / 'di ltar 'phags pa rnams kyi slad du bgyid du stsal yib lags kyis 'di nyid du dbyar gnas par zhal gyis bzhes shig dang / bdag gis 'phags pa rnams la yo byad thams cad kyis mi brel bar bgyi'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ khyim bdag mnyan tsoyod na bcom ldan 'das chos kyi 8rje mngon sum ④du bzhugs shing / dus dang dus su dge slong che ge mo zhig gis ni dgra bcom pa nyid mngon tsodu byas/ che ge mo zhig gis ni mi sdug pa'i bar grub bo zhes 5—377

shes pa brda sprod pa dag kyang thos par 'gyur/ rgyal po yang bstan pa la shin tu dad / btsun mo phreng ldan ma dang / rgyal rigs dbyar tshul ma dang / bla mkhyen drang srong byin dang / rnying ①pa dang / dge bsnyen ②ma sa ga dang /ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma dang / gzhan yang dad pa can mang du yod pas de ②zang zing gi longs spyod dang / chos kyi ④mongs spyod chen po yang 'grub pas bdag cag de nyid du 'dong ngo / /'phags pa dag chos kyi longs spyod ni 'phags pa ⑤nyid la rag las pa lags kyi/ zang zing gi longs spyod ni bdag la rag las pa lags pas dgyes bskyed ༅cig dang / cung zad ④kyang nyams par mi 'gyur ro//dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis dad pa can gyi dad pa spel bar bya zhing sbyin bdag la rjes su snying brtse bar bya'o zhes gsungs pas 'di nyid du 'khod par bya'o zhes de dag der 'khod nas blo brtan pas gtsug lag khang de'i phyi nang bcas par so sor brtag ⑧par brtsams pa dang / gtsug lag khang de me tog phun sum tshogs pa dang ⑨/'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa/ shin tu dga' bar tshumathong nas dge 'dun bigyi gnas brtan gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag gtsug lag khang 'di me tog phun sum tshogs pa/ 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa/ shin tu dga' ba yin pas gal te bdag cag gis 'dir dbyar snga mar tsoganas par khas blangs na me tog dang 'bras bu thams cad yongs su longs spyod spre)par mi 'gyur gyis/bdag cag ④gis nges par dbyar phyi mar tsoganas par khas blang bar bya'o zhes de dag gis ⑩der dbyar phyi mar ⑩gnas par khas blangs so/ /khyim bdag de la gtsug lag khang de gcig pu 'ba' zhig yod pas de sbyin pa dang bya bar sems pa 5—378

gang yin pa de thams cad gtsug lag khang de nyid du ①sbyin zhing byed do/ / ri brags de na yang gtsug lag khang gzhan med pas/② ri brags pa de dag kyang sbyin pa dang bya bar sems pa gang yin pa de thams cad gtsug lag khang de nyid du sbyin zhing byed do/ / ri brags ②de'i nyen kor dun yang gtsug lag khang gzhan med pas ri brags kyi nyen kor ⑤ba de dag kyang sbyin pa dang bya bar sems pa gang yin pa de dag ⑥thams cad gtsug lag khang de nyid du sbyin zhing byed pas der dbyar gnas par khas blangs pa'i dge slong rnams la rnyed pa mang po byung ngo //ston zla tha chungs kyi g.yon can dag gi ⑦kun tu spyod pa ni dgag dbye byas ma thag tu 'dus te/ bdag cag gis las ci zhig byas na des btsal ⑤mi dgos par lo skor 0du longs spyod cing bde bar 'khod par 'gyur zhes phan tshun gros byed do//de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ shākya'i sras ⑩kyi dge sbyong 'di dag gzhom par bya'o snyam mo/ /gzhan dag gis smras pa/ de dag ni sgo 'phar brgya snyed ⑩bzla ba byas kyang / lto khengs pa 'grub par dka' 8bas de dag la ci yang med na bdag cag ci'i phyir yun 8de srid du bsdad par bya/ de na dge slong gi rgyus shes pa gcig ④'dug pas smras pa/ khyed ci shes de dag la mang du yod do/ /ji ltar 8zhig gtsug lag khang ⑩'di gang gi yin pa'i 0khyim bdag de ni dad pa tsocan bzang ba dge ba'i bsam pa can yin la khyim bdag de la yang gtsug lag khang 'di gcig ⑩phu 'ba' zhig yod pas de sbyin pa dang bya bar sems pa 0gang yin pa de thams cad gtsug lag khang 'di nyid du sbyin zhing byed do/ /ri brags 0'di na yang gtsug lag khang gzhan med pas ri brags ⑤pa 'di dag kyang sbyin pa dang bya bar sems pa gang yin pa de thams cad gtsug lag khang 'di nyid du sbyin 5—379

zhing byed do/ /ri brags ①'di'i nyen kor ②na yang gtsug lag khang gzhan med pas ri brags ②kyi nyen kor ④pa 'di dag kyang sbyin pa dang bya bar sems pa gang yin pa de thams cad gtsug lag khang 'di nyid du sbyin pa'i ⑤zhing byed pas 'dir dbyar gnas par khas blangs pa'i dge slong rnams la rnyed pa mang po byung ngo / /gal te yid mi ches na song la ltos shig dang rang nyid kyi mngon sum du 'gyur ro/ /gal te de lta na khyod nyid je song la/ mngon sum du gyis shig dang / kho bo cag phyis 'ong ngo / /des smras pa/ legs kyis de bzhin gyis shig dang kho bo 'gro'o zhes de ༅gos tshags bcos te 'phags shing de nas tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis mchod rten la phyag 'tshal te/ gtsug lag khang der zhugs ⑦so/ /ji tsam na sgo khang na rgan zhugs shig ⑧'dug nas g.yon can des ⑨de'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te dri bar brtsams pa/ 'phags pa gtsug lag khang snying dang mig 'phrog pa mtho ris kyi them skas su gyur pa 'di su'i lags/bzhin bzangs khyim bdag che ge mo zhig gi yin no/ /'phags pa ci 'di gtsug lag khang lags sam/ 'on te phongs pa lags/ bzhin bzangs gtsug lag khang ni ji ⑩lta bu yin/ phongs pa ni ⑨ji lta bu yin/ 'phags pa gang na yo byad phun sum tshogs pa ni gtsug lag khang lags so/ /gang na yo byad ma mchis pa ni phongs pa lags so/ /bzhin bzangs 'o na 'di ni gtsug lag khang yin gyi phongs pa ma yin te/ 'di ni 8yo byad phun sum tshogs pa yod kyi 'di na yo byad med pa ma yin no/ /'phags pa zas za ba ni 'ga' yang sa rdul mi za la/gos dag gyon pa ni 'ga' yang shing shun dag mi gyon pas khyed cag la gos cung zad mchis sam/ rgan zhugs de drang po'i (sprerang bzhin can yin pas des 5—380

g.yon can de'i lag nas bzung ste gnas khang du bcug nas smras pa/ bzhin bzangs gos kyi gdang gos ①dag gis phur shog cing 'dug pa la ltos/'phags pa ci 'di khyod kyi lags sam/ 'on te dge 'dun gyi lags/bzhin bzangs 'di kho bo gang zag gi yin no/ /'phags pa 'o na khyod ni gor ma bkum par dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan nam/ chos sgrog pa zhig lags samal/bzhin bzangs kho bo ni dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan yang ma yin la/ chos sgrog pa yang ma yin te/ 'di ltar kho bo ni sridage 'dun gyi ④gsar bu dge tshul zhig yin no/ /'phags pa de ni mjal na 'di na dge 'dun gyi gnas mal cung zad mchis sam/ bzhin bzangs mang du yod de re zhig kho bo'i byug ris su yang dngos po bdun po dag 'thob bo/ /'phags pa de yang mjal gyis ⑤'di zhu'o/ /gtsug lag khang 'di na gang la la 'tshal ma bgyid pa da ༅ci rdza mkhan gyi zhusnod du 'tshod dam/ 'on te zangs ma'i snod du 'tshod bzhin bzangs khyod kyis gnas khang 'di dag mthong ngam/ 'phags pa mthong ngo / /bzhin bzangs gnas khang 'di dag ⑧zangs ma'i snod kyis gang zhing 'dug go/ /g.yon can des bsams pa legs par brid zin gyis da ni 'gro'o snyam nas g.yon can des smras pal/ 'phags pa khyod kyi dge ba'i phyogs yongs su nyams la ⑨bdag gi don yongs su nyams pa lags pas bdag slad kyis kyang mchi yis tshud ni mchi'o/ /bzhin bzangs de bzhin gyis shig /g.yon can des rgan zhugs de'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te song nas g.yon can de chom rkun pa de dag gi drung du song ste smras pa / pad ma'i mig can dag rdzas thams cad kyis gang ba'i gru bo che skams la 'dug gis phyogs shig /phrogs shig /de na yigacig gis smras pa/ de na 5—381

'khod pa'i rab tu byung ba drug bcu ①po dag ni 'phong gi slob dpon sha stag yin zhes grag ②pas de bzhin du gzhom par mi nus kyis/ gang gi ③tshe de dag mtshan mo chos nyan pa de'i tshe gzhom mo/ /gzhan dag gis smras pa/ nyi ma gang la de dag gi mechos nyan pa 'byung bar 'gyur⑤/ des smras pa/ tshes brgyad dang / bcu bzhi la 'byung ste/ de la tshes brgyad ni thal zin pas tshes bcu bzhi la 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag sor mo dag gis nyi ma bgrang zhing 'khod 'khod pa dunas ji tsam na tshes bcu bzhi la bab ste/ dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis so sor ⑤thar pa'i mdo bton te dge 'dun gyis ⑤gso sbyong byas nas chos sgrog pa seng ge'i khri la 'dzegs te 'di skad ces/ mi mchog 'dul ba'i ⑨ba lo sgyur mdzad pa/ /kun sbyor 'ching ba gcod pa de bzhin gshegs / /dbang po zhi zhing nyer zhi zhi la mkhas/ /mnyan yod bzhugs pas 4) bka' bzhin byed la gsungs(2/ /zhes tho)smra bar brtsams pa dang /g.yon can de dag gis sgo brdungs so/ /dge slong de dag gis tshor nas smras pa/shes ldan dag khyed cag su yin/ 'phags pa dag bdag cag tsorigs kyi bu dag go/ /dge slong rnams kyis bsams pa/ ri brags ④ nas skye bo'i tshogs dag chos nyan du lhags gor ma chag gis sgo dbye'o snyam nas de dag gis sgo phye ba dang de dag zhugs so/ /ji tsam na gzhom par brtsams 8pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed cag na re bdag cag rigs kyi bu dag go zhes zer na da spre'unged cag 'joms tho 7par byed dam/ de dag gis smras pa/'phags pa dag bdag cag la ming gnyis mchis 8te/ slad rol du ni rigs kyi bu dag ces bgyi la/ nang du ni chom rkun pa dag ces bgyi'o/ /khyed cag 5—382

ming 'dogs par byed pa ni nyams so/ /g.yon can de dag gis dge slong de ①dag bcom ste dong nas/ dge slong bcom pa de dag gis gros byas pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis lhag ma dang bcas par bzho ②bar bya'o zhes gsungs pas ①re zhig khyim bdag 'di phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dudage 'dun la sbyin du bcug ste yang ci bya/ bdag cag la sbyin du bcug ste yang ci byas / bdag cag mnyan yod nyid rjodu dong na der bdag cag re re dul tshangs pa mtshungs ⑦par spyod pa dag gis chos gos dag gis mi phongs par byed par 'gyur ro zhes gros byas so/ /ji ltar 'dong bar bya/ mtshan mo ⑧'gebs pas 'dong zhing / nyin mo thibs por zhugs te 'gro ⑨bar bya'o zhes de dag gis khyim bdag la yang ma bltas ⑫ par dong ngo / /ji tsam na mthar gyis mnyan yod du phyin pa dang / dge slong dag nam gyi cha stod dang cha smad la mi nyal bar sbyor ba'i rjes su brtson par gnas pa de dag gis dge slong de dag sgren mor sgo'i gam yo na rgyu ba mthong nas smras pa/ gcer bu sgre byi dag khyed cag 'dir ci 'dod/ 'di khyed kyi gtsug lag khang yang yim yin la 'dug gnas kyang ma yin no/ /de dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag cag gcer bu pa tsodag ma yin no/ /'o na khyed su yin/ dge slong dag go/ /'di lta bu dag tsodage slong yin nam/ gang dag chom rkun pa ④dag gis bcom pa de dag ji lta bu yin/ khyed cag ming ci/ sangs rgyas 'tsho'o⑫/ /chos 'tsho'otshul/ /dge 'dun 'tsho'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag 'ongs pa legs so/ /'ongs pa legs so/ /zhes de dag gis sgo phye nas dge slong de dag 'jug tu bcug ste/ de dag la la las ni chos gos byin/ la las ni sham thabs byin/5—383

la las ni 〉rngul gzan du byin/ la las ni lhung bzed byin/ la las ni chu tshags byin te/ bgo bsha' du ji lta ba bzhin du thams cad bgo bsha' byas pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi shes pa la gtsug lag khang gi sgo gya tshom sadu dbye bar mi bya ste/ gal te 'ga' zhig mtshan mo sgo sa'adod na de'i ming dang ris 'dri bar bya zhing gal te ngo shes na sgo dbye bar bya zhing / ngo mi shes na sgo dbye bar mi bya'o/ /gzhan yang chos mnyan pa la bab pa'i tshe dge slong mel tse tsub gzhag par bya zhing / gal te chom rkun pa sa'ongs na gaṇ+ḍi 'on cig /gaṇ+ḍi'i /the'u 'on cig /dus kyi 'khor lo ri 'on cig /snam sbyar dang / bdun pa dang / lnga pa dang / gtur bu dang / rgya cang dang /shur bu dang / lcag pod dang / shur bu phre'u 'on cig ces tsham ngam bya'o/ /gzhan yang ngas dge slong dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis 1 kun tu spyod pa'i chos dag bca' bar bya ste/ dge slong dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis chos mnyan pa la bab pa'i tshe dge skos la tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyis gtsug lag khang gi sgo bcad dam/ so sor brtags sam/ chos smra ba snyo la gsol ba btab bam/bshang ba dang gci ba'i skyabs byi dor byas sam zhes dri bar bya'o/ /dge slong dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis kun du spyod pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa dag yang dag par blangs te 'jug par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /de skyenas chom rkun pas bcom pa'i dge slong de dag la dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa dag kho bo cag gis khyed cag skyel bgo bsha' ji lta ba bzhin du bgo bsha' byas mod kyi 'on kyang da dung khyed cag chos gos dag gis brel gyis 5—384

khyed cag khyim bdag gang gi ①gtsug lag khang du bcom par gyur pa'i khyim bdag de ni dad pa can bzang ba dge ba'i bsam ②pa can yin pas/ de nyid kyi ②gtsug lag khang du deng shig khyodang de nyid kyis khyed cag ⑤la chos gos dag gis mi brel bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong de dag mtha' gcig ⑥ku dong ste phan tshun gros bya bar brtsams pa⑦/ tshe dang ldan pa dag tshangs pa mtshungs ⑧par spyod pa 'di dag zer ba 0ni bzang ste/ bdag cag gis khyim bdag la ma bltas ⑪ par 'ongs pas yang phyir de nyid du dong na des bdag cag la chos gos dag gis bgo bsha' byed par 'gyur ba'i gnas kyang yod do/ /zhes de dag yang phyir der dong ngo / /de thormenas khyim bdag des mthong nas smras pa/'phags pa dag ci'i slad du khyed kyis bdag la ma gzigs par bzhud/ dge slong de dag gis smras pa/ khyim bdag bcom ldan 'das kyis 8lhag ma dang bcas par bzho bar bya'o zhes gsungs pas des na bdag cag la blo byung ba re zhig khyim bdag 'di phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la sbyin du bcug 8ste yang ci bya/ bdag cag la sbyin du bcug ④ste yang ci byas/ bdag cag mnyan yod du dong na der bdag cag la tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa dag gis chos gos dag gis mi phongs par byed par 'gyur ro/ /snyam nas de'i phyir bdag cag mnyan yod du dong ngo / /khyim bdag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag gal te bdag gi gtsug lag khang bcom pas ci 'khyim na bdag dbang ba'i rdzas dag 8kyang bcom snyam mam/ 'phags pa dag khyed cag gang gi slad du byon pa ni byon pa ⑩legs so/ /zhes khyim bdag des yang rgya cher gus pa dang bcas pas mkhos su phab ste dge slong re re la yang yo byad bcu gsum bcu gsum 5—385

phul lo/ /chom rkun pa de dag yang phyir 'ongs te gtsug lag khang gi sgo rdung bar byed pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis tshor nas de dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag g.yon can de dag nyid lhags kyis tsham ngam gyis shig ces gaṇ+ḍi 'on cig ces gaṇ+ḍi de'i ②the'u dang / dus kyi 'khor lo dang / snam sbyar dang / bdun pa dang / lnga pa dang / gtur bu dang / rgya cang dang /shur bu dang / lcag pod dang / shur bu phre'u 'on cig ces tsham ngam bya bar brtsams pa dang / g.yon can de dag skrag ste 'byer ②bar brtsams pa na ②lhas tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ legs gsungs ༅rkang gnyis gtso bo thub pa yis/ /nyan thos rnams kyi tsham ngam gang bstan pa/ /tsham ngam rab brtson pa dag mchog yin gyi/ /g.yon can g.yul la sngar ba go gyon pa/ /lnga brgya dag ni de lta ma yin no/ /g.yon can de dag la dge slong gi rgyus shes pa des smras pa/shes ldan dag khyed cag ci'i phyir 'byer bar byed/ de dag gis smras pa/khyed ⑤nyid na re 'di na 'khod pa'i rab tu byung ba drug bcu zhupo dag ni 'phong gi slob dpon sha stag yin no zhes zer bas ji ltar mi 'bros su rung / gzhan yang bdag cag gis gaṇ+ḍi zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i mtshon de lta bu dag gi ming ni sngon lan 'ga' yang ma thos so/ /des smras pa/ de dag ni mtshon ma yin no/ /'o na de dag ci yin/ re zhig gaṇ+ḍi zhes bya ba ni de dag gi brdung ba'o/ /gaṇ+ḍi'i the'u zhes bya ba ni gang gi 0rdung bar byed pa'o/ /dus kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba ⑧ni dus yongs su gcod par byed pa'o/ /snam sbyar dang / bdun pa dang / lnga pa zhes bya ba de dag ni chos gos dag gi 0ming ngo / /gtur bu zhes bya ba ni gang du de dag gzhug ⑩pa'o/ /rgya cang dang / shur bu dang / lcag 5—386

pod dang / shur bu phre'u zhes bya ba de dag ni ①ska rags kyi ming yin gyis ②khyed cag ma snar bar yang phyir 'dong la gzhom par bya'o zhes smras nas/ de dag yang phyir log ste chom rkun pa'i dmag dpon gyis ya gad btsugs te 'dzeg ③par brtsams pa dang / de na rgan zhugs zhig mel tse ④bar bzhag pa des chom rkun pa'i dmag dpon 'dzeg pa de ⑤mthong nas rgan zhugs des bsams pa/g.yon can 'di dag ni gang dag gis bdag cag lhung bzed dang chos gos phrogs te sgren ⑤mor bzhag pa dag yin gyis/ gal te 'di dag la btang snyoms byas na yang 'di dag gis bdag cag ①lhung bzed dang chos gos phrogs te sgren ⑤mor bzhag par 'gyur bas 'di dag bsdigs par bya'o snyam nas/ rgan zhugs des dal bus khad kyis 0khad kyis song ste chom rkun pa'i dmag dpon de'i mgor gaṇ+ḍi 'phangs pa dang de'i klad ⑩pa zhom nas de bsnun pa drag pos phog pas/sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba dag gis nyen nas tshegs chen pos babs te cung zhig tu song ba dang dus la bab bo/ /rgan zhugs des chom rkun pa chom rkun pa zhes ku co'i 0sgra phyung ba dang / dge slong rnams kyis chos nyan pa bcad de/ khang steng du 'dzegs nas smras pa/ chom rkun pa de dag gar dong rgan zhugs kyis smras pa/ phyogs 'dir ya gad btsugs cite 'dzegs pa na kho bos bsdigs nas byer ro/ /dge slong rnams kyis 6smras pa/ gal te byer na ④legs so zhes de dag babs te/ ji tsam na mtshan mo nam nangs pa dang / gtsug lag khang gi nyen kor ④so sor brtags par brtsams 0te/ chom rkun pa de dag 'dzegs par gyur pa'i phyogs de gang yin zhes de dag gis so sor brtags pa na khrag mthong ngo / /de dag khrag rjes su dong ba dang chom rkun pa'i dmag dpon bsad 5—387

pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bslab pa 'khrugs pa'i 'jigs pas skrag ste smra bar brtsams pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag cag sngon ma bcom gyi ①bdag cag gang gis pham par gyur pa'i ltung ba byung bas da ②ni bcom par gyur to zhes de dag 'gyod pa skyes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed ③la ni ltung ba med de / yang dge slong gis ci nas kyang 'di la bsnun pas bsnun par bya'o snyam pa de lta bu'i sems kyis 'phangs par ④mi bya bar 'di ltar ⑤slo 'am rgyab logs su 'phang bar bya zhing bsdigs pa bskyed ⑥pa'i phyir tsham ngam bya'o/ /dge slong gis ci nas kyang bsnun pas bsnun par ④bya'o snyam pa de lta bu'i sems kyis 'phen par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro// risangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na khyim bdag cig 'dug pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /rtse bar byed/dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa de'i chung ma la dus gzhan na ⑤sems can zhugs par gyur nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu 'das te btsas pa las khye'u zhig byung nas de bsrings shing bskyed de chen por gyur to/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na khyim bdag de'i 0nye du zad par gyur cing nor dang longs spyod kyang zad par gyur/ de'i chung ma yang dus la bab nas des bu la smras pa/bu kho bos ni rgas pa'i gnas skabs su nor bsgrub 0tu 'gro mi nus kyis rab tu 'byung du 'gro'o/ /bus smras pa/ yab gal te de lta na bdag kyang yirab tu 5—388

'byung ngo / /bu legs so/ /zhes des khye'u ༅khrid de rgyal byed kyi tshal du song nas dge slong gi drung du song ste ②kang pa gnyis ②la phyag 'tshal nas smras pa/'phags pa bdag rab tu 'byung bar 'tshal lo/ /dge slong des smras pa/ ci khye'u 'di yang rab tu 'byung ngam/ 'phags pa rab tu 'byung ngo / /dge slong de khye'u de 'dod pas de bu dang bcas te rab tu phyung ④ngo / /chos nyid kyis na rgan pa'i mtha' nas rnyed pa 'thob ⑤la/ gzhon ⑥pa'i mtha' nas las su bsko ⑦ba yin pas rgan zhugs kyi bu rtag tu las su sko bar ⑤byed nas/ des pha ⑨la smras pa/ yab bdag cag gnyis gang cung zad zil gyis non pa de thams cad thos pa nyung ba las gyur pa lags ⑩kyis bzhengs shig dang / skol cag gnyis yul gzhan du bzhud la thos pa gzung bar bgyi'o/ /rgan zhugs kyis smras pa/bu legs kyis 'dong ngo zhes de gnyis yul gzhan du dong ngo / /'on kyang gzhon pa'i mtha' nyid nas las su sko ⑨bas de gnyis son ma thag kho nar las su sko ⑫bar bskos pa dang / bus rgan zhugs la smras pa/ yab mnyan yod na las su sko skyob mchis su lags kyang de na ④bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rje mngon sum ④du bzhugs shing dus dang / dus su dge slong che ge mo zhig gis ni dgra bcom pa nyid mngon du byas so/ /che ge mo zhig gis ni mi sdug pa'i bar grub bo zhes shes pa brda tshusprod pa yang thos par 'gyur/ rgyal po yang bstan pa la shin tu dad cing btsun mo phreng ldan ma dang / rgyal rigs dbyar tshul ma dang / bla mkhyen drang srong byin dang / rnying pa dang / dge bsnyen ma sa ga dang / ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma dang / gzhan yang dad pa can mang du mchis pas/ de na zang zing gi longs spyod dang / chos kyi longs spyod chen po yang mchis kyis der 5—389

bzhud do zhes smras nas/ de gnyis ci dga' bar ༅ljongs su 'khod nas mnyan yod ga la ba der rgyu zhing dong ba na mthar gyis rgyu zhing 'dong ba'i tshe mnyan yod du phyir phyin to/ /ji tsam na rgyal byed kyi ②tshal dang nye bar phyin pa na gaṇ+ḍi yang brdungs nas bus smras pa/ yab chagatsug lag khang du gaṇ+ḍi brdungs kyis myur ba ④myur bar bzhud do/ /rgan zhugs de rgan par gyur pas ༅shin tu ngal zhing 'gro mi nus pas de dal bus 'gro ba na bus de'i gnya' ba nas bzung ste phul ba dang / rgan zhugs des myur ba myur bar 'gro bar brtsams so/ /bus bsams pa/ thabs 'di ni bzang po zhig yin gyis yang dbul ⑥bar bya'o snyam nas / bu ⑦des rgan zhugs de yang de bzhin du phul ba dang / rgan zhugs de sa la khas dubub tu sgyel ⑨nas de'i kha phang los tsoglogs pa'i sas gang ste dus la bab bo/ /bu des ngud mos btab ste/ rgan zhugs kyi ro de lam gyi mtha' gcig 7tu bor ro/ /de nas bu des lhung bzed dang chos gos khyer te rgyal byed kyi mtshal du song ba dang / dge slong rnams kyis de mthong nas smras pa/ rgan zhugs kyi bu 'ongs pa legs so/ /'ongs pa legs so/ /khyod kyi rgan zhugs de ga la 'dug ces dris pa dang / gsar bu 8des ngu bar brtsams so/ /dge slong rnams kyis byasmras pa/ bu ci'i phyir ngu bar byed/ gsar bu des smras pa/bdag gi 8 rgan zhugs de dus la bab bo/ /dge slong de dag gis smras pa/ bu 'du byed thams cad kyi chos de lta bu yin la khyod ni legs par gsungs ⑩pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba yin pas mya ngan ma byed cig /gsar bu des ⑫smras pa/ de bdag gis bsad do/ /dge slong de dag gis smras pa/ bu 'o na khyod kyis mtshams 8med pa'i las gang yin pa yang byas la pham par 'gyur 5—390

ba'i ltung ba gang yin pa yang byung bas yun ring por sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med par gnas par 'gyur bas da ngu ba'i ①rigs so zhes zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis ②bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong de la ni ltung ba med de/yang dge slong lam du zhugs pas chadage slong lam gyis dub pa phul ④bar mi bya'o/ /ngas ⑤dge slong lam du zhugs pa'i kun du spyod pa'i chos dag bca' bar bya ste/dge slong lam du zhugs pas dge slong lam gyis dub pa ngal sor gzhug par bya/chos gos gsum dang / lhung bzed dang / chu tshags dang / lhung bzed kyi snod dang / bar bur yisnod kyi rdzas blang bar bya'o/ /dus shes par bya ste/gal te 'gro nus na de lta na legs/ gal te ⑦mi nus na ches sngar song ste/lhung bzed bkru bar bya/ go dugazhag par bya/ snod dag byin len byed du bcug ⑨nas so sor brtag par bya'o/ /'on hu) te 'ong mi nus pa thormin zan ⑫mnos te bsu bar bya'o/ /dus ma yin na skom gyis bsu bar bya'o/ /dge slong lam du zhugs pas kun tu spyod pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa dag yang dag par bslangs 6te 'jug par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa rgan zhugs kyi 8bu 'dis/ pha srog dang phral ⑫yang mtshams ma mchis pa'i kha na ma tho bas ④kyang ma reg la/ pham par 'gyur ba'i ltung ba yang ma byung ba la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag da ltar 'ba' ⑩zhig tu ma zad de 'di ltar 'das pa'i dus na yang 'dis pha srog dang phral yang mtshams med pa'i kha na ma tho bas ma reg ste de nyon 5—391

cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na ri brags ①shig na btso blag mkhan zhig la'adug pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do//rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa de'i chung ma las bu byung nas de bsrings shing bskyed de chen por gyur to/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na ri brags ②der dus ston byung nas de la gos bkru bshal bya ba mang po dag byung ba dang des bu la smras pa/ bu gos mang po dag bkru bshal bya dgos pas kho bo khyim du song ste zan za mi nus kyis ④tsar shog gos dag khyer te 'dong ngo / /phyir song la zan ༅khyer te shog shig /de buci dang lhan cig gos dag khyer te song ngo / /bu phyir song ste zan khyer te 'ongs nas des zan zos te smras pa/ bu kho bo ngal gyis nyal lo/ /khyod re zhig gos dag bkru bshal gyis shig /bus smras pa/ de ltar bgyi'o/ /btso blag mkhan de phyogs gcig tu glos phab ste gnyid log go/ /de spyi cer༅zhig yin pas de'i mgo la sbrang bu chags so/ /ji tsam na btso blag ⑦mkhan gyi bu des gos dag bkru bshal byas nas pa'i gan du song ba dang pa'i mgo la sbrang bu chags pa mthong nas des bskrad ⑧par brtsams pa dang / sbrang bu khrag gis myos pa 'phur 0du ma btub nas bu de mi bzod pa skyes te bsams pa/ sbrang bu 'dis bdag gi pha gson bzhin ⑩du khrag 'thung bar byed kyis gsad par bya'o snyam nas/ bu des de la spang leb ⑪kyis bsnun pa dang / sbrang bu de ni bros te song gi pa'i klad ⑩pa zhom nas des ⑫dus la bab pa dang / lhas tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ /dgra bo blo gros ldan pa mchog yin te/ /mdza' bshes blo gros bral ba de lta ④min/ /blo gros chung 5—392

ngus sbrang bu gsad snyam nas/ /tho bas pha yi klad ①pa bcom par gyur/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na btso ༅blag mkhan gang yin pa de ni rgan zhugs 'di nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na btso blag mkhan gyi bu gang yin pa de ni rgan zhugs kyi bu 'di nyid yin te/ 'dis de'i tshe ②yang pha ④srog dang phral yang mtshams med pa'i kha na ma ④tho bas ma reg la/ 'dis ⑥da ltar yang pha srog dang phral yang mtshams med pa'i kha na ma tho bas kyang ma reg la pham par 'gyur ba'i ༅ltung ba yang ma byung ngo / /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ni ⑧ltung ba med do/ /pham par 'gyur ba gsum pa rdzogs sto0// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can na 0spre'u rdzing gi 'gram na khang pa brtsegs pa'i khang bzangs na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na nya pa lnga brgya chu klung yid 'ong ldan la rten cing 'khod do/ /de dag la rgya mo spyod pa dang / spyod pa chen mo zhes bya ba gnyis shig yod do/ /de dag yilan 'ga' ni rgya mo spyod pa 'dzud tho)par byed la/ lan 'ga' ni spyod pa chen mo 'dzud tho)par byed de/gang gi tshe nya dag nyo ba med pa de'i tshe ni (stergya mo spyod pa 'dzud 8par byed la/gang gi tshe nya dag nyo ba yod pa de'i tshe ni 0spyod pa chen mo 'dzud ⑩par byed do/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na yangs pa can du dus ston byung nas/ de dag gis rgya mo gnyis ka bcug ste/ nyis brgya lnga bcus ni rgya mo spyod pa bcug /nyis brgya ⑫lnga bcus ni spyod pa chen mo yibacug go/ /gang dag gis rgya mo spyod pa bcug pa de dag gis ni 0nya dang / rus sbal dang / sbal pa rjodang / chu srin byis ⑤5—393

pa gsod dang / nya khyi ba la sogs pa ①mang po dag 'di lta ste/ dper na til dang / 'bras thug po che dang / rgya shug dang / rgya sran la sogs pa bzhin du phung po chen por ②rnam par bzhag go/ /gang dag gis rgya mo spyod pa chen mo ②bcug pa de dag gis ni rgya mtsho chen po nas chu klung yid 'ong ldan du zhugs ④pa chu srin nya'i rigs bong tshod chen po nyal ba zin nas de dag gis de drang ⑤bar brtsams so/ /de dag gis drangs pa na de sad nas ༅nya pa nyis brgya lnga bcu po de dag dang rgya mo spyod pa chen mo khyer te rgyun phyogs su zhugs sol/ /nya pa de dag gis nya pa nyis brgya lnga bcu po gzhan dag la shes ldan dag rgya mo spyod pa chen mo ༅dang bdag cag khyer gyis ra mda' zlog shig ⑤ces byas so//de dag gis thos nas zhunya pa nyis brgya lnga bcu po gzhan dag kyang lhags te de nyid la rub ⑩pa dang des nya pa lnga brgya dang rgya mo spyod pa chen mo khyer te rgyun phyogs su zhugs nas gzung bar ma khyanus so/ /skyabs med pa de dag gis kun du shes ldan dag rgya mo spyod pa chen mo dang bdag cag khyer gyis grogs gyis 8shig ces ra mda' ba tsobazlog pa dang las ma mthong ba'i mi ba lang rdzi dag dang / phyugs rdzi dag dang /n+tu shing (nyethun dag dang / rtswa skyethun dag dang / lam gyis 'tsho ba dag dang / lam gol bas 'tsho ba'i mi dag dang / gzhan yang srog chags brgya stong phrag du ma dag tshulog nas de dag gi lus smas 8pa dang / rnam par mas (7pa dag gis rgya mo ral pa dang rab tu ral pas chu srin de chu nas ⑥skam la phyung ngo / /de la mgo bcwa 0brgyad dang / mig sum bcu 0rtsa drug yod dos/ /de'i mgo la la ni glang po che'i mgo 'dra/ la la ni rta'i mgo 'dra/la la ni rnga mo'i mgo dang / bong bu'i mgo dang / ba lang gi mgo dang /5—394

spre'u'i ①mgo dang / seng ge'i mgo dang / stag gi mgo dang / dom gyi mgo dang / dred mo'i mgo dang / gung gi mgo dang / byi la'i mgo dang /ra'i mgo dang / lug gi mgo dang / ri dgas kyi mgo dang / ma he'i mgo dang / phag gi mgo dang / khyi'i mgo 'dra'o/ /kun du chu klung ②yid 'ong ldan pa'i nya pa lnga brgyas rgya mtsho chen po nas chu klung yid 'ong ldan du zhugs pa'i chu srin nya'i rigs bong tshod chen po zhig rgya mo spyod pa chen mos zin te/ chu nas skam la phyung zhing de la mgo bcwa ②brgyad dang mig sum bcu ④ma drug yod do zhes sgras khyab par gyur to/ /de thos nas srog chags brgya stong phrag du ma dag chu klung yid 'ong ldan gyi 'gram du lhags te/ kha cig ni ltad mo skyes par gyur/kha cig ni sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba dag gis bskul bar gyur to/ /rdzogs byed la sogs pa ⑤ston pa drug po yangs pa can na rten cing gnas pa de yidag kyang ltad mo skyes te der lhags so/ /skye bo'i ④tshogs chen po yang ya mtshan skyes te mig ②tshugs su rtog cing shes ldan dag 'di'i mgo la la ni glang po che'i mgo 0'dra la de nas rtog par 0byed/ 'di'i tsamago la la ni khyi'i bar gyi mgo 'dra la de nas rtog par byed do zhes kyang cizer ro/ /de'i skabs su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la ni mi mkhyen pa dang / mi tigazigs pa dang / ma rig pa dang /rnam par mi mkhyen pa cung zad kyang mi mnga' bas ④sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten la phan par zhugs ④pa/ bsrung ba gcig pu pa/ nyag gcig dpa' ba/ gnyis pa med pa/ gnyis su mi gsung ba/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gis bzhugs pa rig ⑩pa gsum gsal bar mdzad pa/ bslab pa gsum la legs par bslabs pa/ dul ba'i gnas 5—395

gsum gyi gzhi nyul mkhas pa/ chu bo bzhi las rgal ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhis spyod pa'i gzhi sel legs par gnas pa/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la yun ring po nas yongs su sbyang ba rdumadzad pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhis bsnyengs ④pa mi mnga' ba/ yan lag lnga spangs pa/ 'gro ba lnga las yang dag par 'das pa / yan lag drug dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu 5phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa/rtag tu gnas pa drug gis gnas pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi me tog gis phyug thopa/ lam gyi yan lag brgyad ston pa/ mthar gyis tsosnyoms par 'jug pa dgu la mkhas pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/ phyogs bcur snyan pas yang dag par rgyas pa/ brgya phrag bcur dbang sgyur ba las 3khyad par du 'phags pa rnams kyi chos nyid ni nyin lan gsum/ mtshan lan gsum sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs nas gang ni nyams par gyur( / gang ni 'phel bar gyur / gang ni gnod par gyur/ gang ni nyam nga bar gyur/ gang ni mi bde bar gyur/ gang ni gnod pa dang / nyam nga ba dang / mi bde bar gyur/ gang ni ngan song la gzhol/ gang ni ngan song la babanyunyu/ gang ni ngan song la 'babatsun/ ngas gang ni ngan song gi lam nas bslangs te zhu mtho ris dang / thar pa dang / 'bras bu la gzhag par bya/'dod pa'i 'dam du bying ba gang gi lag nas ni drang bar bya/ 'phags pa'i nor gyi dbyig dang bral ba gang ni 'phags pa'i nor gyi dbang phyug la gzhag par bya / gang gi sangs rgyas 'byung bas brgyan pa'i 'jig rten ni bya'abras bu dang bcas par bya/ /gang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba dag ma bskyed pa ni hu)bskyed par bya/gang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba dag bskyed pa ni yongs su smin par bya/ yongs su smin 5—396

pa gang yin pa ①ni rnam par grol bar bya zhes mkhyen pa dang / gzigs pa 'jug go/ /smras pa/ chu srin gnas ②kyi dug can pa/ /dus las 'da' bar 'gyur srid kyi/ /sangs rgyas gdul la ③byams pa ni/ /dus las 'da' bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar ma ni bu sdug gcig pu la/ /rtog cing de srog sung bar byed pa ltar/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'ang gdul ④ba'i skye bo la/ /rtog par mdzad cing de srog srung bar mdzad/ /kun mkhyen rgyud la mnga' ba'i thugs rje yi/ /gzhon ma gdul ba'i be'u tshol mi skyo ste/ /srid dang ngan 'gros nyams la byams pa ni/ /rab byams be'u la ⑤byams pa'i ba bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ chu srin nya'i rigs gnod pa dang/ nyam nga ba dang ⑥/ mi bde ba thob par gyur pa 'di ni sngon gyi sangs rgyas dag la bya ba lhag par byas pa yin gyis/ ngas chu srin nya'i rigs 'di la rten te 'dul ⑦bar gyur pa'i rgya mo chen mo drang bar byas/ de'i phyir chu klung yid 'ong ldan gyi 'gram du 'gro'o snyam mo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'tsho zhing bzhugs la gson ②zhing gzhes ⑨pa rnams kyis ༅chos nyid ni gdul bar gyur pa'i skye bo la rjes su thugs brtse bas dus dang dus su sems can dmyal ba rgyur gshegs pa dang / dud 'gro rgyu ba dang / /yi dgas rgyu ba dang / lha rgyu ba dang / ljongs rgyu ba dang / chu klung rgyu ba dang / ri rgyu ba dang / dur khrod rgyu ba dang /gtsug lag khang rgyur gshegs pas don 'dir ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chu ⑪klung rgyur gshegs par bzhed nas 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /chos nyid kyis na ⑫gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'dzum pa mdzad pa de'i tshe na zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang /5—397

btsod ka khyodang / shel dang / dngul gyi kha dog lta bu dag byung nas kha cig ni 'og logs su 'dong ②/ kha cig ni steng logs su 'dong bas gang dag 'og logs su 'dong ba de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / bsdus gzhom dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang /chu bur rdol ba ⑤dang / so thams thams dang / kyi ༷hud zer ⑤dang /a chu zer ba yidang / ut+pal ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa dang /pad ma ltar gas pa chen por dong ste/ sems can dmyal ba tsha ba gang dag yin pa ⑦de dag tu ni bsil bar gyur te 'bab par byed la/ sems can dmyal ba grang ba gang dag ②yin pa de dag tu ni 0dro bar gyur te 'bab ⑩par byed do/ /des sems can de dag gi gnod pa'i bye brag dag rgyun gcod par byed cing / de dag 'di snyam du shes ldan dag ci bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos sam / 'on te gzhan du skyes snyam du sems so/ /de dag dad pa bskyed par bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis sprul pa gtong bar mdzad de/ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du shes ldan dag bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos pa yang ma yin la/ gzhan du skyes pa yang ma yin te/ 'di ltar sems can sngon ma mthong ba 'di'i mthus bdag cag gi yiganod pa'i bye brag dag rgyun chad par gyur to 8snyam du sems so/ /de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dad par gyur nasal/ sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad par byas nas gang du 0bden pa dag gi snod du gyur par 'gyur ba'i lha dang mi rnams kyi tsonang du nying mtshams sbyor ba len par byed hūṃ/ /gang chadag steng logs tsos 'dong ⑩5—398

ba de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi pa dang / sum bcu ①ma gsum pa ②dang / 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / tshangs ris dang / tshangs pa'i mdun ②na 'don dang / tshangs chen dang / 'od chung dang / tshad med 'od dang / 'od gsal dang /dge chung dang / tshad med dge dang / dge rgyas ④dang / sprin med dang /bsod nams skyes dang / 'bras bu che dang / mi che ⑤dang / mi gdung ba dang / gya rnam snang dang / shin tu mthong ༅dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi nang du dong nas mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang /bdag med pa zhes bya ba'i sgra sgrogs ⑦par byed cing tshigs su bcad pa gnyis po//brtsam ⑧par bya zhing 'byung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya/ /gang zhig rab tu bag yod par/ /chos 'dul 'di la spyod 'gyur ba/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal tha mar byed par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba yang smras so/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis ⑨stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams byul nas/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi slad bzhin slad bzhin du rjes su 'dong ste/ de la gal te bcom ldan 'das 'das pa'i las ⑩lung ston par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi 7snam logs su nub par 'gyuratso/ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su nub par 'gyur/sems can dmyal bar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du nub par 'gyur/ dud 'gror skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni long bur nub par 'gyur / yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe 5—399

bor nub par 'gyur/ mir skye bar ①lung ston par bzhed na ni pus mor nub par 'gyur/ stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag mthil g.yon par nub par 'gyur/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag mthil g.yas par nub par 'gyur/ lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar nub par 'gyur/ nyan thos kyi byang chub lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du nub par 'gyur/ rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub lung ston par bzhed na ni mdzod spur nub par 'gyur/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ①lung ston par bzhed na ni gtsug tor du nub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi lte bar nub bo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu ma mchis rkyen ma mchis par 'dzum pa mi mdzad na/ btsun pa 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu ni gang lags/ rkyen ni gang lags/ tshigs su bcad pa yang gsol pa/ kha dog sna tshogs stong gis bkra ba yi/ /tshogs rnams zhal gyi sgo ③nas byung gyur te/ /de yis phyorges rnams thams cad snang bgyis pa/ /nyi ④gdugs bdal ⑤bar gyur pa ji bzhin no/ /rgod bral zhum dang rgyags pa rab spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas 'gro bar ⑥mchog gi rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thul byed rgyu ma mchis par/ /rtsa lag dung ltar dkar 'dzum ston mi mdzad/ /de slad brtan ⑦pa rang blos ⑧dus mkhyen nas/ /thub pa khyu mchog dge sbyong skye dbang po/ /nyan pa'i skye bo som nyi ldan rnams la/ /the tshom 0skyes pa gsung 5—400

tshig brtan ①pa dang / /dam pa dge ba dag gis bsal du gsol/ /tshwa ②chu ri rgyal lta bur brtan pa yis③/ /sangs rgyas mgon rnams glo bur 'dzum mi ston/ /brtan ①pa ci slad du'adzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /skye bo'i tshogs rnams de ni nyan par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /kun dga' bo de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ kun dga' bo de bzhin yigashegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad kyis/ kun dga' bo song la dge slong rnams la dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa chu klung rgyur gshegs bzhed kyis/ khyed cag las gang de bzhin gshegs pa dang / thabs cig ༅chu klung rgyur 'gro bar spro ba ⑧des chos gos dag long shig ces sgo 0shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas dge slong rnams la ⑩smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das chu klung rgyur gshegs bzhed kyis/khyed cag las gang bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig 7chu klung rgyur 'gro bar spro ba des chos gos dag long shig/ //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po bcu gnyis pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das dul ba 'khor dul ba tsodang ldan pa/ zhi ba 'khor zhi ba dang ldan pa/grol ba 'khor grol ba dang ldan pa/ dbugs phyin pa 'khor dbugs phyin pa dang ldan pa/ thul ba 'khor thul ba tsodang ldan pa/ dgra bcom pa 'khor dgra bcom pa dang ldan pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba 'khor 'dod chags dang bral ba chadang ldan pa/ mdzes pa 'khor mdzes pa dang ldan pa/ khyu mchog ltar ba lang gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ glang po che ltar glang po che'i phrug ⑫5—401

gu'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ seng ge ltar mche ba can gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ ngang pa'i rgyal po ltar ngang pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nam mkha' lding ltar bya'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ bram ze ltar slob ma'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ sman pa mkhas pa ltar nad pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ①ba/ dpa' bo ltar ru pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ sa mkhan ltar lam du zhugs pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ded dpon ltar tshong pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ tshong dpon ltar 'khor gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ mkhar gyi rgyal po ltar blon po'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ 'khor los sgyur ba ltar bu stong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ zla ba ltar rgyu skar gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nyi ma ltar 'od zer stong gi dutshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ yul 'khor srung ltar dri za'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ 'phags skyes po ltar grul bum gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ mig mi bzang ltar klu'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nor sbyin ltar gnod sbyin gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ thags zangs ris ②ltar lha ma yin gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ brgya byin ltar sum bcu ④ rtsa gsum ⑤pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ tshangs pa ⑥ltar tshangs ris kyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ dbang po rnams kyis shin tu dul brtsi/ spyod lam dang / spyod pa ma 'khrugs pa/ chu gter ltar ting nge ba/ sprin ltar chu dang bcas pa glang po che'i rgyal po ltar dregs pa dang bral ba/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu lartsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan pa/dpe byad bzang 0po brgyad bcus tshusku rnam par mdzes pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis ⑩5—402

gzugs can brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun du bzang ba/ stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum dang / thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ kun shes kauṇ+ḍi ①rgya dang / rlangs pa dang / ming ②chen dang / ma 'gags pa dang / shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu dang /'od srung dang / kun dga' bo dang / nam gru la sogs pa nyan thos chen po dag ③dang / gzhan yang dge slong gi dge 'dun mang pos bskor te chu klung yid 'ong ldan ga la ba der rgyu zhing gshegs so/ /'khor des thag ring po kho na nas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang gang dag ma dad pa de dag ni dge sbyong gau ༅ta ma ltad mo dang bral lo zhes grags ⑤na/ de la ⑥yang ltad mo skyes te chu srin nya'i rigs blta ba'i phyir nye bar 'ongs so zhes zer ro/ /gang dag dad pa dang ldan pa de dag ni ma dad pa de dag la shes ldan dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni ltad mo dang bral ba kho na yin te/ bcom ldan 'das chu srin nya'i rigs las brtsams te/ skye bo'i tshogs chen po la ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos cung zhig ston par bzhed gor ma chag go zhes zer zhing 'di skad ces kyang smras so/ /thub pa ltad mo bral ba'i dgongs ldan pa/ /ltad mo med la skye ngan don med smra/ /gzhan phan de la gzhol ba'i rgyal ba 'di/ /lus can phan phyir nges par 'dir gshegs so/ /de nas 'khor des bcom ldan 'das mthong nas 'phral kho na la ⑦mngon par langs te/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das sngon byang chub sems dpar gyur pas yab dang / yum dang / mkhan po dang / slob dpon dang / bla 5—403

ma dang / bla ma'i gnas lta bu dag la mngon par bzhengs pa ①mdzad mdzad ②pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor de'i dbus su gshegs te/dge slong gi chadage 'dun gyi gong du gdan bshams ④pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis nya pa lnga brgya bo de dag la bka' stsal pa/bzhin bzangs dag re zhig khyed cag ni nyes par byas pa'i las byed pa yin te/des na da ltar ⑤nya pa'i skye gnas dman par skyes shing khyed cag da ⑥ltar drag shul can/ lag pa khrag gis gos pa/ nyams pa ⑦rab tu nyams pa la zhen pa/gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa/ gzhan gyi srog gcod pas 'tsho ⑧bar byed de/ 'di ⑨nas shi 'phos na khyed cag gi 'gro ba ni cir 'gyur/ skye ba ni cir 'gyur/tshe phyi ma ni cir 'gyur/ de dag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis ci zhig bgyi ba bka' 455 du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nya dang / rus yi sbal dang / sbal pa dang / chu srin byis pa gsod dang / nya khyi ba la sogs pa 7chu nas bton ④pa 'di dag thong shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis ji skad cibaka' stsal pa bzhin gtang tsobar bgyi'o zhes de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyis 8bka' stsal pa'i dus kyi mjug thogs su de dag btang yingo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das ⑩'di snyam du dgongs te/ ngas ci nas kyang chu srin nya'i rigs ma gtogs pa nya dang / rus tsosngal dang / sbal pa dang / chu srin byis pa gsod dang / nya khyi ba la sogs pa'i srog chags 'di dag chu ji lta ba kho na bzhin du chu klung yid 'ong ldan du 'jug par 'gyur ba dang / chu srin nya'i rigs kyang sngon gyi skye ba rjes su dran ⑩zhing mi'i skad rjod ⑥par 'gyur la/ nga ⑥dang thabs cig ⑤smra bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul 5—404

mngon par 'du bya ba mngon par 'du bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ci nas kyang ②chu srin nya'i rigs ma gtogs pa nya dang / rus ①sbal dang /sbal pa dang / chu srin byis pa gsod dang / nya khyi ba la sogs pa'i srog chags de dag chu ji lta ba kho na bzhin du chu klung ③yid 'ong ldan du 'jug par 'gyur ba dang / chu srin nya'i rigs kyang sngon gyi skye ba rjes su dran zhing mi'i skad rjod ④par 'gyur la/ bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig ⑤smra bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba mngon par 'du mdzad do/ /de nas ⑥bcom ldan 'das kyis chu srin nya'i rigs la bka' stsal pa/ bu khyod ser skya yin nam/ bcom ldan 'das bdag ser skya lags so/ /bu khyod ser skya yin nam/ bde bar gshegs pa bdag ser skya lags so/ /bu khyod la lus kyis nyes par spyad pa yod dam/ bcom ldan 'das mchis ⑦so/ /pru khyod la ngag dang yid ④kyis nyes par spyad pa yod dam/ bde bar gshegs pa mchis so//bu khyod kyis lus kyis nyes par spyad pa'i rnam par smin pa nyams su myong ngam/bcom ldan 'das nyams su myong ngo / /bu khyod kyis ngag dang yid kyis ①nyes par spyad pa'i rnam par smin pa nyams su myong ngam/ bde bar gshegs pa nyams su myong ngo / /'o na khyod kyi mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen su yin/ bdag gi ma lags so/ /de gang du skyes sems can dmyal ba rnams su'o/ /khyod gang du skyes dud 'gror ro/ /ji snyam du sems/ khyod 'di nas shi 'phos nas gang du skye bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das sems can dmyal ba rnams su'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa sems can dmyal ba rnams su'o zhes gsol nas ngu ba la zhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa bka' 5wa 405

stsal pa/ khyod ①ni dud 'gro'i skye gnas skyes/ /mi khom zhugs par gyur pa la// da lta changs kyang ci byar med/ /don med ngus pas ①ci la phan/ /thugs rje ldan rgyal nga la ni/ /legs par sems ni dad ④gyis dang / /dud 'gro'i skye 'dir chags bral zhing / /de nas mtho ris 'gro bar 'gyur⑤/ /des bcom ldan 'das la sems dad par byas nas de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑥de la bzhin bzangs 'di ltar 'du byed thams cad ni mi rtag pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni bdag med pa'o/ /mya ngan las 'das pa ni zhi ba'o/ /zhes tshig ⑦gsum gyis chos bstan to/ /de nas 'khor de mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes nas shes ldan dag bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pas sngon gyi ②skye ba dran par byas shing mi'i skad kyang rjod ⑨par byed la/ bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig ⑩smra bar byed pa 'di su zhig yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bsten ⑪par dka' ba dang / bzod par dka' ba yin pas bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das la don de zhu bar 8mi nus kyis 8bdag cag 'phags pa kun dga' bo ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas 'phags pa kun dga' bo la don de zhu bar bya zhing 'phags pa kun dga' bos bdag cag la ji skad lung ston par 'gyur ba de de kho na bzhin du gzung ④bar bya'o zhes zer ro/ /de nas 8'khor de tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ga la ba 8der dong 0ste phyin nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces smras sotso/ /'phags pa kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' ⑩stsal pas/ sngon gyi skye ba dran par bgyis shing mi'i skad kyang rjod par bgyid la/ bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig ⑥ smra bar bgyid pa 'di su zhig lags/ kun dga' bos smras pa/ shes ldan dag bcom ldan 5wa 406

'das nyid la don de zhus shig /'phags pa kun dga' bo sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bsten par dka' ①ba dang / bzod par dka' ba lags pas bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das la don de zhu bar rngo mi thog gol/ /shes ldan dag kho bo la yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni ②bsten ④par dka' ba dang / bzod par dka' ba yin pas kho bos kyang bcom ldan 'das la don de zhu bar mi nus mod kyi/ 'on kyang khyed ⑤kyi don du zhu bar bya'o zhes smras nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ༅zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pas sngon gyi skye ba dran par bgyis ༅shing mi'i skad kyang rjod par bgyid ⑧la/ bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig smra ⑨bar bgyid pa 'di su zhig lags/ kun dga' bo 'di ni chu srin nya'i rigs yin no/ /kun dga' bo khyod chu srin nya'i rigs kyi sngon gyi ⑩las kyi rgyu ba las brtsams te chos dang ldan pa'i gtam nyan ⑩par 'dod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 8chu srin nya'i rigs kyi sngon gyi tsolas kyi rgyu ba las brtsams te dge slong rnams dang skye bo'i tshogs la chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid 8bka' stsal par gyur rten/ bcom ldan 'das las thos nas dge slong rnams dang skye bo'i tshogs dag ⑩'dzin par 'gyur bas bcom ldan 'das de ⑩ni dus lags rme/ /bde bar gshegs pa de 8ni dus lags so/ /kun dga' bo de'i phyir nyon la legs par rab tu yid la gyis shig dang bshad par bya'o/ /kun dga' bo sngon byung ba bskal pa chen po bzang po 'di nyid la 5—407

skye ①dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig ②pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i ②kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de dge slong nyi khris bskor cing grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī ④na drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na nye bar brten cing bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī ⑤na rgyal po kṛ tī ⑥zhes bya bas rgyal srid 'byor pa/rgyas pa/ bde ba/ lo legs pa/ skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba/ thab ⑦mo dang / 'thab pa dang / phyi dgra dang / nang 'khrug ⑧rab tu zhi ba/chom rkun dang / mu ge dang / nad dang bral ba/ sā lu dang / bu ram ⑨shing gi phreng ba dang / ba lang dang / ma he phun sum tshogs pa byed du bcug ste / chos dang ldan pa chos kyi rgyal pos chos kyis ⑩rgyal srid byed du bcug go/ /de nas shed bu gsang tshig 'dod pa gsang tshig 7tshol ba zhig yul dbus nas lho lam du song ngo / /de na bram ze rig byed chadang rig byed kyi yan lag gi pha rol du son pa/ yul tha dad pa na tsoganas pa'i bram ze rnams kyi ston cipar gyur pa zhig 'dug nas/ shed bu de bram ze de'i drung du song ste phyin nas zhi ba dang spyod lam zhi bas mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas bram ze des shed bu de la 'ongs pa legs so zhes bya ba'i tshig gis kun du spyad nas smras pa/ kye shed bu khyod ga las 'ongs/ ci zhig 'dod/ shed bus smras pa/ bdag yul dbus nas mchis te mkhan po'i zhabs la sri zhu ④bgyid par 'tshal lo/ /ci zhig gi phyir/ rig byed bklag ⑩pa'i slad du'o/ /shed 5wa 408 4 snye

bu legs kyis de bzhin gyis shig /de ni bram zes bya ba yin no/ /shed bu des bram ze de'i ①drung du rig byed bklag par ②bya bar brtsams so/ /shed bu rnams kyi kun tu spyod pa ni 'di yin te/ gang gi tshe mi klog par gyur pa de'i tshe na lan 'ga' ni chu ngogs su nye reg byed du ①'dong ngo / /lan 'ga' ni grong khyer ltar 'dong ngo / /lan 'ga' ni yam ④srog shing thur 'dong ngo / /ji ⑤tsam dus ⑥gzhan zhig na de dag mi klog par gyur nas de'i tshe de dag yam sreg shing thur dong ba dang / de dag la lam gyi bar du bar skabs kyi gtam rjod pa 'di lta bu 'di byung ste/ kye kud sa'i rigs dag /bad sa'i rigs dag /shan di la'i rigs dag /ba ra dwa dza'i rigs dag / lnga pa'i rigs dag /⑦nye lnga'i rigs dag je khyed cag las gang ni yul ga las 'ongs pa dri bar ⑧bya'o/ /de na shed bu gcig ②gis smras pa/ kho bo ni yul shar nas so/ /gzhan zhig gis smras pa/ kho bo ni lho lam nas so/ /yang gzhan zhig gis smras pa/ kho bo ni nub kyi sa byanas so/ /yang gzhan zhig gis smras pa/ kho bo ni byang lam nas so/ /shed bu des smras pa/ kho bo ni yul dbus nas so/ /de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag gis yul thams cad mthong zhing thos na ⑫yul dbus ni tsom mthong ma thos so/ /shar na blo can gnas pa ste/ /lho lam na ni yon byed 'dug /nub kyi yul na phra ma can/ /byang lam na ni tshig rtsub bo / /zhes tshigs su bcad pa yang smras so/ /de nas dris pa/ shed bu yul dbus ci 'dra/ shes ldan dag yul dbus ni yul rnams kyi mchog yin te/sā lu dang / bu ram shing gi phreng ba dang ba lang dang / ma he phun sum tshogs pa / slong tsomo ba brgyas khyab pa/ dbus pa'i skye bos gang ba mtha' 'khob 5—409

pa'i skye bos spangs pa/ skye bo mkhas pas bsten pa/ de na chu klung gang gā ①kha rje dang / bsod nams dang / bkra shes dang / gtsang ba dang /gtsang ba nyid kyi gnas su grags pa/ 'gram gnyis nas rlan 'phyo ba/ drang srong rnams kyi bste ②gnas zhes bya ba chu dgur bcwa ③brgyad 'bab pa yod de/der drang srong rnams kyis dka' ⑤thub spyad na rang gi lus nyid kyis mtho ris su 'dong ba yin no/ /kye shed bu de ni mjal gyis ⑤gzhan 'di dri'o༅/ /yul dbus na ⑦mkhas par bgrang ba dag yod dam/ shes ldan dag kho bos dang po nyid nas shes ldan dag yul dbus ni dbus pa'i skye bos gang ba/ 'thab 'khob ⑤pa'i skye bos spangs pa/ skye bo mkhas pas bsten pa'o zhes ma smras sam/ shed bu khyod kyis de skad smras so/ /shed bu yul dbus na 'di lta ste/ dper na bdag cag gi mkhan po dang 'dra ba smra ba'i khyu mchog de lta bu dag yod dam/shes ldan dag yul dbus na bdag cag gi mkhan pos gang dag gi gdong du lta bar yang mi nus pa snyan par smra ba smra ba'i khyu mchog de lta bu dag yod do/ /shed bu des ⑨de dag la de lta de ltar yul dbus kyi bsngags pa brjod pa dang /'di ltar de dag thams cad yul dbus su 'dong 'dod par gyur to/ /de nas shed bu de dag gis yam sreg shing dag btsal te/ yam sreg shing gi ⑨ khur thogs nas bram ze de'i khyim ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas yam sreg shing gi khur mtha' gcig spre)tu bzhag ste bram ze de ga la ba der dong nas spre)phyin pa dang /bram ze de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /mkhan po mkhyen par mdzod cig /shed bu 'dis ci nas kyang bdag cag thams cad yul dbus su mchi 'tshal bar gyur pa de ltar yul dbus kyi ⑩bsngags pa brjod do/ /bram ze des smras pa/ bu 5—410

dag ci ji ①sted thos pa de snyed bgrod par bya ba yin nam/ 'di ltar yul dag ni thos na ②dga' bar 'gyur ba yin pas mnyan ③par bya'i bgrod par ni mi bya'o//mkhan po shed bu 'di'i mchid nas yul dbus na bdag cag gi mkhan pos gang dag gi gdong du lta bar yang ④mi nus pa snyan ⑤par smra ba smra ba'i khyu mchog de lta bu dag mchis so zhes mchi'o/ /bu dag ci kho bo na re sa'i steng na kho bo gcig pu kho na smra ba yin gyis ⑨smra ba gzhan 'ga' yang med do zhes zer ram/ sa cani rin po che mang po ⑦'dzin pa yin pas ⑤sa gzhi ni mdzes pa mdzes pa dag gis gang ba yin no0/ /mkhan po re zhig yul de yang mthong bar 'gyur zhing chu ngogs su nye reg kyang bgyi/ smra ba'i khyu mchog de dag la yang bsnyen bkur bgyi/rgol ba dag kyang tshar gcad ⑩par bgyi/ rang gi grags pa yang bsgrag par bgyi/ rnyed pa yang bsgrub par bgyis/ bdag cag yul dbus su mchi'o༅/ /bram ze de slob ma la 8rjes su chags pa dang bcas pa dang 'khor nyung ba yin pas des shed bu de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu dag gal te de lta na g.yang gzhi ⑫dag dang / shing shun dag dang / dbyug gu dag dang / blugs tsogazar dag dang / dgang gzar dag dang /tso ril ba dag long shig dang yul dbus su 'dong ④ngo / /de dag gis de dag blangs nas bram ze de shed bu de dag dang lhan cig yul dbus su 'phags pa dang / des rgol ba kha cig ni ⑩tshar bcad de rgol ba'i shing rta la sbyor bar byed/ kha cig ni mgor thal ba'i bum pa dag gis bsnun/ kha cig ni 'phong gi dpong tsosar khu bzhin du thag ring po nas yongs su spong bar byed/ kha cig ni gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis bsu bar byed/ kha cig ni slob ma nyid du khas len 5—411
