mtshan nyid 'dzin pa cung zad cig ①la brten nas 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis nyon mongs pa dag rnam par mnan pas 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang / gnod sems dag rgyud la kun du ②mi 'byung nas/ dge slong gis 'du shes bsgyur cing bzod pa dang / 'dod pa dang / blo gros dang / rtog pa dang / lta ba bsgyur te 'di skad ces bdag kyang grong med pa'i dgon pa'i gnas de na gnas shing bdag gis kyang de na gnas pa na zhi gnas kyi rgyu mtshan rang gi mtshan nyid 'dzin ③pa cung zad cig la brten nas 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis nyon mongs pa dag rnam par mnan pas 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang / gnod sems dag bdag gi ④rgyud la yang kun du ⑤mi 'byung ngo zhes zer na/ nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis bdag nyid la nye bar ston pas 'du shes bsgyur ducing bzod pa dang / 'dod pa dang / blo gros dang / rtog pa dang / lta ba bsgyur te 'di skad ces dge slong gang gis lha rnams mthong ba de yod do zhes zer zhing 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams nas snga ma bzhin du lus srul po rnams kyi bar du mthong ba yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /tha na 'di skad ces dge slong gang gis rdul khrod kyi sha za rnams mthong ba de yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi gzer na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis bdag nyid la nye bar ston pas 'du shes bsgyur cing bzod pa dang / 'dod pa dang /blo gros dang / rtog pa dang / lta ba bsgyur te 'di skad ces dge slong gang gis lha rnams kyi sgra thos pa de yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o 5—462

zhes ni mi zer na ①nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /klu rnams dang/ gnod sbyin rnams nas snga ma bzhin du lus srul po rnams kyi bar gyi sgra thos pa yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro//tha na 'di skad ces dge slong gang gis rdul khrod kyi sha za rnams kyi sgra thos pa de yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis bdag nyid la nye bar ston pas 'du shes bsgyur cing bzod pa dang / 'dod pa dang / blo gros dang / rtog pa dang / lta ba bsgyur te 'di skad ces dge slong gang lha rnams blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba de yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams nas snga ma bzhin du lus srul po rnams ②kyi bar du blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba de ②yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /tha na 'di skad ces dge slong gang rdul khrod kyi sha za rnams blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba de yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis ④bdag nyid la nye bar ston pas 'du shes bsgyur cing bzod pa rjodang / 'dod pa dang / blo gros dang / rtog pa dang / lta ba bsgyur te 'di skad ces dge slong gang la lha rnams blta ba'i phyir 'ong ba de yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro//klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams nas snga ma bzhin du lus srul po rnams kyi bar du blta ba'i phyir 'ong ba ⑦yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces tsokho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /tha na 'di skad ces dge slong 5—463

gang la rdul ①khrod kyi sha za rnams blta ba'i phyir 'ong ba yod do zhes zer zhing /'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis bdag nyid la nye bar ston pas 'du shes bsgyur cing bzod pa dang / 'dod pa dang / blo gros dang / rtog pa dang / lta ba bsgyur ②te 'di skad ces dge slong gang lha rnams dang lhan cig gtam 'dre ③bar byed/ phebs par smra bar byed / so sor kun dga' bar byed/ rtag tu yang lhan cig gnas par byed pa de yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams nas snga ma bzhin du lus srul po rnams kyi bar dang lhan cig gtam 'dre bar byed/ phebs par smra bar byed/ so sor kun dga' bar byed/ rtag tu yang lhan cig gnas par byed pa de yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /tha na 'di skad ces dge slong gang rdul bokhrod kyi sha za rnams dang lhan cig gtam 'dre bar byed/ phebs par smra bar byed/ so sor kun dga' bar byed/ rtag tu yang lhan cig gnas par byed pa de duyod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o ༅zhes ni mi zer na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis bdag nyid la nye bar ston pas 'du shes bsgyur cing bzod pa dang / 'dod pa dang / blo gros dang / rtog ⑦pa dang / lta ba bsgyur te 'di skad ces dge slong gang chadang lhan cig lha rnams ⑨gtam 'dre bar 0byed/ phebs par smra bar byed/ so sor kun dga' bar byed/ rtag tu yang lhan cig gnas par byed pa de yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /klu rnams dang / gnod 5—464

sbyin rnams nas snga ma bzhin du lus srul po rnams kyi bar yang lhan cig gtam 'dre bar byed/ phebs par smra bar byed/ so sor kun dga' bar byed/rtag tu yang lhan cig gnas par byed pa de yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /tha na 'di skad ces dge slong gang dang lhan cig rdul khrod kyi sha za rnams ①gtam 'dre bar byed/phebs par smra bar byed/ so sor kun dga' bar byed/ rtag tu yang lhan cig gnas par byed pa de yod do ② zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis bdag nyid la nye bar ston pas 'du shes bsgyur cing bzod pa dang / 'dod pa dang / blo gros dang /rtog pa dang / lta ba bsgyur te 'di skad ces dge slong gang gis mi rtag pa'i 'du shes thob pa de yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /mi rtag pa'i 'du shes ji lta ba de bzhin du gang gis snga ma bzhin du stong pa nyid du so sor rtog pa'i 'du shes kyi bar du thob pa de yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis bdag nyid la nye bar ston pas 'du shes bsgyur cing bzod pa dang / 'dod pa dang / blo gros dang / rtog pa dang /lta ba bsgyur te 'di skad ces dge slong gang ②gis bsam gtan dang po thob pa de yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan dang po ji lta ba de bzhin du gang gis snga ma bzhin du gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa nas dge slong gang dgra bcom pa rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam gtan pa dang / gnyi ga'i cha las 5—465

rnam par grol ba'i bar de yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar dge slong rab tu mang po dag grong med pa'i dgon pa'i ①gnas shig na gnas shing de la de dag na ②mi ma yin pa dag gis 'tshe ba na de ③dge slong gang rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan gcig ④phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa yin pa de la de na ⑤mi ma yin pa dag gis 'tshe bar mi byed nas dge slong gis bdag nyid la nye bar ston pas 'du shes bsgyur cing bzod pa dang / 'dod pa dang /blo gros dang / rtog pa dang / lta ba bsgyur te 'di skad ces dge slong gang grong med pa'i dgon pa'i gnas de na gnas pa de la de na mi ma yin pa rnams 'tshe bar mi byed pa de yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar dge slong rab tu mang po dag khyim rnams su mgron ༅du bos te za bar byed cing de na de dag la stan khra bo nye bar bkra ba dag bshams shing de na dge slong gang rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan gcig ⑦phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa yin pa de la de na ①stan khra bo nye bar bkra ba dag shom par byed nas/ dge slong gis bdag nyid la nye bar ston pas 'du shes bsgyur cing bzod pa dang / 'dod pa dang / blo gros dang / rtog ⑨pa dang / lta ba bsgyur 0te 'di skad ces dge slong gang khyim der mgron yidu bos shing zos te/ de na de la yang stan khra bo nye bar bkra ba dag shom par byed pa de yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar dge slong rab tu mang po dag dgon pa na gnas pa dag gis zhi gnas kyi rgyu mtshan rang gi mtshan 5—466

nyid 'dzin pa cung zad cig la brten nas 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis nyon mongs pa dag rnam par mnan pas 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang / gnod sems dag rgyud la kun du mi 'byung nas dge slong gis bdag nyid la nye bar ston ①pas 'du shes bsgyur cing bzod pa dang / 'dod pa dang / blo gros dang / rtog pa dang / lta ba bsgyur te 'di skad ces dge slong gang gis grong med pa'i dgon pa'i gnas de na gnas shing zhi gnas kyi rgyu mtshan rang gi mtshan nyid 'dzin pa cung zad cig la brten nas 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis nyon mongs pa dag rnam par mnan pas 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang / gnod sems dag rgyud la kun du mi 'byung ba de yod do zhes zer zhing / 'di skad ces kho bo'o zhes ni mi zer na nyes byas su 'gyur ro// //sdom la/ phan tshun zhe ni 'gras pa dang / /char 'bab pa ②dang mtshan gyur dang / /rgyal po'i ②khab kyi chu dron ④dang / /glang chen rnams kyi sgra skad do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can na spre'u ⑤dzing gi 'gram khang pa brtsegs pa'i khang bzangs ⑦na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga ṅgār byung ba'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra dang / yangs pa can gyi lits+tsha bī ⑦rnams phan tshun zhe ⑧'gras par gyur to/ /de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga ṅgār byung ba'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi po 0glang po che pa'i tshogs dang / rta pa'i tshogs dang / shing rta pa'i tshogs dang /dpung bu chung gi tshogs go bskon te/ yul spong byed gzhom par brtsams pa dang / yul spong byed na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs kyis yangs pa can gyi lits+tsha bī ⑩rnams la shes ldan dag lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga d+mar byung ba'i rgyal po ma 5—467

skyes dgras dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi po ༅glang po che pa'i tshogs dang / rta pa'i tshogs dang / shing rta pa'i tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi tshogs go bskon te zhuyul spong byed 'joms par byed do zhes ra mda' ba bzlog go/ /yangs pa can gyi lits+tsha bī 〈rnams kyis thos nas de dag gis kyang dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi po 5glang po che pa'i tshogs dang / rta pa'i tshogs dang / shing rta pa'i tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi tshogs go bskon te/ yangs pa can nas 'byung slebar brtsams pa dang / de dag 'byung ba na tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po yang snga dro sham /thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te yangs pa can du bsod snyoms la zhugs so/ /yangs pa can gyi lits+tsha bī 3rnams kyis satshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po thag ring po kho na nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ shes ldan dag 'di ni mchog gsum pa yin te/ 'dis mi shes pa'am/ ma nyamathong ba'am ma rig pa'am / rnam par mi shes pa cung zad kyang med do zhes grag gis bdag cag gis / 'di la bdag cag gang rgyal bar 'gyur ba dri bar bya'o snyam nas/de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi nyu bu chen po la dris pa/ 'phags pa lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga sgyur byung ba'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras yul spong byed 'joms par bgyis nyu3pas bdag cag g.yul 'gyed nyu)pa'i slad du mngon du mchis sku na/ bdag cag gang rgyal bar 'gyur/ mod gal gyi bu chen pos smras pa / ba siṣ+ṭha'i hūṃ )rigs dag khyed cag rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag 'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bdag cag rgyal bar lung bstan to zhes rangs pa dang / dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang /⑫5—468

yid bde ba ༅skyes zhunas lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga d+mar byung ba'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra ②ma brtsis par ④tsham tshom med pa kho nar de'i steng du brtul ba dang / de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga ṅgār byung ba'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra pham pa dang /skrag pa dang / bcom pa dang phye/ gzhan rgyal ba dang / rgyab kyis phyogs par byas te/ chu klung gang gā'i 'u'agram du phyin to/ /yangs pa can gyi lits+tsha bī ⑦rnams rgya cher rab tu dga' ba'i yid kyis phyi dubazhin kho nar 'brang ba dang /lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga d+mar byung ba'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras spubasams pa/yangs pa can gyi lits+tsha bī sku 'di dag ni gdug cing rnam par gnon pa yin pas gal te bdag gang gā'i zhu nang du zhugs na yang 'od tsuX dag gis rgya mo'am mchil 8pas dbyung bas 'byin par byed cing tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ba'i gnas yod kyis ci — bdag mngon du phyogs te shi ba ni legs so snyam du rig nas / des 'chi ba'i shugs kyis bsngos pa dang / dpung thams cad phyir log nas yangs pa can gyi lits+tsha bī nyu rnams pham pa dang / skrag pa dang /bcom pa dang / gzhan rgyal ba dang / rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas/gar yang ma 'khor bar yangs pa can du zhugs nas/ sgo dag bcad de ra ba'i khar sbrengs nas 'dug go/ /lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga ṅgār byung ba'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra tshagayul las rnam par rgyal zhing yul spong byed bcom nas rgyal po'i khab tu song ngo / /de nas yangs pa can gyi lits+tsha bī nyu)rnams lam po che dang /srang dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo dag na 'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos khyed cag rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bdag cag la lung bstan na/de ci gal te bdag cag gi yangs pa can phrogs par gyur na de lta na rgyal bar 5—469

'gyur ram zhes smod par byed/ phyar kha ①gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed dol/ /de dag smod par byed pa na drug sde dag kyang bsod snyoms la zhugs nas de dag gis de dag ②'phya ba thos nas drug sde dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed ①cag su la smod/ khyed cag la'o/ /④'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos khyed cag rgyal bar 'gyur ro zhes bdag cag la lung bstan na/ de ci gal te bdag cag gi yangs pa can phrogs par gyur na de lta na rgyal bar 'gyur ram/drug sde dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag dang por g.yul sprad pa gang yin pa der su rgyal/ kho bo cag go/ /gal te khyed cag rgyal na de'i 'og tu ci'i phyir ⑤ldog par mi byed/ ci yul ma ga dhā ⑥bcom ste rgyal po'i ༅khab len par 'dod dam / khyed cag gis ha cang mnan na wa yang seng ge lta bur 'gyur ro zhes bya ba ma thos sam/ de dag spobs pa med par gyur nas cang mi smra bar 'khod pa dang / drug sde dudag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' de dag la go bar byas zin mod kyi zhu'on kyang don nyung ngu de la ltung ba byung gis tshur sheg 8de'i gan du dong la 'chags su gzhug go zhes de dag zas kyi bya ba byas nas phyag 'tshal te tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ga la ba byuder dong nas phyin pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gnas brtan phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag a rog gya'i/ gnas brtan je 8skabs phye shig /tshe dang ldan pa dag ltung ba sde lnga (stedag la skabs phye'o/ /gnas brtan gyis (nyeyangs pa can gyi lits+tsha bī ⑩rnams la rgyal bar lung bstan tam/lung bstan to/ /ci gal te de dag gi yangs pa can phrogs par gyur na de lta ⑩na rgyal bar 'gyur ram/ khyod lhung bzed nag pos 'tsho bar mi byed pas des 5—470

na kun shes pa brda sprod par byed cing de yang 'bras bu med par gyur te/ khyod kyis spyod yul bsregs pas bdag cag gis bsod snyoms kyang mi rnyed kyis/khyod ①la ltung ba byung ba de chos bzhin du slar mdzod cig /tshe dang ldan pa dag ltung ba ma mthong ngo / /drug sde dag gis ②smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis ltung ba ma mthong ba'i phyir gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya'o zhes gsungs pas de'i phyir 'di la ci'i phyir ③lhag par btang snyoms su bya/khang skyong su yin/ che ge mo zhig go/ /bos shig /bos so/ /tshe dang ldan pa gaṇ+ḍi rdungs ④shig /mod dugal gyi bu chen po don nyung ngu la ltung ba byung ba chos bzhin du phyir mi byed pas/ de ltung ba ma mthong ba'i phyir gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya'o/ /khang skyong dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan ⑥gyi gan du song ba dang / drug sde dag kyang de dang lhan ⑦cig dong ngo / /de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan byed de/ de rtag tu gaṇ+ḍi dubardungs pa na tshe dang ldan pa su zhig yongs su gnas pa'am/ gzhi nas yongs su gnas pa'am / mgu bar bya ba'am/ gzhi nas mgu bar bya ba'am/ 'byin par byed ces chos kyi dbang du byas te rmed ⑨par byed do/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa/gnas brtan su 'ang ⑩yongs su gnas pa ⑩'am/ gzhi nas yongs su gnas pa'am / mgu bar bya ba'am/ gzhi nas mgu bar bya ba'am/ 'byin par ⑫mi bgyid de/ 'di ltar 8tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos 'drums pa ltung bas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa 'dral bar bgyid de/ lhung bzed nag pos 'tsho bar mi bgyid pas des na ④mi'i chos bla ma dam 'cha' 8zhing kun shes pa brda sprod par bgyid de/ de yang 'bras bu ma mchis par gyur nas des spyod 5—471

yul bsregs pas bdag cag gis bsod snyoms kyang mi rnyed de/ de la ltung ba byung ba chos bzhin du slar mi bgyid pas de ltung ba ma mthong ba'i slad du gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag dge slong gnas brtan la tho ①ma btsams ②par 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di thams cad mkhyen pa / thams cad gzigs pa/ mkhyen pa dang shes bya dag la bla na med pa'i mnga' brnyes pa/ the tshom ②thams cad gcod par mdzad pa yin gyis de'i spyan sngar dong ④la don 'di zhus shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis khyed la ji skad lung ston pa de de kho na bzhin du zung shig /skabs de dge slong phyedag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag g.yul ngor dang por ⑥mi ma yin pa dag g.yul 'gyed cing / de'i 'og tu mi rnams g.yul 'gyed de/ gang du mi ma yin pa rnams rgyal bar 'gyur ba der mi rnams kyang rgyal bar 'gyur bas de'i phyir dge slong mod gal gyi bu chen pos yangs pa can gyi lits+tsha bī ⑦rnams la lung bstan pa de'i tshe na yangs pa can pa'i mi ma yin pa rnams kyis rgyal po'i khab pa'i mi ma yin pa rnams pham par byas so/ /gang gi tshe de dag gang gā'i ⑧ 'gram du phyin pa de'i tshe rgyal po'i ⑨khab pa'i mi ma yin pa dag gis yangs pa can pa'i mi ma yin pa dag pham par byas so/ /gal te dge slong mod gal gyi bu chen po la de yang dris par gyur na/dge slong mod gal gyi bu chen pos de yang lung ston par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag dge slong mod gal gyi bu chen pos ⑩'du shes de lta bus lung bstan 0pa la ltung ba med do/ /ji ltar yangs pa can pa dag gis sngar rgyal bar byas nas/phyis rgyal po ma skyes tsodagras gang gā'i tso'agram du 'chi 8ba'i shugs kyis bsngos 5—472

pas pham par byas pa de bzhin du rgyal po ma skyes dgras sngar rgyal bar ①byas nas/phyis yangs 3pa can pa de dag gis gang gā'i du'agram du 'chi byaba'i shugs kyis bsngos nas pham par byas pa yang de bzhin rgyas par sbyar bar bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can na 'uspre'u rdzing gi 'gram khang pa brtsegs pa'i khang bzangs na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na mu stegs can rnams kyis lo rdzobacu gnyis su than pa 'byung bar bstan to/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te yangs pa can du bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / de la yangs pa can gyi lits+tsha bī hūṃrnams kyis dris pa/ 'phags pa yun ji srid kyis lhas char 'bebs par 'gyur/des smras 3pa/ shes ldan dag nyi ma bdun 'das nas so/ /de dag 'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos nyi ma bdun 'das nas lhas char 'bebs par 'gyur ro / /zhes lung bstan to zhes de dag gis 9khyim dang bang ba na 'dug 7pa'i 'bru gang dag yin pa de dag kyang phyi rol du cho khyer te bor ro/ /ji tsam na nyi ma glubadun 'das nas lhas 'brug cho bsgrags shing sgra byung ci nas sa rgyas btab ste btang ba dang / de dag lam po che dang / srang dang / bzhi mdo dang /sum mdo dag na shes ldan dag mu stegs can rnams dam pa yin gyis/ shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong rnams ni de lta ma yin te/ rtag tu 'gro ba'i shing ljon sapa bzhin du ngur smrig dag gis lus dag dkris shing 'khod par zad kyi cung zad kyang mi shes so zhes smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed do/ /de dag smod par byed pa na drug sde dag kyang bsod snyoms la zhugs nas de dag gis de dag smod pa thos nas drug sde dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed cag 5—473

su la smod/ khyed cag la'o/ /nged kyis ci byas/ mu stegs can rnams kyis lo bcu gnyis su than pa 'byung bar ①bstan na 'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos nyi ma bdun 'das nas lhas char 'bebs par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan nas/bdag cag gis khyim dang bang ba na 'dug pa'i 'bru gang dag yin pa de dag kyang phyi rol du khyer te bor na lhas char ma phab bo/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa/shes ldan dag mu stegs can ②kun du spyod pa ni gal te sprin kyang yod/ sprin las 'brug kyang grag /glog ①kyang 'byung / phyogs bzhi nas rlung bsil ba dag kyang ldang / lhas khad kyis dal bu dal bus char cung zad ④'bebs pa de'i tshe na de dag dang / 'jig rten dag kyang lhas gdon mi za bar char 'bebs so zhes zer na/ char cher bab cing sa rgyas btab par gyur na lta smos kyang ci dgos pa yin no/ /'di ltar ji 'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos lo tog thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan tam/ de dag spobs pa med par gyur nas cang mi smra bar 'khod pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' de dag la go bar byas zin mod kyi 'on kyang don nyung ngu de ⑤la ltung ba byung gis tshur sheg /de'i gan du dong la 'chags su gzhug go/ /zhes de dag zas kyi bya ba byas nas phyag 'tshal te/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ga la ba der dong nas phyin pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod khyagal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gnas brtan phyag 'tshal lo//tshe dang ldan pa dag a rog gya②/ gnas brtan ji laskabs phye shig /tshe dang ldan pa dag ltung ba sde lnga po dag la skabs phye'o/ /mu stegs can ⑨rnams kyis lo bcu gnyis su than pa 'byung ngo ⑩zhes bstan na/ khyod kyis char 'bab 7par 5—474

'gyur ro zhes lung bstan gyis/ chos gos kyi grwa rdzab kyis ma rungs par gyur na mi rung ①gis theg shig /khyod lhung bzed nag pos ③'tsho bar mi byed pas des na kun shes pa brda sprod par byed cing de yang 'bras bu med par gyur te/ khyod kyis spyod ②yul bsregs pas bdag cag gis dubasod snyoms kyang mi rnyed kyis/khyod la ltung ba byung ba de chos bzhin du slar mdzod cig /tshe dang ldan pa dag ltung ba ma mthong ngo / /drug sde rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis ltung ba ma mthong ba'i phyir gnas nas rjodabyung ba'i las bya'o zhes gsungs pas de'i phyir 'di la ci'i phyir lhag par btang snyoms su bya/khang skyong su yin/ che ge mo zhig go/ /bos shig /bos so/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag gaṇ+ḍi rdungs ⑥shig /mod gal gyi bu chen po don nyung ngu ⑦cing ba byung ba chos bzhin du phyir mi byed pas de ltung ba ma mthong ba'i phyir gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya'o/ /khang skyong dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyi gan du song ba dang /drug sde dag kyang de dang lhan cig dong ngo / /de'i tshe ③tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan ⑨byed de/ de rtag tu gaṇ+ḍi brdungs pa na tshe dang ldan pa su zhig yongs su gnas pa'am/ gzhi nas ( )yongs su gnas pa'am/mgu bar bya ba'am/ gzhi nas mgu bar bya ba'am/ 'byin par byed ces chos kyi dbang du byas pa rmed 47par byed do/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa/gnas brtan su yang yongs su gnas pa'am/ gzhi nas yongs su gnas pa'am/mgu bar bya ba'am/ gzhi nas tsomagu bar bya ba'am/ 'byin par mi bgyid ⑫de / 'di ltar tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos 'brums pa ltung bas bcom ldan 'das kyi ④bstan pa 'dral bar bgyid de8/ lhung bzed nag 0pos 5—475

'tsho bar mi bgyid pas des ①na mi'i chos bla ma dam 'cha' ②zhing kun shes pa brda sprod ①par bgyid de de yang 'bras bu ma mchis par gyur nas/ des spyod yul bsregs pas bdag cag gis bsod snyoms kyang mi rnyed de/ de la ltung ba byung ba chos bzhin du slar mi bgyid pas de ltung ba ma mthong ba'i slad du gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag dge slong gnas brtan la tho ma btsams ④par 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di thams cad mkhyen pa / thams cad gzigs pa/ mkhyen pa dang / shes bya dag la bla na med pa'i mnga' brnyes ༅pa the tshom ⑥thams cad gcod par mdzad pa yin gyis de'i spyan sngar deng ༅la don 'di zhus shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis khyed ④la ji skad ⑨lung ston pa de de kho na bzhin du zung hu shig /skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag 'di dag ni ltas mkhan dag gis lhas ༅char 'bebs par 'gyur ro//zhes ston kyang mi rtog 6pa than pa chen po'i rgyu lnga dang rkyen lnga yin te/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'di ltar sprin kyang 8yod/ glog 6kyang 'byung / sprin las 'brug kyang grag /phyogs bzhi nas rlung bsil ba dag kyang ldang / ltas mkhan dag kyang lhas char 'bebs par 'gyur ro zhes ston mod kyi/ 'on kyang sa gzhi chen po 'di las me'i khams mngon par 'phags nas des char pa de bar ma dor 'kho nar skams ⑩par byed de⑩/ 'di ni ltas mkhan dag gis lhas char 'bebs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes 8ston kyang mi rtogs ⑩pa than pa chen po'i rgyu dang po dang rkyen dang po yin no/ /gzhan yang sprin yang yod/ glog ( tre kyang 'byung /sprin las 'brug kyang grag 0 /phyogs bzhi nas rlung bsil ba dag kyang ldang /5—476

ltas mkhan dag kyang lhas char 'bebs par 'gyur ro zhes ston mod kyi①/ 'on kyang nam mkha' la mi mnyam pa'i rlung dag ldang zhing des char pa de daṇ+ḍa ②ka'i dgon pa dag dang / ka ling ku'i dgon pa dag dang / ma tang ma'i dgon pa dag tu 'bebs par byed de/ 'di ni ltas mkhan dag gis lhas char 'bebs par 'gyur ro zhes ston kyang mi rtogs ②pa than pa chen po'i rgyu gnyis pa dang / rkyen gnyis pa yin no/ /gzhan yang sprin yang ④yod/ glog kyang 'byung / sprin las 'brug kyang grag⑤ /phyogs bzhi nas rlung bsil ba dag kyang ldang / ltas mkhan dag kyang lhas char 'bebs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes ston mod kyi 'on kyang lha'i bu char gyi shugs can dag rab tu myos par gnas pa dang / bag med par gnas shing de dag rab tu myos par gnas pa dang /bag med par gnas pas lhas yidus dang dus su chu'i rgyun legs par 'bebs su mi ster te/ 'di ni ltas mkhan dag gis lhas char 'bebs par 'gyur ro zhes ston kyang mi rtogs ⑦pa than pa chen po'i rgyu gsum pa dang rkyen gsum pa yin no/ /gzhan yang sprin yang niyod/ glog 0kyang 'byung / sprin las 'brug kyang grag /phyogs bzhi nas rlung bsil ba dag kyang ldang / ltas mkhan dag kyang lhas char 'bebs par 'gyur ro zhes ston mod kyi/ 'on kyang mi rnams chos ma yin pa'i 'dod chags kyis chags pa dang / 'dod pa dga' 0bas zil gyis non pa dang /chos log pas dkris par gyur yin/ chos ma yin pa'i 'dod chags kyis 'chags pa dang / 'dod pa dga' tsobs zil gyis non pa dang / chos log pas dkris pa de dag la (stelhas dus dang dus su chu'i rgyun legs par 'beb 8tu mi ster te/'di ni ltas mkhan dag gis lhas char 'bebs par 'gyur ro zhes ston kyang mi 5—477

rtogs ①pa than pa chen po'i rgyu bzhi pa dang rkyen bzhi pa yin no/ /gzhan yang sprin yang yod/ glog kyang 'byung / sprin las 'brug kyang grag /phyogs bzhi nas rlung bsil ba dag kyang ldang / ltas mkhan dag kyang lhas char 'bebs par 'gyur ro zhes ston mod kyi/ 'on kyang lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra can ②rgya mtsho chen po nas mngon par 'phags nas des chachar pa de lag pa gnyis kyis bzed cing rgya mtsho chen por ldugs par byed de/ 'di ni ltas mkhan dag gis lhas char 'bebs par 'gyur ro zhes ston kyang mi rtogs ④pa than pa ①chen po'i rgyu lnga pa dang rkyen lnga pa yin no/ /dge slong dag 'di ltar de'i tshe lhas char phab mod kyi/ de na ༅lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra can ⑦rgya mtsho chen po nas mngon par 'phags nas des char pa de lag pa gnyis kyis ⑧bzed cing rgya mtsho chen por blugs so/ /ci de dag gis lo tog thams cad grub par 'gyur ram zhes dris sam/ gal te dge slong ⑨thad gal gyi bu chen po la de yang dris par gyur na/ dge slong mod gal gyi bu chen pos de yang lung ston par 'gyur ro//dge slong dag dge slong mod gal gyi bu chen pos 'du shes de lta bus lung bstan pa la ltung ba med do// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can na spre'u rdzing gi 'gram khang pa brtsegs pa'i khang bzangs na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na yangs pa can na gcer bu pa'i nyan thos shig 'dug pa de'i chung ma la sems can zhugs par gyur to/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te yangs pa can du bsod snyoms la zhugs so/ /de ⑩mthar gyis bsod snyoms la yirgyu ba na de'i khyim du zhugs pa 5—478

dang / des bsams ①pa/ 'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 'di ni mchog gsum pa ste/ 'dis mi shes pa'am/ ma mthong ba'am/ ma rig pa'am/rnam par mi shes pa cung zad kyang med do zhes grag gis bdag gis 'di la bdag gi ②chung ma sbrum pa 'di las khye'u'am/ bu mo'am ci zhig skye bar 'gyur ba gsungs shig ces dri bar bya'o snyam du rig nas/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag gi mchis 'brang cha'adi sbrum na ci 'di'i mngal na khye'u mchis sam/ 'on te bu mo mchis/ des smras pa / bzhin bzangs khye'u'o/ /'jig rten ni 'byor pa 'dod pas des ④rangs pa dang / dga' ba dang / rab tu dga' bas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bza' ba dang / bca' ba gtsang ba bsod ⑤pas lhung bzed bkang ste byin nas smras pa/ 'phags pa yang gshegs su gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos a rog gya ⑥zhes smras te song ngo / /de'i khyim dang ha cang mi ring ba na gcer bu pa zhig 'dug pa des tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu 0lhung bzed bkang ste song ba mthong nas des bsams pa/bdag gi slong ④mo ster ba'i khyim gcig pu yod pa gang yin pa der shākya'i bu'i ⑨dge sbyong dag rgyu bar 'gyur ba ni ma legs kyis de'i phyir je 0khyim bdag de'i gan du song la des khyim bdag dang lhan cig gtam ci zhig byas par gyur pa dri'o snyam nas de myur ba myur bar tho〉khyim bdag gi gan du song ste smras pa/ khyim bdag dge sbyong mod gal gyi bu chen po tso'ongs sam/ 'ongs so/ /khyed ⑩kyis cung zad dris sam/ dris so/ /ci dris/ bdag gi mchis 'brang tso'adi sbrum na ci 'di'i mngal na ⑫khye'u mchis sam/ 'on te bu mo mchis zhes 8dris pa 5—479

dang / de na re khye'u'o zhes zer ro/ /gcer bu pa de rtog ge'i shes pa la mkhas pas brtsi bar brtsams pa dang ji tsam na bu mor mthong nas de bzhin sgyur bar byed/ lag pa gnyis 'dril bar byed do/ /khyim bdag des gcer bu pa de la dris pa/ ci'i phyir bzhin ༅sgyur bar byed/ lag pa gnyis 'dril bar byed / gcer bu pas smras pa②/ kho bos bu mor mthong gi khye'ur ma mthong ngo / /khyim bdag des spyos nas 'phral bar 'phral ②rtsa gsum bsgreng zhing khro gnyer byas te smras pa/ gcer bu pa sgre byi khyed ④ci shes/ khyod pas 'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i mkhyen pa ches dri ma can yin nam/ 'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos khye'u'o zhes lung bstan nas/ khyod bu mo'o zhes zer ramadude de ltar tshar bcad ⑦nas yang brtsi bar brtsams pa dang / bu mo nyid du mthong nas de dukun nas dkris pas smras pa/ gal te dge sbyong shākya'i bu 0nyid kyis lung bstan du zin kyang / de lta rkyen yang 'di ni bu mo nyid yin gyi khye'u ma yin rnal/ /ji tsam na de tho1zla ba dgu 'das te btsas pa las bu mo zhig skyes nas/khyim bdag de nang mi dang bcas 8pa gcer bu pa dag dam pa yin gyi/ shākya'i ⑫bu'i dge sbyong rnams ni de lta ma yin te/ 'phags pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos khye'u'o zhes lung bstan na/ 'di bu mor gyur to zhes smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar thostebyed do/ /thos pa gcig nas gcig 8tu brgyud pas yangs pa can na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs kyang lam po che dang /sung dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo dag na smod pa la zhugs par gyur to/ /de dag smod par byed pa na drug sde dag snga dro sham thabs bgos 0lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te yangs pa can du bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / de dag 5wa 480

gis de dag smod pa thos so/ /thos nas smras pa shes ldan dag khyed cag su la smod / khyed cag ①la'o/ /nged kyis ci byas/ 'phags pa mod ②gal gyi bu chen pos gcer bu pa'i nyan thos kyi chung ma'i mngal na khye'u yod do zhes lung bstan na/ de las da ④bu mo btsas so/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'jig rten thams cardo shes pa rgya mtsho la 'khrul pa yod kyi ④/ bcom ldan 'das nyag gcig ⑤chos rnams la skyob ༅pa yin gyi༅/ skyob pa gzhan med do / /gzhan yang mi'i skye dgu rnams la khye'u'am/ bu mo btsas par duzad kyi/gzhan mtshan nyuci zhig tu 'gyuranyurte/ ci khyi zhig gam/ 'on te spre'u zhig tu 'gyur snyam mamaskyo/ de dag spobs pa med par gyur 8te/ cang mi smra bar 'khod pa dang / drug sde dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' de dag la go bar byas zin mod kyi don nyung ngu de la ltung ba byung gis tshur shegaskye /de'i gan du 'dong tshul 'chags su gzhug go/ /zhes de dag zas kyi bya ba byas nas phyag 'tshal te tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ga la ba der dong nas phyin pa dang /tshe dang ldan pa mod 6gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gnas brtan phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag a rog gya nyuste nad med par gyur cig /nyunyeganas brtan je 6skabs phye shig /tshe dang ldan pa dag ltung ba sde lnga po dag la skabs phye'o/ /gnas brtan gyis ci gcer bu pa'i nyan thos kyi chung ma'i mngal na khye'u yod do zhes lung bstan tam/ lung bstan totho)/ /bzhud cig dang dga' ba 'phel ba nyams su myong zhing 'bru mar dang bu ram yang thob par 'gyur rol/ /khyod lhung bzad nag pos 'tsho bar mi byed pas des na kun shes pa brda cisprod par byed cing de yang 'bras bu med par gyur te0/ khyod kyis spyod 3yul 5—481

bsregs pas kho bo cag gis bsod snyoms kyang mi thob kyis ①khyod la ltung ba byung ba de chos bzhin du slar mdzod cig /tshe dang ldan pa dag ltung ba ma mthong ngo //drug sde dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis ltung ba ma mthong ba'i phyir gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya'o zhes gsungs pas de'i phyir 'di la ci'i phyir lhag par btang snyoms su bya/ khang skyong su yin/ che ge mo zhig go//bos shig /bos so/ /tshe dang ldan pa gaṇ+ḍi rdungs ②shig /mod gal gyi bu chen po don nyung ngu la lhung ba byung ba chos bzhin du phyir mi byed pas de ltung ba ma mthong ba'i phyir gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya'o/ /khang skyong kladage 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyi gan du song ba dang / drug sde dag kyang de dang lhan cig dong ngo / /de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan byed de/de rtag tu gaṇ+ḍi brdungs pa na tshe dang ldan pa dag su zhig yongs su gnas pa'am/gzhi nas yongs su gnas pa'am/ mgu bar bya ba'am/ gzhi nas mgu bar bya ba'am/ 'byin par byed ces chos kyi dbang du byas pa 'dri bar byed do/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa/ gnas brtan su yang yongs su gnas pa'am/gzhi nas yongs su gnas pa'am/ mgu bar bya ba'am/ gzhi nas mgu bar bya ba'am/ 'byin par mi bgyid de/ 'di ltar tshe dang ldan pa mod gal ④gyi bu chen pos 'drums pa ltung bas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa 'dral bar bgyid de②/ lhung bzed nag pos 'tsho bar mi bgyid pas des yin mi'i chos bla ma dam 'cha' ④zhing kun shes pa brda ⑧sprod par bgyid del/ de yang 'bras bu ma mchis par gyur nas/ des spyod yul bsregs pas bdag cag gis bsod snyoms kyang mi rnyed de/ de ltung ba byung ba chos bzhin du slar mi bgyid pas de 5—482 5

ltung ba ma mthong ba'i slad du gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag dge slong gnas brtan la tho ①ma 'tsham par 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di thams cad mkhyen pa/ thams cad gzigs pa/ mkhyen pa dang shes bya dag la bla na med pa'i mnga' brnyes ②pa/ the tshom thams cad gcod par mdzad pa yin gyis de'i gan du deng la don 'di zhus shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis khyed la ji skad lung ston pa de de kho na bzhin du zung shig /skabs ⑧de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ④bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gnas bzhi po 'di dag ni bsam ⑤par mi bya ba dag yin te/ gang dag sems par byed pa dag myos pa dang / rmongs par 'gyur zhing sems rnam par g.yengs pa ༅thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bdag la sems pa dang / 'jig rten la sems pa dang / sems can rnams kyi las kyi rnam par smin pa dang /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi yul lo/ /'di ltar gang gi tshe dge slong mod gal gyi ⑦bus lung bstan pa ⑤de'i tshe na de khye 'ur gyur ⑨pa yin la/ phyis de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas mtshan gyur to/ /gal te dge slong mod gal gyi bu la de yang dris par gyur na/ dge slong mod gal gyi bus de yang lung ston par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag dge slong tsomod gal gyi bus 'du shes de lta bus lung bstan pa la ltung ba med do// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal ka lan da ku'i gnas na bzhugs so/ /rgyal po'i khab na khyim bdag cig 'dug pa des gang dge slong gi dge 'dun la so sor rig par ma byas par zas sbyin pa de 5—483

'phral kho ①na la ②longs spyod dag gis mngon par 'phel lo zhes thos so thos nas kyang de 'di snyam du sems te/ de ni nor sgrub ②pa'i thabs bzang po yin gyisal/ bdag gis kyang dge slong gi dge 'dun la so sor rig par ma byas par zas sbyin par bya'o snyam nas des sung du song ste/ sha mang po nyos nas de'i 'og tu zangs kyi nang du zhun mur mang po dang sbyar ba'i thug pa bskol nas grong khyer gyi sgor ④sgo ba la kye nang rje dge slong gang la la zhig bsod snyoms la 'jug na 'kho bo'i khyim du thong shig ces spring ⑥ba dang / sgo ba des smras pa/ khyim bdag de bzhin du btang ngo zhes des ⑦dge slong bsod snyoms la 'jug pa gang mthong ba de la 'phags pa khyim bdag che ge mo zhig deng ⑧dge slong rnams la bsod snyoms 'bul gyis de'i sdum par bzhud cig ces smras pa dang / de de'i khyim du song ngo / /de bzhin du sgo bas bsod snyoms pa thams cad la bsgo ⑨ba dang / bsod snyoms pa thams cad khyim bdag de'i khyim du dong ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des shin tu snum pa'i sha'i thug pa dag gis de dag tshuso so'i lhung bzed bkang ste byin no/ /de'i nyin mo nam mkha' sprin gyis chukhebs shing yul ngan byung bar gyur nas tsodage slong dag zan zos nas lhung bzed snum po 'di dag rtsub par bya mi nus kyis de na chu dron yod kyis 8chu dron gyi gan du song ste bkru bar bya'o zhes de dag chu dron gyi gan du song ste bkru bar brtsams pa dang /ji tsam na dge slong gzhon nu zhig la chu dron 'di gang nas 'ong snyam pa'i tshul bzhin yid la byed pa byung nas de dang 8ha cang mi ring ba na tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' lhung bzed 'khru bar byed de/ de 8de'i gan du song nas/ btsun pa nye dga' chu dron 'di gang nas 'ong zhes dris pa dang / de dang yang ha cang mi 5—484

ring ba na ①tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po lhung bzed 'khru bar byed nas nye dga'as song la don nyung ngu 'di la ②dris shig /ces gzhon nu de ③tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i dugan du btang zhab dang / gzhon nu de spyod lam zhi ba rgya chen pos de'i gan du song ste gus pa dang bcas pas dris pa gnas brtan 0chab dron 'di ga las mchisal/ des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa mtsho chen po ma dros pa nas so/ /nye dga'as thos nas des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa mdo sde'i mtha' la gnod pa ⑧ma byed cig /chos kyi khrid byed rnam par ma dkrugs 0shig /chos kyi mngal ma rtol cig /'di ltar kho bo cag la rtogs ⑩pa med kyang ci lung yang med dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mtsho chen po ma dros pa'i chu ni yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa yin te/ bsil ba dang / mngar ba dang / yang ba dang / 'jam pa dang / dang ba dang / dri nga ba med pa dang / 'thung ⑩ba na mgul pa la mi gnod pa dang / 'thungs na lto la mi gnod pa'o zhes gsungs na/ de'i phyir khyod kyis yan lag dang po nyid kyis bslus so/ /khyod lhung bzed nag pos 'tsho bar mi byed pas des na kun shes pa brda sprod par byed cing de yang 'bras bu med par gyur te/ khyod kyis spyod yul bsregs pas bdag cag gis bsod snyoms kyang mi rnyed kyis/ khyod la ltung ba byung ba de chos bzhin du slar mdzod cig /tshe dang ldan pa ltung ba ma mthong ngo //drug sde dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis ltung ba ma mthong ba'i phyir gnas nas dbyung 8ba'i las bya'o zhes gsungs pas de'i phyir 'di la ci'i phyir lhag par btang snyoms su bya/ khang skyong su yin/ che ge mo zhig go/ /bos shig /bos so/ /tshe dang ldan pa gaṇ+ḍi rdungs ⑩shig /mod 5—485

gal gyi bu chen po don nyung ngu la ltung ba byung ba chos bzhin du phyir mi byed pas de ltung ba ma mthong ba'i phyir gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya'o/ /khang skyong dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyi gan du song ba dang / drug sde dag kyang de dang lhan cig dong ngo / /de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan byed de/ de rtag tu gaṇ+ḍi brdungs ①pa na tshe dang ldan pa dag su zhig yongs su gnas pa'am/ gzhi nas yongs su gnas pa'am/ mgu bar bya ba'am/gzhi nas mgu bar bya ba'am/ 'byin par byed ces chos kyi dbang du byas pa 'dri bar byed do/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa/ gnas brtan su yang yongs su gnas pa dang ②/ gzhi nas yongs su gnas pa'am/ mgu bar bya ba'am/gzhi nas mgu bar bya ba'amal/ 'byin par mi bgyid de/ 'di ltar tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos 'drums pa ltung bas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa 'dral bar bgyid de/ lhung bzed nag pos 'tsho bar mi bgyid pas des na mi'i chos bla ma dam 'cha' ④zhing kun shes pa brda sprod par ⑤bgyid de/ de yang 'bras bu ma mchis par gyur nas ⑥des spyod yul bsregs pas bdag cag gis bsod snyoms kyang mi rnyed de/ de ltung ba byung ba chos bzhin du slar mi bgyid pas de ltung ba ma mthong ba'i slad du gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag dge slong gnas brtan la tho ma 'tsham ⑦par 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di thams cad mkhyen pa/ thams cad gzigs pa/mkhyen pa dang shes bya dag la ⑧bla na med pa'i mnga' brnyes ⑨pa/ the tshom ⑫thams cad gcod par ⑨mdzad pa yin gyis de'i gan du deng tsol don 'di zhus shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑫khyed la ji skad lung ston pa de de kho na bzhin du ⑫5—486

zung shig /skabs de dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ chu dron de ni mtsho chen po ma dros pa kho na las 'ong ngo / /dge slong rnams rikyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te chab de mtsho chen po ma dros chopa las mchis ②na ci'i slad du dro lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag 'di ltar chu de nyi tshe /④ba'i sems can dmyal ba lnga brgya'i steng nas 'ong ba'i phyir ro/ /gal te dge slong mod gal gyi bu la de yang dris par gyur na/dge slong mod gal gyi bus de yang lung ston ④par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag dge slong mod gal gyi bus 'du shes de lta bus lung bstan pa la ltung ba med do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan zhuyod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de na byutshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos dge slong rnams la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag kho bo ci yang med pa'i skye mched la snyoms rtsopar zhugs pas/ rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab kyi 'gram na 2glang po che gtso bo rab tu mang po dag gi sgra skad thos so/ /de'i tshe na ⑨tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' 'khor de nyid na 'dug cing mthun par gyur nas des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa mdo sde'i mtha' la gnod pa ma byed cig /chos kyi khrid byed rnam par ma dkrugs hu shig /chos kyi mngal ma rtol ༅cig /'di ltar bdag cag la rtogs pa med kyang ci lung yang med dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ci yang med pa'i skye mched la snyoms par zhugs pa'i gzugs kyi 'du shes rnam par gzhig 8cing sgra'i 'du shes dang bral lo zhes gsungs na/ de'i phyir ji ltar gzugs kyi 'du shes rnam par bshig cing sgra'i 'du shes dang bral ba 5—487

des gzugs dag mthong bar 'gyur zhing sgra dag thos par 'gyur te de ni gnas med do/ /khyod lhung bzed nag pos 'tsho bar mi byed pas des na kun shes pa brda sprod par byed cing de yang 'bras bu med par gyur te/ khyod kyis spyod yul bsregs pas bdag cag gis bsod snyoms kyang mi rnyed kyis khyed ①la ltung ba byung ba de ②chos bzhin du slar mdzod cig tshe dang ldan pa ltung ba ma mthong ngo / /drug sde dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis ltung ba ma mthong ba'i phyir gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas de'i phyir 'di la ci'i phyir lhag par btang snyoms su bya/ khang skyong su yin/ che ge mo zhig go/ /bos shig /bos so/ /tshe dang ldan pa gaṇ+ḍi rdungs ①shig /mod gal gyi bu don nyung ngu la ltung ba byung ba ④chos bzhin du phyir mi byed pas de ltung ba ma mthong ba'i phyir gnas nas dbyung ba'i las ⑤bya'o/ /khang skyong dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyi gan ༅du song ba dang / drug sde dag kyang de dang lhan cig dong ngo / /de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan byed de/ de rtag tu gaṇ+ḍi brdungs pa na tshe dang ldan pa dag su zhig yongs su gnas pa'am/ gzhi nas yongs su gnas pa'am/ mgu bar bya ba'amal/gzhi nas mgu bar bya ba'am/ 'byin par byed ces chos kyi dbang du byas pa ⑧'dri bar byed do/ /drug sde dag gis smras pa/ gnas brtan su yang yongs su gnas pa'am/ gzhi nas ⑨yongs su gnas pa'am/ mgu bar bya ba'am/gzhi nas mgu bar bya ba'am/ 'byin par mi bgyid de/ 'di ltar tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos 'brums pa ltung bas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa 'dral bar bgyid de/ lhung bzed nag pos 'tsho bar mi bgyid pas des na 5—488

mi'i chos bla ma dam 'cha' ①zhing kun shes pa brda sprod par bgyid de/ de yang 'bras bu ma mchis par gyur nas/ des spyod yul bsregs pas bdag cag gis bsod snyoms kyang mi rnyed ②de/ de la ltung ba byung ba chos bzhin du slar mi bgyid pas de ltung ba ma mthong ba'i slad du gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag dge slong gnas brtan la tho ma 'tsham par ⑧'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di thams cad mkhyen pa/ thams cad gzigs pa/mkhyen pa dang shes bya dag la bla na med pa'i mnga' brnyes 0pa/ the tshom ⑤thams cad gcod par mdzad pa yin gyis de'i gan du deng ⑥la don 'di zhus shig/bcom ldan 'das kyis khyed la ji skad lung ston pa de de kho na bzhin du zung shig/skabs de dege slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te / ci yang med pa'i skye mched la snyoms par zhugs pa'i gzugs kyi 'du shes rnam par bshig cing sgra'i 'du shes dang bral bas gzugs kyi 'du shes rnam par bshig cing sgra'i 'du shes dang bral ba des gzugs dag mthong bar mi 'gyur zhing / sgra dag thos par mi 'gyur te de ni gnas med do/ /'di ltar dge slong mod gal gyi bu ni bsam gtan dang / rnam par ④thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa dag thob pa yin te/ de ni myur du snyoms par 'jug cing rnam par ldang bar byed pas des snyoms par zhugs pa'i sems nye bar rtogs shing rnam par langs pa'i sems ni ma rtogs te/ dge slong dag dge slong mod gal gyi bu rnam par langs pas sgra de thos so/ /dge slong dag dge slong mod gal gyi bus 'du shes de lta bus lung bstan pa la ltung ba med dol//5—489

las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ltung ba med do/ /pham par 'gyur ba bzhi pa rdzogs te/pham par 'gyur ba rnams rdzogs stortsi// //'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa/ bam po bcwa ②lnga pa/ sdom la/ khu ba 'dzin ②pa 'khrig tshig ④bsnyen bkur smyan0/ /khang pa khang chen dang ni gzhi med pa/ /bag tsam dge 'dun dbyen dang de rjes phyogs/ /khyim sun 'byin dang bka' blo mi bde ba'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i kun tu spyod pa ni grong ngam grong rdal ⑥gang na nye bar rten ⑦cing gnas pa der ninang par sngar langs te/ gtsug lag khang du chag ⑨chag 'debs par byed/ legs par nyug par byed/ ba lang gi ⑩ci ba sar pa'i byug pas skud par byed cing / de gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol du rkang pa gnyis bkrus nas lag pa gnyis bsnyal te so shing bor nas snga dro sham thabs bgos/lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te grong ngam/ grong rdal yide nyid du lus ma bsrungs / dbang po rnams skem bsdams/ dran pa nye bar ma bzhag 8par bsod snyoms la 'jug cing / de grong ngam/ grong rdal ④der bsod snyoms brgyus nas zas kyi bya ba byas te/ phyi ma'i bzas kyi bsod snyoms las phyir log pas lhung bzed dang / chos gos mkhos su phab ste/ rkang pa gnyis bkrus nas nang du yang dag 'jog gi phyir gtsug lag khang du 'jug par byed do8/ /gal te de'i sems 'dod pa la 'dod chags kyis kun nas dkris ⑩par gyur na/5—490

des rang gi yan lag gi rnam pa las su rung bar byas te/ lag pa gnyis kyis ①bzung nas rtsol bar byed cing khu ba 'byin par byed do/ /de nas dge slong rab tu mang po dag gtsug lag khang rgyu zhing 'dong ba na tshe dang ldan pa 'char ku'i gtsug lag khang ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka dang lhan cig mngon du yang dag par dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / yang dag par mgu bar 'gyur ba'i gtam sna tshogs byas te mtha' gcig ②tu 'khod do/ /mtha' gcig ①tu 'khod nas dge slong rab tu mang po dag gis tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa ji ltar ④khyod bzod dam/'tsho 'am/ bde ba la reg par gnas sam/ bsod snyoms kyis ngal bar ma gyur tam/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag te por bzod do/ /'tsho'o/ /bde ba la reg par gnas so/ /bsod snyoms kyis ngal bar ma gyur to/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka khyod ji ltar bzod pa dang / 'tsho ba dang / bde ba la reg par gnas pa dang / bsod snyoms kyis ngal bar ma gyur/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag grong ngam/ grong rdal ⑤gang na nye bar rten cing gnas par bdag nang par sngar langs te/ gtsug lag khang du chag chag 'debs par byed/legs par nyug par byed/ ba lang gi lci ba sar pa'i byug pas skud ①par byed cing / bdag gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol du rkang pa gnyis bkrus nas lag pa gnyis bsnyal te so shing bor nas snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te grong ngam/ grong rdal ⑦de nyid du bsod snyoms la 'jug cing bdag grong ngam/ grong rdal ⑧de nyid du bsod snyoms ⑨brgyus nas zas kyi bya ba byas 0te/ phyi ma'i zas kyi bsod snyoms las phyir log pas lhung bzed dang 5—491 sgo 6

chos gos mkhos su phab ste/ rkang pa gnyis bkrus nas nang du yang dag 'jog gi phyir gtsug lag khang du 'jug par byed do/ /gal te bdag ni sems 'dod pa la 'dod chags kyis ①kun nas dkris par gyur na②/ bdag gis rang gi yan lag gi rnam pa las su rung bar ③byas te/ lag pa gnyis kyis bzung 0nas rtsol bar byed cing khu ba phyung nas rims ⑤nad dang bral zhing yongs su gdung ba yidang bral bas bde ba la reg par gnas shing bsod snyoms kyis ngal ba ④yang med de/ tshe ③dang ldan pa dag bdag de ltar na bzod pa dang /'tsho khyab dang / bde ba la reg par gnas pa dang / bsod snyoms kyis ngal ba yang med do/ /dge slong de dag des smras pa la mngon par bstod ⑩par yang mi byed/ phyir zlog par yang ⑩mi byed cing ⑫/ mngon par bstod pa yang tsom byas / phyir bzlog pa ④yang ma byas par dong ste bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong nas phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'khod do/ /mtha' gcig tu 'khod nas dge slong rab tu mang po dag gis skabs de bcom ldan 'das la rgyas par gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng gzhi ()'di dang /skabs 'di la dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni don gyi dbang gnyis gzigs pa na dge slong gi dge 'dun sdud par mdzad de/'di lta ste/ nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis kun shes pa nyid du bya ba'i phyir dang /ngas 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi legs par bcas par 'gyur ba'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du ched (9par mdzad pa tho)ste/mkhyen bzhin du rmed btso/ mkhyen kyang mi rmed pa/ dus su rmed pa/ dus 5—492

las yol bar mi med pa/ don dang ldan pa rmed pa/ don dang mi ldan pa mi rmed pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni don dang mi ldan pa rmed pa la chu lon ①gyis zlog par mdzad pa yin no/ /de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni don dang ldan pa med ②pa la dus mkhyen pa yin pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la rmas ①pa/ 'char ka khyod kyis mi mdzes ④pa de lta bu de byas par gyur pa bden nam/ btsun pa mad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong ⑤gi tshul ma yin pa rjes su mthun pa ma ⑥yin pa/ rung ba ma yin pa/ tshul dang mthun pa ma yin pa de ni rab tu byung bas bya ba ma yin no/ /'char ka ngas 'dod chags 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir sems rnam par grol ba dang / shes rab rnam par grol ba'i chos bstan pa dang zhe sdang 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba dang / gti mug 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ⑦ba'i phyir sems rnam par grol ba dang / shes rab rnam par grol ba'i chos bstan pa la khyod kyis ci'i phyir mi mdzes pa de lta bu de byas par gyur/ mi gti mug can khyod kyis lag pa gang dag gis bram ze dang /khyim bdag dad pa can dag las dad pas sbyin par ⑤bya ba len par byed pa'i lag pa de dag nyid kyis ci'i phyir mi mdzes pa de lta bu de byas par gyur/ mi gti mug can khyod kyis sbrul nag po dug 7myur du khyab par byed pa/ dug drag pa/dug rno ba lag pa gnyis kyis bzung ⑩bar gyur pa ni bla'iyi/ de ltar gyur pas rang gi yan lag gi rnam pa chubazung ba ni ma yin no zhes rnam par smad pa mdzad do//'char ka ji snyam du sems/ de ltar tson bdag nyid kyi lus kyi bsnyen bkur bdag gir ma byas sam/ btsun pa bgyis so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 5—493

kyis rnam ①grangs du mas rnam par smad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag de lta bas na phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs pas 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bya ste/ 'di lta ste/ dge 'dun bsdu ba'i phyir dang / dge 'dun legs par bya ba'i phyir dang / dge 'dun bde bar gnas par ②bya ba'i phyir dang / gnong mi bkur ba'i gang zag rnams tshar gcad ③ par bya ④ba'i phyir dang / ngo tsha shes pa rnams bde bar gnas par bya ba'i phyir dang / mngon par ma dad pa rnams mngon par dad par bya ba'i phyir dang / mngon par dad pa rnams phyir zhing 'byung bar ⑤bya ba'i phyir dang / tshe 'di'i zag pa rnams bsdam par bya ba'i phyir dang / tshe rabs phyi ma'i rnams bzlog par bya ba'i phyir dang / nga'i tshangs par ༅spyod pa skye bo mang po la phan pa yangs par gyur pa lha dang mi'i bar dag la yang dag par ⑦rab tu bstan pa yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ba'o/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/ bsams ②bzhin du khu ba phyung na dge 'dun lhag ma'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi de ltar bca' ba mdzad do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas dge slong rab tu mang po nyal ba dag gi rmi ⑨lam na mi gtsang ba shor cing khu ba phyung bar gyur te de dag la 'du shes kyang yod/ sems pa yang yod pas de dag 'gyod pa skyes par gyur nas / 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis bsams ⑩bzhin du khu ba phyung na dge 'dun lhag ma'o zhes 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' ba 5—494

mdzad na/ bdag cag dge slong rab tu mang po nyal ba dag gi rmi ①lam na mi gtsang ba shor zhing khu ba byung bar ③gyur te/ bdag cag la 'du shes kyang yod/sems pa yang yod pas bdag cag la dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba byung bar ma gyur tam/ tshur sheg bdag cag tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ga la ba der 'dong ①zhing phyin nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la brjod par bya zhing dubadag cag la ⑤ma dang ldan pa kun dga' bos ji skad lung ston par 'gyur ba de de kho na bzhin du gzung bar bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas dge slong rab tu mang po dag tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ga la ba der dong ste ༅phyin nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo mkhyen par mdzod cig /'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis bsams ⑦bzhin du khu ba phyung na dge 'dun lhag ma'o zhes 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi ⑧bslab pa'i gzhi bca' ba mdzad na/ bdag cag dge slong rab tu mang po nyal ba dag gi rmi lam na mi gtsang ba shor cing khu ba byung bar gyur te/ bdag cag la 'du shes kyang mchisal sems pa yang mchis pas ⑩bdag cag la dge 'dun ⑩lhag ma'i ltung ba byung bar ma gyur tam/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos dge slong rab tu mang po de dag khrid de bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song nas phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig 8tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di ltar bsams 8bzhin du khu ba phyung na dge 'dun lhag ma'o/ /zhes 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' ba mdzad na/ tshe dang 5—495

ldan pa dge slong rab tu mang po 'di dag mchis nyal ba'i g.yar lam na mi gtsang ba shor cing khu ba byung bar gyur ①te/ 'di dag la 'du shes kyang mchis/sems pa yang mchis pas 'di dag la ②dge 'dun lhag ma'i lhung ba byung bar ma gyur tam/ kun dga' bo 'di dag la 'du shes kyang yod/ sems pa yang yod ②de med do zhes nga mi smra mod kyi 'di dag gi de ni tha snyad du byar rung ④ba ma yin te/ kun dga' bo de ⑤lta bas na rmi lam gyi ma gtogs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bslab pa 'dod pa dang / bslab pa la gus pa dang /bslab pa la yo byad bsnyungs pa'i bsngags pa brjod nas dge slong rnams la de dang mthun pa dang / de'i shas che ba dang / de dang 'tsham pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid mdzad nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na snga ma ni bcas pa yin la 'di ni rjes su gnang ba yin te/nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis ⑥'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar gdon par bya ste/bsams ⑦bzhin du khu ba phyung na rmi lam gyi ma gtogs te dge 'dun lhag ma'o/ /bsams ⑧bzhin du zhes bya ba ni rnam par dpyad nas so/ /khu ba zhes bya ba ni khu ba rnam pa lnga ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / bska ⑨ba dang / sla ba'o/ /de la sngon po ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i 'o⑩/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i bu thu bo dbang bskur bar 'os la dbang ma bskur bar yiganas pa mtshams thob pa gang yin pa de'i ⑩khu ba yang sngon po yin no/ /ser po ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i bu de las gzhan pa dag gi'o/ /dmar po ni tsosna chen po la gtogs pa 'khor lo'i mtha' pa'i 'o/ /bska ④ba ni dbang po yongs su smin pa rnams kyi'o/ /sla ba ni dbang po yongs su ma smin pa rnams 5—496

kyi'ol/ /yang na bud med kyis dub pa dang / khur gyis dub pa dang / lam gyis dub pa dang / gta' gam pa dang / ya za ma lug gang yin pa ①de'i yang sla ba yin no/ /phyung na zhes bya ba ni de ma thag tu phyung ba'o/ /rmi lam gyi ma gtogs te zhes bya ba zhuni rmi lam gyi bzhag ste'o/ /dge 'dun lhag ma'o zhes bya ba ni ltung ba de dge 'dun la rag las zhupa dang / dge 'dun dang 'brel pa dang / dge 'dun la rton ④pa yin te/ ltung ba de dge 'dun las rnam par ldang bar 'gyur gyi gang zag las ma yin pa'o/ /gzhan yang pham par 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi po dag ni lhag ma med pa yin gyi/ 'di ni lhag ma dang bcas pa yin pa ste/ des na dge 'dun lhag ma'o zhes gsungs so//de la ltung bar phyeji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ gzhi lngas te thobade ba 'dod pa dang / sa bon 'dod pa dang / rig thosngags 'dod pa dang / sman 'dod pa dang / brtag pa 'dod pas so/ /ji ltar bde ba 'dod pas she na/dge slong gis dubade ba 'dod pas nang gi gzugs nye bar len cing sems par byed / rtsol bar byed la khu ba 'byin na dge 'dun lhag mar 'gyur ro/ /khu ba mi rtsa'abyin na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /bde ba 'dod pas ji lta ba bzhin du sa bon 'dod pa dang / rig sngags 'dod pa dang / sman 'dod pa dang / brtag pa 'dod pas kyang de bzhin rno/ /dge slong gis bde ba 'dod pas nang gi gzugs nye bar len cing sems par byed/ rtsol bar byed/ril gyis 'chang bar byed/ dam du 'chang bar byedabya/ khu ba 'byin na dge 'dun lhag mar 'gyur ro/ /khu ba mi 'byin na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /bde ba 'dod pas ji lta yib bzhin du sa bon 'dod pa dang ⑫/ rig sngags 5—497

'dod pa dang / sman 'dod pa dang / brtag pa 'dod pas kyang de bzhin no//dge slong gis bde ba 'dod pas nang gi gzugs nye bar len cing sems par byed / rtsol ①bar byed/ ril gyis 'chang bar byed/ dam du 'chang bar byed la des kyang bye brag nges par myong ba'i bde ba nyams su myong bar byed cing khu ba 'byin na dge 'dun lhag mar 'gyur ro/ /khu ba mi 'byin na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /bde ba 'dod pas ji lta ba bzhin du sa bon 'dod pa dang /rig sngags 'dod pa dang / sman 'dod pa dang / brtag pa 'dod pas kyang de bzhin no/ /dge slong gis bde ba 'dod pas nang gi gzugs nye bar len cing sems par byed/ rtsol bar byed/ ril gyis 'chang bar byed/ dam du 'chang bar byed la/ des kyang byung la thug pa'i bde ba nyams su myong bar byed cing khu ba 'byin na dge 'dun lhag mar 'gyur ro/ /khu ba mi 'byin na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /bde ba 'dod pas ji lta ba bzhin du sa bon 'dod pa dang / rig ②sngags 'dod pa dang / sman 'dod pa dang / brtag pa 'dod pas kyang de bzhin no/ /dge slong gis chabade ba 'dod pas nang gi ④gzugs nye bar len cing sems par byed/ rtsol bar byed/ ril gyis 'chang bar byed⑤/ dam du 'chang bar byed⑥/ des kyang ngad las ⑦pa'i bde ba nyams su myong bar byed cing khu ba 'byin na dge 'dun lhag mar 'gyur ro/ /khu ba mi 'byin na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /bde ba 'dod pas ji lta ba bzhin du sa bon 'dod pa dang / rig sngags 'dod pa dang / risman 'dod pa dang /brtag pa 'dod pas kyang de bzhin no/ /dge slong gis bde ba 'dod pas nang gi gzugs nye bar len cing sems par byed/ rtsol bar byed/ ril gyis 5—498

'chang bar byed/ dam du 'chang bar byed la/ des kyang bye brag nges par myong ba'i bde ba dang / byung la thug pa'i bde ba dang / ngad langs ①pa'i bde ba nyams su myong bar byed cing khu ba 'byin na dge 'dun lhag mar 'gyur ro//khu ba mi 'byin na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /bde ba 'dod pas ji lta ba bzhin du sa bon 'dod pa dang / rig sngags 'dod pa dang / sman 'dod pa dang /brtag pa 'dod pas kyang de bzhin no/ /nang gi gzugs ji lta ②ba bzhin du phyi rol gyi gzugs nye bar len pa la yang de bzhin du rgyas par sbyar ro// //bar sdom la/ gar byed rab tu gar byed dang / /mkha' dang shugs dang sbubs 'ongs dang / /kun du mnyed dang bye (brag nges/ /'jal ③ba dang ni lta ba dang / /rgyun las bzlog dang rdzi bzlog pa'i/ /sde tshan yang dag bsdus pa yin/ /dge slong gis gar byed pas skyikhu ba 'byin na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ tsho /khu ba mi 'byin na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis rab tu gar byed pas khu ba 'byin na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /khu ba mi 'byin na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis nam mkha' la rked pa skyod ⑤pas khu ba 'byin na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /khu ba mi 'byin na nyes byas su 'gyur ro//dge slong gis shugs btang ste/ khu ba 'byin na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /khu ba mi 'byin na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis sbubs su 'ongs pa'i khu ba 'byin na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /khu ba mi 'byin na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis kun tu mnyed pa'i bde ba nyams su myong bar byed cing khu ba 'byin na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /khu ba mi 'byin na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis bye brag nges par myong ba'i bde ba nyams su myong 5wa 499

bar byed cing khu ba 'byin na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /khu ba mi 'byin na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis kun tu chags pa'i sems kyis rang gi yan lag gi rnam pa 'jal bar byed na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis chags pa'i sems kyis nyarang gi yan lag gi rnam pa la lta na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis chags pa'i sems kyis rang gi yan lag gi rnam pa chu'i rgyun las bzlog phyogs su ② gtong bar ②byed na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro//chu'i rgyun phyogs su gtong bar ༅byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis chags pa'i sems kyis rang gi yan lag gi rnam pa rdzi phyogs ma yin par gtong bar ⑤byed na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /rdzi phyogs su gtong bar yibyed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /rma sbyang ba dang / shu ba dang / g.yan pa dang /mdze dang / phol mig dang / spangs pa dang khyi rngo dang / glog ⑦pa dang ⑧/'brum bu dang / phyi rol du mchong ba dang / 'obs la mchong ⑨ba dang /brla ⑩la reg pa dang / gos la reg pa dang / chags par 'gyur ba'i gzugs dag mthong ba dang / sngon spyad pa'i yul rjes su dran pa dang / bsro khang gi las nyams su myong bar byed pas khu ba byung 0ba la ni ltung ba med do/ /las dang po pa dang / smyos pa dang / sems 'khrugs pa dang / tshor ba dag gis nyen pa la ni ltung ba med 'do/ /khu ba 'byin pa'i dge 'dun lhag ma ste dang po rdzogs sto'// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde dag gi rmukun du spyod pa ⑫5—500

ni 'dir bdag cag gis bram ze dang khyim bdag 'ongs shing lhags pa rnams la yang chos bstan par bya/ rgol ba dag kyang tshar gcad par bya/ rang gi grags pa yang bsgrag par bya'o snyam pas drug sde las gang yang rung bas rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi ①tho stong par mi 'jog pas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka nang par sngar langs te so shing bor nas/ snam sbyar dmar ser gyon te rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo na ②'chag cing 'dug go/ /mnyan yod na gnas pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag gi chung ma rnams kyi kun du spyod pa ni skyed mos tshal du song ste/ rgyal byed kyi tshal du 'jug pa dang / gtsug lag khang blta ba dang / bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal du 'gro bas bram ze dang / khyim bdag ③gi chung ma rab tu mang po dag skyed mos tshal ①du byung ste gtsug lag khang lta ⑤'dod pas rgyal byed kyi tshal ga la ba der dong ngo //drug sde dag gis grong khyer chen po drug po dag na 'khod pa'i mi rnams 'di lta ste rigs las sam/ rus las sam/ rgyud ⑥las sam ming las ⑦sam/gzugs las sam bzo las sam/ 'tsho ba las mi shes pa'am/ ma mthong ba'am / ma thos pa'am/ ma rig pa'am/ rnam par mi shes pa 'ga' yang med pas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas bram ze dang khyim bdag gi ⑤chung ma rab tu mang po de dag thag ring po kho na nas mthong ste/ mthong nas kyang 'di skad ces smras so/ /che ge mo'i ma/ che ge mo'i chung ma/ che ge mo'i mna' ⑨ma/che ge mo'i bu mo/ che ge mo'i sring mo 'ongs pa legs so 'ongs pa legs so/ /khyed cag ci'i phyir yun ring mo ring mo nas zla ba ltar rgyu bar byed/ de dag gis smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka bcom ldan 'das kyis mi khom pa brgyad ni 5—501

gang zag gi tshangs par spyad pa'i dus ma lags so zhes legs par gsungs na/bdag cag ni 'di lta ste/ khyim gyi 'du 'dzi ①dang ldan pas mi khom ②pa dgu pa lags so/ /'char gas smras pa/ sring mo dag khyed kyis 'ga' zhig gis ③'di skad ces/ dug can la ④sogs rgyal po yiphye/ /bya ba dag ni ma byas par//de dag nyid dang bya ba rnams/ /zhig pa nyid du gyur pa yin/ /bya ba de dag nyid kyang ni/ /yongs su rdzogs par ma gyur par/ /'jig rten dgra bo 'chi bdag de/ /'ong ba nyid du 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes smras pa ma ①thos sam/ de dag gis ⑦smras pa/ btsun pa 'char ka de'i slad du bdag cag skyed mos tshal du mchis te rgyal byed kyi tshal du 'jug pa dang / gtsug lag khang blta ba dang /bcom ldan 'das dang / dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal ba'i slad du mchis pa lags so/ /'char kus smras pa/ sring mo dag gal te khyed cag de'i phyir 'ongs na bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang snying po med pa'i lus las snying po blang bar bya'o zhes ⑧gsungs pas legs so legs so/ /sring mo dag de ni mjal 0gyis 'di ltar ltad mo ji ltar tshubalta ba dri bar bya'o/ /sring mo dag khyed cag gang du 'jug par byed/ btsun pa 'char ka bdag cag kun dga' ra bar 'jug cing gtsug lag khang lta bar 'tshal lo/ /sring mo dag bcom ldan 'das kyis/ mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dang bas/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten yidag la gom 'dor na/ /'dzam bu chu bo gser gyi sung tshad ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa minaX/ /zhes gsungs pas de yang legs so/ /sring mo dag khyed kyis gang khyed cag gtsug lag khang ston par byed pa'i dge slong 'ga' zhig btsal tam/ 'phags pa ci bdag cag sgron ma 5—502

sug pa na thogs bzhin du zhugs gzhan ①du tshol lam/ btsun pa 'char ka spangs te dge slong gzhan ga la tshol/ khyod pas gzhan khyad par du 'phags pa su zhig mchis kyis/ khyod nyid kyis bstan du gsol/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa ②'char ka 'di snyam du sems te/ gal te 'di dag la ②gtsug lag khang bstan par bya na ni bdag gi dge ba'i phyogs yongs su nyams par yang 'gyur/ gal te bstan par mi bya na ni tshig pa'i bsod snyoms kyang ster bar mi 'gyur la/bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang ma dad pa rnams dad pa phun sum tshogs pa yang dag par 'dzin du gzhug par bya/ gdul bar bya/ gzung ༷bar bya/ rab tu dgod par bya'o zhes gsungs pas de'i phyir 'di dag dge ba la nges par ⑤sbyar bar bya⑤/ rnam pa thams cad du bstan par bya'o snyam du rig nas des me tog dang / bdug spos la sogs pa mchod pa rnam pa ⑦sna tshogs thogs te pog phor ⑧lag tu blangs nas go rims ⑨ji lta ba bzhin du bstan par brtsams te/ sring mo dag 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyi dri gtsang khang ste/ gang du skyabacom ldan 'das nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs nas gang ni nyamus par 'gyurayi/ gang ni 'phel bar 'gyur⑩/gang ni gnod par gyuratso/ gang ni nyam nga bar gyur/ gang ni mi bde bar gyur / gang ni (steganod pa dang / nyam nga ba dang / mi bde bar gyur/gang ni ngan song la gzhol/ gang ni ngan song la 'bab/ gang ni ngan song la bab/ ngas tunyegang ni ngan song gi lam nas bslangs te (nyamatho ris dang /thar pa dang / 'bras bu la gzhag par bya/ 'dod pa'i 'dam ⑩du bying ba gang gi lag nas ni drang 8bar bya/ 'phags pa'i nor gyi dbyig dang bral ba 5wa 503

gang ni 'phags pa'i nor gyi dbang phyug la gzhag par bya/ gang gi sangs rgyas 'byung bas brgyan pa'i 'jig rten ni 'bras bu dang bcas par bya/ gang gi dge ba'i ①ma ba dag ma bskyed ②pa ni bskyed par bya/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dag bskyed pa gang ni yongs su smin par bya/ yongs su smin pa gang ni rnam par grol bar bya zhes mkhyen pa dang / gzigs pa 'jug ⑤cing 'di ltar/ chu srin gnas kyi dug can pa/ /dus las 'da' bar 'gyur srid kyi/ /sangs rgyas gdul la byams pa ni/ /dus las 'da' bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar ma ni bu sdug gcig pu la/ /rtog cing de srog srung bar byed pa ltar/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'ang gdul ba'i skye bo la/ /rtog ④par mdzad cing de srog sung bar mdzad/ /kun mkhyen rgyud la mnga' ba'i thugs rje yige/ /bzhon ma gdul ba'i be'u tshol mi skyo ste/ /srid dang ngan 'gros khyonyams la byams pa ni/ /rab nyams be'u la byams pa'i ba bzhin no/ /zhes bya ba 'jug pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i ⑦sangs rgyas stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhis bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba khyu mchog rlabs nipo che'i gnas su dam 'cha' ⑨ba/ 'khor gyi nang du seng ge'i sgra yang dag par sgrog pa gang yin pa de'i yin gyis 'dir zhabs la phyag dag ⑩'tshol cig /'di ni tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kauṇ+ḍi 0rgya'i gtsug lag khang ste/bcom ldan 'das kyis tso'ajig rten mi shes pa'i mun pa dang / 'dren pa med pa dang / yongs su 'dren pa med pa yin de'i dang por ye shes kyi mig sman gyi thur mas gang gi ④chos kyi mig rnam par sbyangs pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas brtan rnams dang / rgyal tshab blta bu rnams dang / yun ring po nas 5—504

rab tu byung ba rnams dang / tshangs par spyod pa mngon par spyad pa rnams dang /snam sbyar gyi rgyal mtshan thogs pa rnams kyi mchog tu lung bstan pa gang yin pa gang gi rgyud la de'i dang por bcom ldan 'das kyis ①'jig rten du dge sbyong ngam/bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ sus kyang chos dang mthun par bskor mi nus pa chos ②dang ldan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo skye bo mang po'i don dang / skye bo lamang po la phan pa dang / bde ba dang / 'jig rten la rjes su thugs brtse ba dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang /bde ba'i phyir lan gsum du bzlas te rnam pa bcu gnyis su bskor ba de'i yin gyis 'dir yang zhabs la phyag dag 'tshol ④cig /'di ni tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po'i gtsug lag khang ste/ bram ze shing sā la chen po lta bu rmon pa dor stong du gcig gis ma chog pa spangs te rab tu byung ba dbyig bye ba phrag drug bcu ⑤dang ldan pa/ gser gyi yinas bang chung brgyad bcu ⑦bdog pa/ bran gyi grong khyer ⑧bcwa ⑨brgyad bdog pa/ sbyor ba'i grong bcu drug bdog pa/ ser skya bzang mo lus gser bas lhag pa dang ldan pa mchil ma'i thal ba smin pa ltar spangs te mtshan mo'i thun tha ma la ras sbyar ma'i snam sbyar rin thang 'bum ri ba thogs te 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa gang dag bzhugs pa de dag gi phyir rab tu byung ba/ bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /snyoms par 'jug pa ⑩bskyed pa'i phyir nags na brten ⑩pa gang yin pa/ gang mthong na spos kyi glang po che dag kyang rgyags pa dang bral bar 'gyur ba/ gang gis bu mangs kyi mchod rten du 8ston par tsokhas blangs nas dge slong gi sdom pa thob pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang tsodage slong dag nga'i nyan thos kyi dge 5—505

slong 'dod pa chung ba chog shes pa/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan smra ba rnams kyi nang na mchog ni 'di yin te/ 'di lta ste/ dge slong 'od srung chen po'o zhes gsungs shing / bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su bsngags pa gaje yin pa de'i yin gyis 'dir yang zhabs la phyag dag 'tshol ①cig /'di ni tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i gtsug lag khang ste/ mchog thob pa'i bu gang yin pa/ gang gis lo brgyad gnyis su dbang po'i brda sprod pa blags ②pa/ rgol ba thams cad tshar gcad ②pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis shes rab chen po rnams dang / spobs pa chen po ④rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa gang yin pa/ chi bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten thams cad gang gi cha bcu drug par bzhag cing bcom ldan 'das kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa ma gtogs par/ /'jig rten kun gyi shes rab gang / /shā ri'i bu yi ⑤shes rab kyi/ /bcu drug char yang mi chog go/ /gal te lhar bcas 'jig rten 'di/ /shā ri'i bu dang mnyam gyur pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes ⑥kyi / /bcu drug char yang mi chog go/ /zhes gsungs pa gang yin pa de'i yin gyis 'dir yang zhabs la phyag dag 'tshol ⑦cig /'di ni tshe dang ldan pa mod ⑧gal gyi bu chen po'i gtsug lag khang ste/ mdun na 'don gyi bu cod ⑨pan med pa'i rgyal srid spangs te rab tu byung ba gang yin pa gang gis lha'i dbang po brgya ⑩byin gyi khang bzangs ⑩rnam par rgyal byed rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthe bos lan gsum du bskul/ kun du bskul/ kun du rab 8tu bsgul ba/ gang gi rdzu 'phrul gyis bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams 'od zer 8can du nyin mtshan bdun gyis gshegs pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tho)rdzu 'phrul chen po rnams dang /5—506

mthu chen po rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa gang yin pa de'i yin gyis 'dir yang zhabs la phyag dag 'tshol ①cig /'di ni tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa'i gtsug lag khang ste/ mi skal ②ba bzang po las rab tu byung ba gang yin pa/bcom ldan 'das kyi yab kyi mched kyi sras gang gi ming yang dag par bsgrags pas tshong pa dag rgya mtsho chen po nas bzhon pa'i snod legs par grub cing 'ong bar 'gyur ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ③lha'i mig can rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa gang ④yin sa de'i yin gyis 'dir yang zhabs la phyag dag 'tshol cig /'di ni tshe dang ldan pa dukun dga' bo'i gtsug lag khang ste/ yun ring po nas bcom ldan 'das kyi bsnyen ⑥bkur ba gang yin pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs ⑦'bring na nye bar spyod pa/ ston pas ⑧yang dag par bsngags pa/tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa mkhas pa rnams kyis ⑨yang dag par bkur ba gang yin pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi yab kyi mched kyi sras las rab tu byung ba/bcom ldan 'das kyis mang du thos pa rnams dang / thos pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / thos pa bsags pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa gang yin pa de'i yin gyis 'dir yang zhabs la phyag dag 'tshol cig /'di ni tshe dang ldan pa mdzes dga'i gtsug lag khang ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gcung po su'i sras las rab tu byung ba/ gal te rab tu ma byung na stobs kyi ⑩'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis yidabang po dag gi 8sgo bsdams pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa gang yin pa de'i yin gyis 'dir yang zhabs la phyag dag 'tshol cig /'di ni tshe dang ldan pa sgra can 4)zin gyi gtsug lag khang ste/bcom ldan 'das kyi sras las rab tu byung ba/ gal te rab tu ma byung na mthu 5—607

dang ldan pa'i rgyal por 'gyur ba gang yin pa/ gang rab tu byung na rgyal po mang pos bkur gyi rgyud gcig nas gcig ①tu brgyud ②pa yang dag par ①rgyun chad pa/bcom ldan 'das kyis bslab pa 'dod pa rnams dang / bslab pa la gus pa rnams dang / bslab pa la yo byad bsnyungs pa thob pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa gang yin pa de'i yin gyis 'dir yang zhabs la phyag dag 'tshol cig /'di ni tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo'i gtsug lag khang ngo / /'di ni nye dga'i'o/ /'di ni 'dun pa'i'o/ /'di ni 'gro mgyogs ④kyi'o/ / 'di ni nab so'i 'o ༷'di ni kho bo'i gtsug lag khang ngo / /ci ⑥'di yang lta bar byed dam/'phags pa ci bdag cag gis gtsug lag khang thams cad bltas nas gdod 'phags pa 'char ga'i gtsug lag khang blta bar mi ⑦bgyi'am/ bdag cag gis 'phags pa 'char ku'i gtsug lag khang 'di da shin tu blta bar bgyi'o/ /sring mo dag de bzhin gyis shigani /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka de 'dod chags spyad pa yin pas de'i gtsug lag khang na ⑨gzhi mon sran gre'u'i phye 0mas bskus pa dang / rtsig pa cung zhig yinye bar bkra ba dang / mal stan be'u phrug gi snying po can bshams pa dang / bum pa btung bas bkang ba bcu snod dang bcas pa bzhag pa dang / skon pa'i nang na bca' ba sna tshogs kyis gang ba dag yod do// tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus bram ze dang khyim bdag gi chung ma rab tu mang po rang gi gtsug lag khang du 'ongs pa rnams la smras pa/ sring mo dag ci je ⑫khye'u sus bya'am / 'on te btung ba 'thung ⑫/ 'phags pa ci chu klung bzlog phyogs su 'bab bam/ bdag cag gis 'phags pa la gsol bar bgyi ba gang lags pa de nyid 'phags pas bdag cag la stsol rdzitam/ 'di ltar bdag cag la gang 5—508

dkon pa de stsol cig /sring mo dag khyed cag la ci zhig dkon/ 'phags pa chos mnyan pa'o/ /sring mo dag bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas drug po ①dag 'jig rten du 'byung ②ba ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yin te/ drug po de dag gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba dang /mi nyid dang / dbus pa'i gnas su skye ba dang / dbang po ma tshang ba med pa dang / dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa'o zhes legs par gsungs pas de'i phyir khyed cag dge ba'i chos ①la 'dun pa skyes pa 'di ni sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang 'dra ste legs so legs so/ /sring mo dag 'khod cig dang kho bos khyed la chos bstan par bya'o/ /de dag gis de'i rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal te chos mnyan pa'i phyir mdun du 'khod pa dang / des de dag la chos ston par brtsams so laji lta ji ltar chos ston pa de lta de ltar kun du chags so/ /ji lta ji ltar kun tu chags pa de lta de ltar dral to/ /ji lta ji ltar dral ba de lta de ltar de dag gi yan lag dang ⑤nying lag dag la nyug par brtsams so/ /'di lta ste dper na mi gsang sngags nyid rjod ⑥par byed pa 'byung po'am/ sha zas thal lcag gi bsnun pas bsnun ⑦par gyur pa de bzhin du de yang de dag la ji lta ji ltar chos ston par byed pa de ②lta de ltan kun du chags so/ /ji lta ji ltar kun du chags pa de lta de ltar dral to/ /ji lta ji ltar dral ba de lta de ltar de dag gi yan lag dang nying lag dag la nyug par brtsams so/ /de na gang dag bdag gir byed pa de dag ni de dang lhan cig gzhogs stegs ⑨dang / phyar g.yeng dang / tho ⑩'tsham pa dang / kun du rtse (spreb dang / kun du thonaca co 'don pa dang /— 5—509

dgod ①pa dang / dregs pa dang / lus sgyur bar byed do/ /gang dag bdag gir mi byed pa de dag ni de nas phyir byung ste/ 'chag sa dang / dgar ②dang / sgo khang dag na/ gang las chu 'byung de las 'bar/ /gang las skyob pa de las 'jigs/ /'jigs pa med las 'jigs pa skyes/ /skyabs las 'jigs pa skyes par gyural/ /bdag cag gi phyogs gcig tu ④bde ba zhi ba/bde legs brjod pa/ bde legs su 'gyur ba gang yin pa de las 'jigs pa dang / yams dang / gnod pa dang /⑤ 'go ba'i nad dang ⑥/ 'khrug pa byung bar gyur to zhes smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed do/ /de dag smod cing 'dod pa na dge slong dag gi mngon sum du gyur nas ⑦de dag gis de dag smod pa thos pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/sring mo dag khyed cag su la smod/ 'phags pa dag khyed cag la'o/ /nged kyis ⑧ci byas/ 'phags pa dag bdag cag gi yan lag dang nying lag khyim thab kyis kyang ma ⑨byugs pa gang dag lags pa de dag 'phags pa 'char gas byugs so/ /gal te bdag cag gi pha ma'am/ phu nu mo dag gis thos par gyur na rgyal byed kyi tshal ga la ba der ltar yang mi ster na mchi bar lta smos kyang ci 'tshal6) /sring mo dag kha rog shig /dge slong de ni mdun na 'don gyi bu las rab tu byung ba/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'dod chags shas ⑩che ba yin pas rtsom pa des nyon mongs pa sel bar byed do/ /'phags pa dag ci lags glang bu gang la rwa rnon po gnyis mchis pa des bdag nyid kyi dku 'dral bar bgyid dam/ de ni mi rigs so/ /sring mo dag kha rog shig dang bzlog par bya'o/ /'phags pa dag gal te bzlog na de lta na legs/ gal te bzlog ⑫5—510

par mi mdzad na/ bdag cag slan cad ①rgyal byed kyi tshal du mi ②mchi'o/ /sring mo dag kha rog shig dang ci nas kyang phyin chad de ltar ①byed par mi 'gyur bar bzlog par bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis ④de dag la bsgo ⑤ste dong ba dang /lhag ma rnams kyang gtsug lag khang nas byung ste dong ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka yang dgod ⑥bzhin du gtsug lag khang nas byung ba dang / dge slong rnams kyis de mthong nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka khyod mi mdzes pa de lta bu de ༅byas nas da ci dgodani/ 'char gas smras pa/ kho bos chang 'thungs sam/ kun dong 0zos sam ci/ tshe dang ldan pa ci de yang byas sam/gzhan ci zhig byas/ bram ze dang khyim bdag gi chung ma rab tu mang po de dag 'phya zhing dong ngo / /'char mas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag lhung bzed nag po can rnams kyi rang bzhin ni ser snas gang la yang tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam yang mi ston la/ de dag ni gang gzhan la ston pa de la 'phya bar byed do/ /de dag gis smras pa/ ci khyod kyis de dag bden pa dag la bkod dam des smras paX/ je yide dag gi dbang po yongs su smin par bya ba ⑫brtsams na mthar gyis bden pa yang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong don nyung ngu dag ci'i phyir dge slong dag yan lag gang gis ngo tsha bar bya ba'i yan lag de ④nyid kyis khengs par byed ces smod par byed/ phyar ka gtong ④bar byed / kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di dang / gleng tsogazhi 'di dang / skabs 'di la dge slong gi ⑩dge 'dun bsdu ba mdzad do zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa 5—511
